CeladonCity_Text_GotMyKoffingInCinnabar.text: I got my KOFFING in CINNABAR.\pIt's usually nice, but it breathes\npoison when it's angry.

CeladonCity_Text_GymIsGreatFullOfWomen.text: Heheh! This GYM is great!\nIt's full of women!

CeladonCity_Text_GameCornerIsBadForCitys.text: CELADON takes pride in its efforts\nto keep the city beautiful.\pThat's why the new GAME CORNER is\nbad for our city's image.

CeladonCity_Text_BlewItAllAtSlots.text: Moan…\nI blew it all at the slots!\pI knew I should have cashed in my\nCOINS for prizes!

CeladonCity_Text_MyTrustedPalPoliwrath.text: This is my trusted pal, POLIWRATH.\pIt evolved from a POLIWHIRL when\nI used a WATER STONE.

CeladonCity_Text_GetLostOrIllPunchYou.text: What are you staring at?\nGet lost, or I'll punch you.

CeladonCity_Text_KeepOutOfTeamRocketsWay.text: Keep out of TEAM ROCKET's way!

CeladonCity_Text_ExplainXAccuracyDireHit.text:
TRAINER TIPS\pX ACCURACY boosts the accuracy of
techniques.\pDIRE HIT jacks up the likelihood
of critical hits.\pGet your items at the CELADON
DEPT. STORE!

CeladonCity_Text_CitySign.text: CELADON CITY\nThe City of Rainbow Dreams

CeladonCity_Text_GymSign.text: CELADON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\lThe Nature-Loving Princess!

CeladonCity_Text_DeptStoreSign.text: Find what you need at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE!

CeladonCity_Text_GuardSpecProtectsFromSt.text: TRAINER TIPS\pGUARD SPEC. protects POKéMON\nfrom status-reduction moves during\lbattle.\pGet your items at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE!

CeladonCity_Text_GameCornerSign.text: ROCKET GAME CORNER\nThe playground for grown-ups!

CeladonCity_Text_ScaldedTongueOnTea.text:
Aaaagh, ow…
I scalded my tongue!\pThis nice old lady in the MANSION
gave me some TEA.\pBut it was boiling hot!
Gotta cool it to drink it.

Text_SoftboiledTeach.text:
Hello, there!\pI've seen you about, but I never
had a chance to chat.\pIt must be good luck that brought
us together finally.\pI'd like to celebrate by teaching
you the move SOFTBOILED.

Text_SoftboiledDeclined.text: I'll always be keeping an eye out\nfor you.\pI hope we can chat again.

Text_SoftboiledWhichMon.text: So, who's the POKéMON that gets\nthe chance to learn SOFTBOILED?

Text_SoftboiledTaught.text: I wish you the best of luck!

CeladonCity_Text_SomeoneStoleSilphScope.text: Oh, what am I to do…\pSomeone stole our SILPH SCOPE.\pThe thief came running this way,\nI'm sure of it.\pBut I lost sight of him!\nWhere'd he go?

CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_TryThis.text: You shouldn't spend all your money\non drinks.\pTry this instead.

CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_Nothing.text: Nothing beats thirst like some hot\nTEA.\pIt really is the best.

CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_MyDearM.text: My dear POKéMON keep me company.\nMEOWTH even brings money home!

CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_DaisyCo.text:
Oh, hello, dearie.
Did you enjoy my TEA?\pBy the way, dear. Are you, by any
chance, from PALLET TOWN?\pA girl from PALLET TOWN, DAISY,
she enjoys TEA every day.\pShe visits the CELADON DEPT. STORE
to buy some TEA.

CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ImTheGr.text: I'm the graphic artist!\nI drew you!

CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_IWroteT.text: I wrote the story!\nIsn't ERIKA cute?\pI like MISTY a lot, too!\nOh, and SABRINA, I like her!

CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ImGameD.text: Is that right?\pI'm the game designer!\pFilling up your POKéDEX is tough,\nbut don't quit!\pWhen you finish, come tell me!

CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ItsTheG.text: It's the game program! Messing with\nit could bug out the game!

CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_Someone.text: Someone's playing a game instead of\nworking!

CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ItsScri.text: It's the script!\nBetter not look at the ending!

CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_T.text:
There is nothing that I don't know,
like I wrote on the blackboard.\pI know about the world of POKéMON
in your GAME BOY ADVANCE!\pGet together with your friends and
enjoy trading POKéMON!

CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_B.text: ポケモンが　いっぱいだ\nボックスを　かえて　きなさい

CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_W.text: POKéMON Lecture\pPlaying with the Wireless Adapter

CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_R.text: Which heading do you want to read?

CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_E.text: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB is\nupstairs at any POKéMON CENTER.\pVisit one to link up with friend(s)\nusing your Wireless Adapter.

To link only with a friend, go to
the DIRECT CORNER.\pIt is the right counter at the
POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB.\pGo into the TRADE CORNER or the
COLOSSEUM with your friend.

To link and communicate with
anyone, go to the UNION ROOM.\pIt is the left counter at the
POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB.\pGo to the UNION ROOM and enjoy
meeting other TRAINERS.

CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_P.text: It's a pamphlet on TMs.\p… …\pThere are fifty TMs in all.\pThere are also seven HMs that\ncan be used repeatedly.\pSILPH CO.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Welc.text: Hello!\nWelcome to CELADON DEPT. STORE.\pThe board on the right describes\nthe store layout.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Floo.text: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER\p2F: TRAINER'S MARKET\p3F: TV GAME SHOP\p4F: WISE MAN GIFTS\p5F: DRUGSTORE\pROOFTOP SQUARE: VENDING MACHINES

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Supe.text: SUPER REPEL keeps weak POKéMON at\nbay…\pHmm, it's a more powerful REPEL.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_BuyR.text: For long outings, you should buy\nREVIVE.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Floo.text: Top-Grade Items for TRAINERS!\p2F: TRAINER'S MARKET

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Lanc.text: We have a customer, LANCE, who\noccasionally comes.\pHe always buys capes.\pI wonder… Does he have many\nidentical capes at home?

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_OTSt.text: Captured POKéMON are registered\nwith an ID No. and the OT.\pOT stands for “Original TRAINER” -\nthe TRAINER that caught it first.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Budd.text: All right!\pMy buddy's going to trade me his\nKANGASKHAN for my HAUNTER!

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Haun.text: Come on, HAUNTER!\pI love HAUNTER!\nI collect them!\pHuh?\pHAUNTER turned into a different\nPOKéMON while being traded!

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_CanI.text: You can identify POKéMON you get\nin trades by their ID Numbers.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_AnRP.text: An RPG!\nThere's no time for that!

Text_CounterTeach.text:
Oh, hi!
I finally finished POKéMON.\pNot done yet? How about I teach
you a good move?\pThe move I have in mind is
COUNTER.\pNot like the one I'm leaning on,
mind you!

Text_CounterDeclined.text: You're not interested? Come see\nme if you change your mind.

Text_CounterWhichMon.text: Which POKéMON should I teach\nCOUNTER to?

Text_CounterTaught.text: Are you using that COUNTER move\nI taught your POKéMON?

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Gett.text: I'm getting a present for my\ngirlfriend.\pI guess a POKé DOLL will be it.\nIt's the popular thing.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_CanR.text: I heard something useful.\pIf a wild POKéMON appears, you can\ndistract it with a POKé DOLL.\pYou can run away while the wild\nPOKéMON is distracted.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Floo.text: Express yourself with gifts!\n4F: WISE MAN GIFTS\pEvolution Special!\nElement STONES on sale now!

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Expl.text:
POKéMON stat enhancers can be
bought only here.\pHP UP increases the base HP of a
POKéMON.\pCALCIUM raises the base SP. ATK
stat of one POKéMON.\pZINC boosts the base SP. DEF stat
of one POKéMON.\pCARBOS enhances the base SPEED
stat.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Here.text:
I'm here for POKéMON stat
enhancers.\pPROTEIN increases the base ATTACK
power.\pIRON increases the base DEFENSE
stat.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Im.text: I'm thirsty!\nI want something to drink!\p{FONT_NORMAL}Give her a drink?

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ya.text: Yay!\pFRESH WATER!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ex.text: TM16 contains LIGHT SCREEN.\pIt's a move that weakens the power\nof special attacks by your foe.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ya.text: Yay!\pSODA POP!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ex.text: TM20 contains SAFEGUARD.\pIt's a move that prevents status\nproblems among your POKéMON.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ya.text: Yay!\pLEMONADE!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ex.text: TM33 contains REFLECT.\pIt's a move that weakens the power\nof physical attacks by your foe.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Do.text: You don't have space for this!

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Im.text: No, thank you!\nI'm not thirsty after all!

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_My.text: My sister is a TRAINER, believe it\nor not.\pBut, she's so immature, she drives\nme nuts!

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Im.text: I'm thirsty!\nI want something to drink!

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ve.text: A vending machine!\nWhat does it have?

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_No.text: There's no more room for stuff!

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CanExchangeC.text: Welcome!\pYou can exchange your COINS for\nfabulous prizes next door.

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WelcomeBuySo.text: Welcome to ROCKET GAME CORNER!\pDo you need some game COINS?\nWould you like to buy some?

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SorryDontHav.text: Oh, I'm sorry.\nYou don't have a COIN CASE.

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_RumoredTeamR.text: Keep this quiet.\pIt's rumored that this place is run\nby TEAM ROCKET.

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_ThinkMachine.text: I think these machines have\ndifferent odds.

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DoYouWantToP.text: Kid, do you want to play?

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WinsComeAndG.text: Wins seem to come and go.\nNothing's a sure thing.

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WinOrLoseIts.text: These slot games…\nWin or lose, it's only by luck.

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GymGuyAdvice.text:
Hey!\pYou have better things to do,
champ in the making!\pCELADON GYM's LEADER is ERIKA.\pShe is a user of GRASS-type
POKéMON, and at one with nature.\pShe might appear docile because of
her flower arranging…\pBut she's not one to be taken
lightly!

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_RareMonsForC.text: They offer rare POKéMON that can\nbe exchanged for your COINS.\pBut, I just can't seem to win!

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SoEasyToGetH.text: Games are scary!\nIt's so easy to get hooked!

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedMoreCoin.text: Darn! I need more COINS for the\nPOKéMON I want!

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_HereAreSomeC.text: Hey, what? You're throwing me off!\nHere are some COINS, so shoo!

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_YouveGotPlen.text: You've got plenty of your own\nCOINS!

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WatchReelsCl.text: The trick is to watch the reels\nclosely.

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntIntro.text: I'm guarding this poster!\nGo away, or else!

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntPostBat.text: The TEAM ROCKET HIDEOUT might\nbe discovered!\pI better tell BOSS!

CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SwitchBehind.text: Hey!\pA switch behind the poster!?\nLet's push it!

CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Fa.text: I sure do fancy that PORYGON!\nBut, it's hard to win at slots!

CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Ra.text: Gahaha! I raked it in today!\nIf only every day were like this…

CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_We.text: We exchange your COINS for prizes.

CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Yo.text: Okay, a TM of {STR_VAR_2}\nis what you want?

CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Ne.text: Sorry, you'll need more COINS\nthan that.

CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Oo.text: おきゃくさん もう もてないよ

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaIntro.text:
Hello…
Lovely weather, isn't it?\lIt's so pleasant…\p…Oh, dear…
I must have dozed off. Welcome.\pMy name is ERIKA.
I am the LEADER of CELADON GYM.\pI am a student of the art of
flower arranging.\pMy POKéMON are solely of the
GRASS type.\p…Oh, I'm sorry, I had no idea that
you wished to challenge me.\pVery well, but I shall not lose.{PLAY_BGM MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaDefeat.text: Oh!\nI concede defeat.\lYou are remarkably strong.\pI must confer on you the\nRAINBOWBADGE.

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaPostBattle.text: You are cataloging POKéMON?\nI must say I'm impressed.\pI would never collect POKéMON if\nthey were unattractive.

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRainbowBadge.text: The RAINBOWBADGE will make\nPOKéMON up to Lv. 50 obey.\pIt also allows POKéMON to use\nSTRENGTH in and out of battle.\pPlease also take this with you.

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM19.text: TM19 contains GIGA DRAIN.\pHalf the damage it inflicts is\ndrained to heal your POKéMON.\pWouldn't you agree that it's a\nwonderful move?

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ShouldMakeRoomForTh.text: You should make room for this.

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayIntro.text: I should tell you about this GYM.\pOnly real ladies are allowed in\nhere!

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayPostBattle.text: Bleaah!\nI hope ERIKA wipes you out!

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetPostBattle.text: GRASS-type POKéMON are tough\nagainst the WATER type.\pThey also have an edge on ROCK-\nand GROUND-type POKéMON.

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaPostBattle.text: Oh, you were looking at ERIKA…\nYou weren't looking at me…

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaIntro.text: Look, look!\nSee my POKéMON!\pI like the GRASS type.\nI like how they're easy to raise.

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaPostBattle.text: We only use GRASS-type POKéMON at\nour GYM.\pWhy? We also use them for making\nflower arrangements!

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaIntro.text: Oh, hey!\pWe don't like BUG- or FIRE-type\nPOKéMON in here!

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaPostBattle.text: Our LEADER ERIKA might be quiet,\nbut she's famous around here.

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriIntro.text: Pleased to meet you.\nMy hobby is POKéMON training.

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriPostBattle.text: I have a blind date coming up.\nI have to learn to be polite,\lespecially if I have to battle.

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro.text: Welcome to CELADON GYM!\pYou'd better not underestimate\nthe nice ladies here.

CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle.text: I didn't bring my best POKéMON.\nWait until next time!

CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_ThisHotelIsForPeo.text: POKéMON?\nNo, this is a hotel for people.\pWe're full up, unfortunately.

CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_OnVacationWithBro.text: I'm on vacation with my brother and\nboyfriend.\pCELADON is such a pretty city!

CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_WhyDidSheBringBro.text: Why?\nWhy did she bring her brother?

CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_SisBroughtMeOnVac.text: Yippee! I'm on vacation!\nMy sis brought me along! Awesome!

CeladonCity_House1_Text_SlotsReelInTheDo.text: Hehehe!\pThe slots just reel in the dough,\nbig-time!

CeladonCity_House1_Text_ShippedMonsAsSlo.text: CHIEF!\pWe just shipped two thousand\nmore POKéMON as slot prizes\lagain today!

CeladonCity_House1_Text_DontTouchGameCor.text: Don't touch the poster at the GAME\nCORNER!\pThere's no secret switch behind it!

CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeFl.text: A POKé FLUTE awakens sleeping\nPOKéMON. You know that.\pIt does so with a sound that only\nthey can hear.

CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RodeHe.text: I rode here from FUCHSIA.\pIt's an uphill ride on CYCLING\nROAD, so I'm exhausted.

CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToCy.text: If I had a BIKE, I would go to\nCYCLING ROAD!

CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_TakingBreakR.text: Hi!\pSorry, but we're taking a break\nright now.

CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_OftenGoToDru.text: My POKéMON are weak, so I often\nhave to go to the DRUGSTORE.

CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_PsstBasement.text: Psst! There's a basement under the\nGAME CORNER, I hear.

CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ManLostItAll.text: Munch…\pThe man at that table lost it all\nat the slots.

CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_TakeThisImBu.text:
Go ahead! Laugh!
I'm flat-out busted!\pNo more slots for me!
I'm going straight!\pHere!
I won't be needing this anymore!

CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ReceivedCoin.text: {PLAYER} received a COIN CASE\nfrom the man.

CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ThoughtIdWin.text: I always thought I was going to\nwin it back…

CeruleanCity_Text_RivalIntro.text:
{RIVAL}: Yo! {PLAYER}!\pYou're still struggling along back
here?\pI'm doing great! I caught a bunch
of strong and smart POKéMON!\pHere, let me see what you caught,
{PLAYER}!

CeruleanCity_Text_RivalPostBattle.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, guess what?\pI went to BILL's and got him to
show me his rare POKéMON.\pThat added a lot of pages to my
POKéDEX!\pAfter all, BILL's world famous as a
POKéMANIAC.\pHe invented the POKéMON Storage
System on PC, too.\pSince you're using his system,
you should go thank him.\pWell, I better get rolling!
Smell ya later!

CeruleanCity_Text_OhRightLittlePresentAs.text: Oh, yeah, right.\pI feel sorry for you. No, really.\nYou're always plodding behind me.\pSo here, I'll give you a little\npresent as a favor.

CeruleanCity_Text_ExplainFameCheckerSmel.text:
A chatty gossip like you…
That thing's perfect.\pI don't need it because I don't
give a hoot about others.\pAll right, this time I really am
gone. Smell ya!

CeruleanCity_Text_RivalVictory.text: なんたって！\nおれは　てんさい　だからよ！

CeruleanCity_Text_GruntIntro.text:
Hey! Stay out!
It's not your yard!\p…Huh?
Me?\pI'm an innocent bystander!
Don't you believe me?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}

CeruleanCity_Text_GruntDefeat.text: GRUNT: Stop! I give up!\nI'll leave quietly!

CeruleanCity_Text_RecoveredTM28FromGrunt.text: {PLAYER} recovered TM28 from\nthe TEAM ROCKET GRUNT.

CeruleanCity_Text_MakeRoomForThisCantRun.text: Make room for this!\nI can't run until I give it to you!

CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerLifeIsToughIsnt.text: You're a TRAINER, too?\pCollecting, battling…\nIt's a tough life, isn't it?

CeruleanCity_Text_YouCanCutDownSmallTree.text:
Did you know that you can CUT down
small trees?\pEven that small tree in front of
the shop can be CUT down.\pI think there's a way around it,
though.

CeruleanCity_Text_IfSlowbroWasntThereCou.text:
If that SLOWBRO wasn't there, you
could CUT down the small tree.\pThat way, you could get to the
other side.\pI think there's a way around it,
though.

CeruleanCity_Text_PokemonEncyclopediaAmu.text: You're making an encyclopedia on\nPOKéMON? That sounds amusing.

CeruleanCity_Text_PeopleHereWereRobbed.text: The people here were robbed.\pIt's obvious that TEAM ROCKET is\nbehind this most heinous crime!\pEven our POLICE FORCE has\ntrouble with the ROCKETS!

CeruleanCity_Text_HardToControlMonsObedi.text: No! That's wrong!\nIt's so hard to control POKéMON!\pYour POKéMON's obedience depends\non your abilities as a TRAINER.

CeruleanCity_Text_WantBrightRedBicycle.text: I want a bright red bicycle.\pI'll keep it at home, so it won't\nget dirty.

CeruleanCity_Text_ThisIsCeruleanCave.text:
This is CERULEAN CAVE.\pHorribly strong POKéMON live inside
there.\pIt takes a very special TRAINER to
be allowed inside there.\pYou'd have to be strong enough to
become the POKéMON LEAGUE\lCHAMPION for starters.\pAnd, you would have to have
made a great achievement.

CeruleanCity_Text_CitySign.text: CERULEAN CITY\nA Mysterious, Blue Aura Surrounds\lIt

CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerTipsHeldItems.text: TRAINER TIPS\pA POKéMON can be made to hold\nan item.\pSome items can even be used by\nthe holding POKéMON in battle.

CeruleanCity_Text_BikeShopSign.text: Grass and caves handled easily!\nBIKE SHOP

CeruleanCity_Text_GymSign.text: CERULEAN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\lThe Tomboyish Mermaid!

CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_WelcomeToBike.text: Hi!\nWelcome to our BIKE SHOP.\pHave we got just the BIKE for\nyou!

CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_OhBikeVoucher.text: Oh, that's…\pA BIKE VOUCHER!\pOkay!\nHere you go!

CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedVouc.text: {PLAYER} exchanged the\nBIKE VOUCHER for a BICYCLE.

CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_HowDoYouLikeN.text: How do you like your new BICYCLE?\nDo you like how it rides?\pYou can take it out on CYCLING\nROAD and even into caves!

CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_MakeRoomForBi.text: You better make room for your\nBICYCLE!

CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_CityBikeGoodE.text: A plain city bike is good enough\nfor me.\pAfter all, you can't put a shopping\nbasket on a mountain bike.

CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_BikesCoolButE.text: These bikes are cool, but they're\nway expensive!

CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_GermanFoldabl.text: ついに　はつばい！\pドイツ　せい　さいこうきゅう\nおりたたみ　じてんしゃ！

CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyIntro.text:
Hi, you're a new face!\pOnly those TRAINERS who have a
policy about POKéMON can turn pro.\pWhat is your approach when you
catch and train POKéMON?\pMy policy is an all-out offensive
with WATER-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM03.text: TM03 teaches WATER PULSE.\pUse it on an aquatic POKéMON!

CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCascadeBadg.text:
The CASCADEBADGE makes all
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 obey.\pThat includes even outsiders you
got in trades.\pThere's more. You can now use CUT
anytime, even out of battle.\pYou can CUT down small trees to
open new pathways.\pYou can also have my favorite TM.

CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_BetterMakeRoomForT.text: You better make room for this!

CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyDefeat.text: Wow!\nYou're too much!\pAll right!\pYou can have the CASCADEBADGE to\nshow you beat me.

CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaIntro.text: What? You?\nI'm more than good enough for you!\pMISTY won't have to be bothered.

CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaPostBattle.text: You have to face other TRAINERS\nto see how good you really are.

CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisPostBattle.text: MISTY is a TRAINER who's going to\nkeep improving.\pShe won't lose to someone like you!

CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLet me give you some advice!\pThe LEADER, MISTY, is a pro who
uses WATER-type POKéMON.\pYou can drain all their water with
GRASS-type POKéMON.\pOr, you might use ELECTRIC-type
POKéMON and zap them!

CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_WeMakePrettyGoodTe.text: You beat MISTY!\nSee, what'd I tell ya?\pYou and me, kid, we make a pretty\ndarn-good team!

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_BadgesHaveAmazi.text: Only skilled TRAINERS can collect\nPOKéMON BADGES.\pI see you have at least one.\pThose BADGES have amazing secrets,\ndid you know?

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DescribeWhichBa.text: Now then…\pWhich of the eight BADGES should\nI describe?

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ComeVisitAnytim.text: Come visit me anytime you wish.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AttackStatFlash.text: The ATTACK stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLASH outside of battle.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv30Cut.text:
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
CUT outside of battle.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpeedStatFly.text: The SPEED stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLY outside of battle.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv50Strengt.text:
POKéMON up to Lv. 50 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
STRENGTH outside of battle.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DefenseStatSurf.text: The DEFENSE stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nSURF outside of battle.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv70RockSma.text:
POKéMON up to Lv. 70 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
ROCK SMASH outside of battle.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpStatsWaterfal.text: The SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats of\nall your POKéMON rise a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nWATERFALL outside of battle.

CeruleanCity_House2_Text_RocketsStoleTMF.text:
Those miserable ROCKETS!\pLook what they've done to my
house!\pThey stole a TM for teaching
POKéMON how to DIG holes!\pI was going to use it on a
MANKEY or a SANDSHREW…\pThat cost me a bundle, it did!

CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeachDiglettDig.text: I figure what's lost is lost.\pI decided to teach DIGLETT how to\nDIG without a TM.

CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketTryin.text: TEAM ROCKET must be trying to DIG\ntheir way into no good!

CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketLeftW.text: TEAM ROCKET left a way out!

CeruleanCity_House3_Text_PleaseTradeWith.text: My husband likes trading POKéMON.\pYou're collecting POKéMON for your\nPOKéDEX, aren't you?\pWould you please trade with him?

CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NothingEntertai.text: Sigh…\nToo much time, too little to do…\pIs nothing entertaining happening\nanywhere?

CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NewNewsInformat.text:
Ah!
A new news report!\pHmm…\pI see!
That was quite informative!\pI applaud you for taking interest
in the news at your young age.\pAs my thanks for sharing the news
with me, I want you to have this.

CeruleanCity_House4_Text_IncredibleNewsH.text:
Oh, oh!
Th-this news report!\pHmm…\pAmazing!
What an incredible piece of news!\pI haven't seen a news story this
incredible in too long a time!\pThanks for sharing this fantastic
news. Have a bunch of BERRIES!

CeruleanCity_House4_Text_WishCouldShareN.text: It seems such a shame to not share\nthis news with other folks…\pI wish I could tell someone…\nLet others know the news…

CeruleanCity_House4_Text_ThanksForSpread.text: Ah, you've spread the news for me?\pGood news becomes worthwhile when\nall sorts of people share it.\pAs my thanks for your spreading\nthe news, take this!

CeruleanCity_House4_Text_MagnificentNews.text:
You've spread the news some more?
Magnificent!\pThat piece of news must be
delighted to be passed around so.\pYes, indeed!\pConsider this a show of
appreciation from me and the news.\pI'll give you more BERRIES than
I usually do.

CeruleanCity_House4_Text_EnjoyingMyselfW.text: I'm quite enjoying myself with all\nsorts of news.\pYes, I am satisfied!\nI won't be bored for a while.

CeruleanCity_House4_Text_YourBerryPouchI.text: Hm? Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nMy gift remains ungiven, then.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AnyInterestInBe.text:
I concoct a variety of medicine
from BERRY POWDER.\pUsing good BERRY POWDER, I can
make any kind of medicine.\pNow tell me, have you any interest
in BERRIES?

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveJustTheThin.text: Ah, good! For you, then, I have\njust the thing.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_GoCrushBerriesA.text:
There's something new on the second
floor of POKéMON CENTERS, at the\lDIRECT CORNER.\pThey installed a Wireless Adapter
machine for crushing BERRIES.\pThis is where you come in.\pI have a favor to ask, one that
I can entrust only to you.\pCould you make BERRY POWDER for
me using that machine?\pDon't forget, the machine is at the
DIRECT CORNER of POKéMON CENTERS.\pI'll concoct medicine for you if
you bring me some BERRY POWDER.\pDon't forget, crush BERRIES into
BERRY POWDER and bring it to me.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_WhyMustYouLieNo.text: Why must you lie to me?\pHow many BERRIES do you have?\nNot a one!

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TakeInterestInA.text: You have no interest in BERRIES?\pYoung one, it's important to take an\ninterest in all sorts of things.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveYouBroughtB.text: Er-hem! Have you brought me some\nBERRY POWDER?

CeruleanCity_House5_Text_ExchangeWithWha.text: With what would you like to \nexchange it?

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_YoullExchangeBe.text: Fine, you'll exchange your BERRY\nPOWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DontHaveEnoughB.text: Hm? You don't have enough\nBERRY POWDER.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TradeMoreBerryP.text: This is fine BERRY POWDER indeed.\nIt will make excellent medicine.\pWould you like to trade more BERRY\nPOWDER for something else?

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HopeToSeeYouAga.text: That's fine, then.\nI'll hope to see you back again.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SeeMeIfYoudLike.text: Come see me if you'd like to trade\nyour BERRY POWDER.

CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_RepelWorksOnWeakM.text:
REPEL not only keeps bugs away,
it also works on weak POKéMON.\pPut your strongest POKéMON at the
left of the POKéMON LIST.\pIf your first POKéMON is strong,
REPEL's effect is boosted.

CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_DoYouKnowAboutRar.text: Do you know about RARE CANDY?\nThey don't sell it in shops.\pI think it makes POKéMON grow\nvery quickly all of a sudden.

CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillD.text: That BILL!\pI heard that he'll do whatever it\ntakes to get rare POKéMON.\pHe's not above doing all sorts\nof things, I've heard.

CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Every.text: Have you heard about BILL?\pEveryone calls him a POKéMANIAC!\pI think people are just jealous of\nBILL, though.\pWho wouldn't want to boast about\ntheir POKéMON?

CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillC.text: BILL has lots of POKéMON!\nHe collects rare ones, too!

CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryTr.text:
Why don't you go upstairs and try
trading POKéMON with your friends?\pYou could get a lot more variety
by trading.\pThe POKéMON you get in trades grow
quickly, too.

CinnabarIsland_Text_BlaineLivedHereSince.text: CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE is quite the\nodd fellow.\pHe's lived on the island since way\nbefore the LAB was built.

CinnabarIsland_Text_ScientistsExperiment.text: Scientists conduct experiments \nin the burned-out building.\pYou know, the one they call the\nPOKéMON MANSION.

CinnabarIsland_Text_IslandSign.text: CINNABAR ISLAND\nThe Fiery Town of Burning Desire

CinnabarIsland_Text_GymSign.text: CINNABAR ISLAND POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\lThe Hotheaded Quiz Master!

CinnabarIsland_Text_ComeWithMeToOneIslan.text:
Look, it's me, BILL.
Long time no see!\pI hope you're still using my
PC system.\pWell, listen, since we met up here,
how about spending time with me?\pThere's this little island in the far
south called ONE ISLAND.\pA friend invited me, so I'm on my
way out there.\pHow about it?
Do you feel like coming with me?

CinnabarIsland_Text_IllBeWaitingInPokeCe.text:
What, are you too busy?\pWell, all right.
The boat hasn't arrived yet anyway.\pI'll be waiting at the POKéMON
CENTER over there.\pCome see me when you're done with
your business here.

CinnabarIsland_Text_MyPalsBoatArrived.text: Looks like my pal's boat arrived,\ntoo.\pHe sent it specially here to\nCINNABAR to pick me up.

CinnabarIsland_Text_IfYouHaveTriPassYouC.text:
Hey, wasn't that a long cruise?\pMy buddy CELIO seemed to enjoy
your company.\pI'm sure he'd welcome you if you
were to visit him again.\pIf you have a TRI-PASS, you can
always take a ferry there from\lVERMILION PORT.\pAll right, thanks for your company!

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro.text:
Hah!\pI am BLAINE, the red-hot LEADER
of CINNABAR GYM!\pMy fiery POKéMON are all rough
and ready with intense heat!\pThey incinerate all challengers!\pHah!
You better have BURN HEAL!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineDefeat.text: I have burned down to nothing!\nNot even ashes remain!\pYou have earned the VOLCANOBADGE.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_FireBlastIsUltim.text: FIRE BLAST is the ultimate fire\ntechnique.\pDon't waste it on WATER POKéMON.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ExplainVolcanoBa.text: Hah!\pThe VOLCANOBADGE heightens the\nSPECIAL stats of your POKéMON.\pHere, you can have this, too!

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlainePostBattle.text: TM38 contains FIRE BLAST.\nTeach it to FIRE-type POKéMON.\pVULPIX or CHARMELEON would be\nideal for that move.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikIntro.text: Do you know how hot POKéMON fire\nbreath can get?

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikPostBattle.text: Fire, or to be more precise,\ncombustion…\p…Oxygen in the air…\nBlah, blah, blah, blah…

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnIntro.text: I was a thief, but I went straight\nas a TRAINER.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnPostBattle.text: I get this uncontrollable urge to\nsteal other people's POKéMON.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryIntro.text: I've studied POKéMON thoroughly.\nYou can't win!

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryPostBattle.text: My theories are too complicated\nfor you to understand.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonIntro.text: I like using FIRE-type POKéMON.\nI just do.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonPostBattle.text: I wish there were a thief POKéMON.\nI'd use that!

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekIntro.text: I know why BLAINE became a\nTRAINER.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekPostBattle.text:
Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost
in the mountains but good.\pNight fell when a fiery bird
POKéMON appeared.\pIts light allowed BLAINE to find
his way down safely.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyIntro.text: I've been to many GYMS, but this\none best suits my style.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyPostBattle.text: PONYTA, NINETALES…\nThose are popular FIRE POKéMON.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacPostBattle.text: Water beats fire, of course.\pBut fire melts ice, so the FIRE\ntype beats ICE-type POKéMON.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pThe hotheaded BLAINE is a FIRE
POKéMON pro.\pDouse his spirits with water!\pYou'd better take some
BURN HEALS, too.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PokemonQuizRules.text:
POKéMON Quiz!\pGet it right, and the door opens to
the next room.\pGet it wrong, and face a TRAINER!\pIf you want to conserve your
POKéMON for the GYM LEADER…\pThen get it right!
Here we go!

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion2.text: There are nine certified POKéMON\nLEAGUE BADGES?

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion4.text: Are electric moves effective\nagainst GROUND-type POKéMON?

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion5.text: POKéMON of the same kind and level\nare not identical?

CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveXAt.text: Don't they have X ATTACK?\pI like it because it raises the\nATTACK stat in battle.

CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_ExtraItemsNever.text: It never hurts to have extra items.\nYou never know what might happen.

CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Cin.text:
I came to visit the CINNABAR GYM,
but the door is locked tight.\pThere should be a key for it
somewhere.\pCould it be in that burned-out
mansion?\pThe GYM LEADER's friend used to
live there, they say.

CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Vis.text:
Do you have lots of friends?\pLinking up with the usual friends
is fun, of course.\pBut how about visiting the
UNION ROOM every so often?\pWho knows, you may end up making
new friends.\pI think it would be worth your time
to check the UNION ROOM.

CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Evo.text: POKéMON can still learn techniques\nafter canceling evolution.\pEvolution can wait until new moves\nhave been learned.

CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Rea.text: BILL: Hey, you kept me waiting!\nReady to set sail to ONE ISLAND?

CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OhN.text: Oh, you're still not done yet?

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PhotoOfBlaineAnd.text: It's a photo of BLAINE and\nMR. FUJI.\pThey're standing shoulder to\nshoulder with big grins.

CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_.text: We study POKéMON extensively\nevery day.\pPeople often bring us rare POKéMON\nfor examination.
A photo of the LAB's founder…\nDR. FUJI?!

Text_MetronomeTeach.text:
Tch-tch-tch!
I'll teach you a nifty move.\pTeach it to a POKéMON, and watch
the fun unfold!\pIt's a move called METRONOME.
Does it strike your fancy?

Text_MetronomeDeclined.text: I tell you, it's a lot of fun!

Text_MetronomeTaught.text: Tch-tch-tch!\nThat's the sound of a METRONOME.\pIt tweaks your POKéMON's brain into\nusing moves it doesn't even know.

CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom.text:
Hiya!\pI am important doctor.
Yes, very much so, indeed.\pHere, I study rare POKéMON fossils.
All the time, I study.\pYou!
Have you a fossil for me?
ちょっと　じかん　かかるよ！\pそこらへんを　すこし\nブラブラ　してくると　よろしー！
You late.\nWhere were you?\pYour fossil is back to life!\nIt was {STR_VAR_1} like I think!
ポケモン　いっぱいで　もてないね！

Oh!
That is {STR_VAR_2}, it is!\pIt is fossil of {STR_VAR_1},
a POKéMON that is already extinct!\pMy Resurrection Machine will make
that POKéMON live again!
So!\nYou hurry and give me that!\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} handed over the\n{STR_VAR_2} to the weird doctor.
I take a little time!\nYou go for walk a little while!

CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Lounge_Text_Fo.text: I found this most remarkable fossil\ninside MT. MOON.\pI think it's of a rare, prehistoric\nPOKéMON.

CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_T.text: EEVEE can evolve into one of three\nkinds of POKéMON.

There's an e-mail message.\p… … …\pThere are three legendary bird
POKéMON.\pThey are ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS, and
MOLTRES.\pTheir whereabouts are unknown.\pWe plan to explore the cavern
close to CERULEAN.\pFrom: POKéMON RESEARCH TEAM…

DiglettsCave_NorthEntrance_RockTunnelPit.text: I went inside ROCK TUNNEL, but it's\npitch-black and scary in there.\pIf I could get a POKéMON to use\nFLASH and light it up…

DiglettsCave_SouthEntrance_Text_DiglettD.text: Well, isn't this a surprise!\nDIGLETT dug this long tunnel!\pIt goes right to VIRIDIAN CITY,\nthey tell me.

FiveIsland_Text_IslandSign.text: FIVE ISLAND\nChrono Island: Where Time Goes

FiveIsland_Text_WeirdBuildingInMeadow.text: Oh, this stinks. I wanted to play in\nthe MEADOW.\pBut they put up a weird building\non it, so I can't play there.

FiveIsland_Text_BeenGettingBusierAroundH.text: It's been getting busier around\nthese parts lately.\pI haven't been catching many good\nfish lately, either.

FiveIsland_House1_JPText_HusbandWentOffF.text: こんばんの　おかずは\nようい　しなくて　いいぞ！\pって　だんなが\nつりに　いったん　だけど‥\lしんじて　いいのかねえ

FiveIsland_House1_Text_HusbandWentOffFis.text:
Don't worry about buying anything
for dinner tonight!\p…That's what my husband said when
he went off fishing today.\pI'm not sure if I can count on him
to live up to that promise.

FiveIsland_House2_Text_MeadowBelongedToF.text:
That MEADOW has belonged to our
family for generations.\pI should have had a giant mansion
built on it.\pIt would be preferable to having
those thugs run wild on it!

FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonInt.text: Aiyeeeeeh!\pI thought this was an ancient ruin.\nBut it's teeming with ghosts!

FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonPos.text: I'm trying to get out of here, but\nI always end up at the same spot.\pMaybe the number of boulders is\na hint…

FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyIn.text: W-what do you intend to do with\nme?

FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyDe.text: Oh… I was afraid that you meant to\nharm me.

FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_MayIAskY.text:
I am so glad that you happened
here.\pI grew rather bored of walking,
and I am feeling fatigued.\pMay I ask you to take me home
from here?

FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraIntr.text: I think there is a mysterious power\nat work in this cave.

FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraDefe.text: If you don't go into the right\ntunnel, you won't get ahead.

FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraPost.text: Earlier, a lady went into the caves\nahead.

FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_DoorNeedsTwoPassw.text: とびらを　あけるには\nパスワードが　2つ　いるようだ

FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordAn.text: {PLAYER} entered a password.\p“GOLDEEN need log.”\p… …  … …  … …\pAnother password is needed to\nopen the door…

FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordDo.text: {PLAYER} entered two passwords.\p“GOLDEEN need log.”\n“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”\p… …  … …  … …\pThe WAREHOUSE's door opened!

FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1PostBattle.text: You don't have any business here!\nGo home!

FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2Intro.text: There's nothing past here except\nour WAREHOUSE.\pSo what brings you here?

FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2PostBattle.text: You're wanting to know what's inside\nthis WAREHOUSE?\pIt's better you didn't know.\nFor your own sake, I mean.

FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3Intro.text: You'd be wasting time even if you\nwere to get by me.

FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3PostBattle.text: You won't be able to get in without\nthe passwords anyway.

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloIntro.text: I'm the eldest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the beak.

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloPostB.text: You can fly to FOUR ISLAND from\nhere.

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazIntro.text: I'm the middle kid of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the wings.

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazPostB.text: There was a really somber guy\nover that way.

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldInt.text: I'm the youngest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the down.

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldDef.text: Down is so comfy…\nIt makes me drowsy…

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldPos.text: It fills me with happiness when\nbird POKéMON beg playfully…

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThisIsWhe.text: This is where I buried my ONIX…\nIt was named TECTONIX…

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesT.text: “Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.\pThere is a LEMONADE placed as an\noffering in front of the grave.

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_LeaveAnot.text: Would you like to leave another\nLEMONADE as an offering?

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_PlacedCan.text: {PLAYER} placed a can of LEMONADE\nin front of the grave.

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThankYouP.text:
Th-thank you…\pThat was my TECTONIX's favorite
drink…\pI don't even know you, but your
act of kindness…\pIt's uplifted me a little.\pCan you please take this as my
thanks?

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_BeGoodToY.text: Please be good to your POKéMON,\ntoo.

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_DontHaveR.text: If you don't have room for it,\nI'll hold it for you till next time.

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_StillHave.text: Oh, it's you from that time…\pI still have that thing I wanted\nyou to have as my thanks.

FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesT.text: Boulders and rocks are neatly piled\nup as a cairn.\p“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.

FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnMyWay.text: I'm on my way to prepare a meal\nfor a certain high-society person.

FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoureOn.text: You're on a quest to catch every\nsingle kind of POKéMON?\p…How incredible. Please tell me if\nyou catch a strong one!

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyIntr.text: With these hands, I will create\nmy victory!

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyPost.text: Uh-oh, my paint tubes have\nscattered everywhere!

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaInt.text: Excuse me!\nI'm trying to paint.\lPlease keep out of my sight!

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaDef.text: This loss…\nI feel like I'm whiting out…

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaPos.text: GILLIAN?\nPlease tilt your head slightly…\lThere! That's the look I want!

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaIntr.text: Hmm…\nThe angle, it is not quite there…

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaPost.text: The sky and the sea…\nThey are so fickle.\pTheir changing expressions make\nthem difficult to capture.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiIntr.text: I am visiting my friend's retreat,\nif you must know.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiPost.text: I find it pleasurable to leisurely\nbattle in the gentle sea breeze.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianIn.text: I'm thinking of having a pool\nmade specially for POKéMON.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianPo.text: A pool would be nice, but I must\nsay, a sun-room may be sublime.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinInt.text: I'm a good runner.\nI'm really fast!

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinPos.text: When I run with the wind, it feels\nlike I could fly!

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyIntro.text: I say, this marine life here at\nthis resort agrees with me.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyDefea.text: That's a shocker!\nYou must be joking.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyPostB.text: Getting so serious over this…\nHow nonsensical.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_SelphyTha.text: SELPHY: Thank you.\pYou may go now.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Ple.text: SELPHY: Oh?\nDo I know you from somewhere?\pOh, but that doesn't matter.\pI am exquisitely bored.\nPlease, hear my wish.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Wis.text: I wish to see a POKéMON.\nA darling {STR_VAR_1}.\pI want to see one right away.\nPlease, make my wish come true.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_OhI.text: SELPHY: Oh, I'm tired of this.\nI'm tired of waiting for you.\pI'll forgive you this time, but\nplease don't fail me next time.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Mon.text:
SELPHY: Oh, hello, there.\pOh, my gracious. That must be the
{STR_VAR_1} you caught for me.\pGiggle…
I see a resemblance to you.\pThank you so kindly.\p… …  … …  … …
Is something the matter?\pYou may leave.\p… …  … …  … …
Oh, fine. I understand now.\pSEBASTIAN!
I need you here this instant!

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Sel.text: SELPHY: See to it that this person\nis given a token of appreciation.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_But.text: Butler: I shall do as you bid,\nmy lady.
Butler: I sincerely thank you for\npleasing Lady SELPHY.\pPlease accept this as her thanks…
Butler: Your BAG appears to be\nunfortunately full.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Sel.text: SELPHY: I wish you the best of\nluck.

FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Lad.text: Butler: The smile of Lady SELPHY\nhas the brilliance of the sun.\pPlease, I beg you to bring joy\nto Lady SELPHY.

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ManyMons.text: There are many POKéMON locked\naway in the pen…

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_PenUnloc.text: The pen door is unlocked.\nThe POKéMON appear to have fled.

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2In.text: Did you come here knowing it's\nTEAM ROCKET's WAREHOUSE?

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2De.text: What do you think you're doing?!

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2Po.text: TEAM ROCKET broke up?\nWhat planet are you from?

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1In.text: Oh, now your POKéMON look strong.\nYou're willing to sell them?\pOh?\nYou wanted to battle?

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1Po.text: We can give you a great price.\nSell us your POKéMON!

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3In.text: I got word about you from the\nothers.\pBut there's no way a kid like you'd\nknow our BOSS GIOVANNI!

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3Po.text: Don't mess in the doings of adults,\nyou jumped-up pip-squeak!

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1In.text: I don't know or care if what I'm\ndoing is right or wrong…\pI just put my faith in GIOVANNI\nand do as I am told.

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1Po.text: You're doing things according to\nyour beliefs and morals.\pI understand now…

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_MadeItSo.text:
I've made it so you can come back
in through there.\pWhy don't you go get rested and
refreshed for what lies ahead?\pThe ADMIN after me outranks me
thoroughly as a TRAINER.\pYou'd better steel yourself for one
harsh challenge.

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2In.text:
That's quite enough of you 
playing the hero, kid.\pSpreading lies about how TEAM
ROCKET has disbanded…\pIt's such an obvious attempt to
cause confusion in our ranks.\pFortunately, we're not so ignorant
to fall for the lies of a child!\pAnd now, I'll show you how scary
an angry adult can be!

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2De.text:
Urgh…
You were too strong…\p…
Th-that's GIOVANNI's BADGE!\pSo it's true?
TEAM ROCKET really has disbanded?

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2Po.text: We will abandon this WAREHOUSE…\pBut don't think this is over.\nI won't let this be the end.\pI will find GIOVANNI.\nAnd I will resurrect TEAM ROCKET!\lI will…\pUntil then, farewell!

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ReportWi.text: A report with graphs and text is on\nthe PC monitor.\p“The Influence of Magnetic Waves\non POKéMON Evolution”…\p… … … … … …\pIt's too difficult to understand…

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonIn.text:
I almost managed to sell the
SAPPHIRE for huge money…\pThen, you just had to come along
and blow the whole deal apart!\pFufu… Fufufufu…
There's no forgiveness for you!

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonPo.text: If I can't sell it, it's worthless!\nGo ahead, take it!

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GetLostL.text: What do you want now?\nGo on, get lost, leave me be.

FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Giovanni.text:
What, you again?\pYou… You're not GIOVANNI's kid,
are you?\pNo, that can't be right!
GIOVANNI's kid has red hair.\pYou don't have any reasons for
bugging me. Leave me alone!

FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_LetMeTake.text:
You travel all over the place,
don't you?\pYou're not driving your POKéMON
too harshly, are you?\pLet me take a look.
… … …   … … …

FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_TreatMonR.text: Oh, impressive.\nYou treat your POKéMON right.\pI think you can be entrusted with\nthis.\pPlease, I'd like you to have this.

FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_DontHaveS.text: …Unfortunately, you don't have\nspace for this in your party.\pYou'd better come back for it\nanother time.

FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_YouveCome.text: やあ\nタマゴを　もらいに\lきて　くれたんだね

FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_GladIMetS.text: I received that EGG while I was\ntraveling.\pI'm glad I met someone like you.

FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_CuteMonRe.text:
Oh, hello.
That's a cute {STR_VAR_2}.\pSeeing it reminds me of a sweet 
little girl I met while traveling.\pShe was gently grooming POKéMON…
She was a little angel.\pThat little girl's name…
I think it was DAISY.

FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeIntr.text: This is an excellent environment\nfor raising POKéMON.

FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeDefe.text: Your POKéMON are growing up\nadmirably well!

FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizePost.text: You know, I think you have the\ntalent to be a good BREEDER.

FourIsland_Text_IslandSign.text: FOUR ISLAND\nThe Warm, Blue, Floe Island

FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasReturned.text: LORELEI has returned.\pDid she find the city life too\nstressful, I wonder?

FourIsland_Text_LoreleiMetLaprasAsChild.text:
LORELEI has gone back.\pThe LAPRAS she has, I imagine it
to be the one she met as a child.\pI believe it was in ICEFALL CAVE
that she caught it.\pPerhaps that POKéMON has been with
her ever since.

FourIsland_Text_RivalAlreadyGotEggBeSmel.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey!
{PLAYER}!\pWhat are you doing here in the
SEVII ISLANDS?\pYou should quit copying me,
you know?\pAnyways, I already got my POKéMON
EGG, so I'm done with this island.\pHeh, I bet you don't even know
about POKéMON EGGS.\pYou'll never fill your NATIONAL
POKéDEX that way.\pBy the way, I saw someone we both
know on this island.\pWhy don't you go look around if
it makes you curious?\pMe, I don't have the time to
waste.\pBe smelling ya!

FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasLotsOfStuffedD.text:
Oh, you found me!
Please don't tell LORELEI.\pDid you know that LORELEI has lots
and lots of stuffed dolls?\pEvery time she comes back to
FOUR ISLAND, her collection grows!

FourIsland_Text_MadeSlushieUsingIcefallC.text: Ooh, chilly!\pI made a slushie using ice I\nshaved inside ICEFALL CAVE.\pIt's chilly and tasty!

JPText_BodySlamTeach.text: そーれ　ぼよーん！\nどっちが　さきに　へたばるか？\lのしかかり　しょうぶ　してるんだ\pきみは　なかまに　はいったら\nつぶれそうだな‥\lかわりに　きみの　ポケモンに\lのしかかり　おしえて　やろっか？

JPText_BodySlamDeclined.text: また　おいで　ぼよーん！

JPText_BodySlamWhichMon.text: どの　ポケモンに\nおしえたい　かい？

FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_Lorelei.text: LORELEI: Keep your filthy hands\noff the POKéMON in the cave!\pDo as I say, or you'll have me to\nanswer to!

FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_ShutItL.text: Aww, shut it, lady, and leave\nus be.\pDon't let your glasses get all\nsteamed up!

FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_Lorelei.text:
LORELEI: {PLAYER}?!
What are you doing here?\pNo, we can catch up later.
Right now, I need your help.\pHelp me kick these poachers out
before they do anything else.\pThey've been catching POKéMON
here, then selling them off!\pAre you ready?
You take that one, please!

FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_GruntIn.text: W-what?!\pWho says we can't do what we want\nwith the POKéMON we catch?

FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_Lorelei.text:
LORELEI: Humph.
So despicably weak.\pYou!
Tell me!\pWhere have you taken the captured
POKéMON?\pI'm smashing your ring once and
for all!

FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_NotTell.text: N-no way!\nI'm not telling you that!

FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_Lorelei.text:
LORELEI: If you won't confess,
we'll deep-freeze you.\pMy LAPRAS is furious for what
you've done to its friends.\pGo, LAPRAS!
ICE BEAM…

FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_OkayRoc.text:
Wawaah! Okay!
I'll talk!\pThe POKéMON are in the ROCKET
WAREHOUSE on FIVE ISLAND.\pThere! I said it!
We'll be going now!\p…But I doubt you'll ever make it
into the ROCKET WAREHOUSE!\pHeheheheh!

FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_ThankYo.text:
{PLAYER}, thank you.
But this is awful…\pI was born and raised here on
these islands.\pI had no idea that those horrible
criminals were loose here…

FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IfAnything.text:
LORELEI: There's something weighing
heavily on my mind.\pIf anything were to happen on
the island where I was born…\pI wouldn't know about it if I were
in the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI wonder if that would make me
irresponsible to my home…

FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IllReturnT.text:
LORELEI: So, you managed to solve
all the problems here?\pThat's wonderful.\pThat means there isn't any reason
for me to be here all the time.\pThank you…\pI'll return to the POKéMON LEAGUE
in a short while.

FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_WillDoWhat.text: I don't know what will happen in\nthe future, but…\pI will do what I can here and now.\nThat's all I can do.

FourIsland_Mart_Text_LoreleiGrewUpOnThis.text:
We've had a great and powerful
TRAINER grow up on this island.\pI bet even you'd know her.
It's LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR!\pWhen LORELEI was just a tyke,
I taught her about POKéMON.

FourIsland_Mart_Text_IcefallCaveIsFrigid.text:
The SEVII ISLANDS are in a warm
region overall.\pBut there is one exception you
need to know about.\pThe ICEFALL CAVE is frigid because
of the POKéMON that live in it.

Text_BodySlamTeach.text:
Ready?
Boing!\pWe're having a BODY SLAM match
to see who wimps out first.\pIf you were to join us, you'd be
squashed like a bug, though…\pHow about I teach BODY SLAM to
a POKéMON of yours instead?

Text_BodySlamWhichMon.text: Which POKéMON wants to learn how\nto BODY SLAM?

FourIsland_House1_Text_FatMan.text: それ　ぼよーん！\nおまえ　おもいなあー！

FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RareIce.text: There's a rare kind of ICE POKéMON\nthat lives in the cave.\pWe get a lot of visitors hoping to\nsee that POKéMON.

FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DayCare.text:
Oh? A POKéMON EGG?
…I have no idea.\p…Oh, wait. The DAY-CARE people
in town were saying something.\pThey said that they'd found EGGS
before on their property.

FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NewPoke.text: What's this?\pThe new POKéMON JOURNAL hasn't\narrived on this island?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DidYouTrySafariGame.text: Did you try the SAFARI GAME?\pThere are some rare POKéMON that\ncan only be caught there.

FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneZooInFront.text: The SAFARI ZONE has a zoo in front\nof the entrance.\pOut back is the SAFARI GAME for\ncatching POKéMON.

FuchsiaCity_Text_WheresSara.text: ERIK: Where's SARA?\nI said I'd meet her here.

FuchsiaCity_Text_ItemBallInThere.text: That item ball in there…\nWere you wanting that?\pMe, too!\n…Huh? That's a POKéMON?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneOfficeSign.text: POKéMON PARADISE!\nWelcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\lSAFARI ZONE OFFICE

FuchsiaCity_Text_GymSign.text: FUCHSIA CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\lThe Poisonous Ninja Master

FuchsiaCity_Text_ChanseySign.text: Name: CHANSEY\nCatching one is all up to chance.

FuchsiaCity_Text_VoltorbSign.text: Name: VOLTORB\nThe very image of a POKé BALL.

FuchsiaCity_Text_KangaskhanSign.text: Name: KANGASKHAN\pA maternal POKéMON that raises its\nyoung in a pouch on its belly.

FuchsiaCity_Text_SlowpokeSign.text: Name: SLOWPOKE\nFriendly and very slow moving.

FuchsiaCity_Text_LaprasSign.text: Name: LAPRAS\nAKA the king of the seas.

FuchsiaCity_Text_OmanyteSign.text: Name: OMANYTE\nAn extremely rare POKéMON that was\lregenerated from a fossil.

FuchsiaCity_Text_KabutoSign.text: Name: KABUTO\nAn extremely rare POKéMON that was\lregenerated from a fossil.

Text_SubstituteTeach.text:
Aww, I wish I was a KANGASKHAN
baby.\pI'd love to be a substitute for the
baby…\pAnd snuggle in the mother
KANGASKHAN's belly pouch.\pBut only POKéMON can use the
technique SUBSTITUTE…\pWant me to teach SUBSTITUTE to
one of your POKéMON?

Text_SubstituteTaught.text: Boy, what I'd give to crawl inside\na KANGASKHAN belly pouch…

FuchsiaCity_Text_MyFatherIsGymLeader.text: My father is the GYM LEADER of\nthis town.\pI'm training to use POISON POKéMON\nas well as my father.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaIntro.text:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!\pA mere child like you dares to
challenge me?\pThe very idea makes me shiver
with mirth!\pVery well, I shall show you true
terror as a ninja master.\pPoison brings steady doom.
Sleep renders foes helpless.\pDespair to the creeping horror of
POISON-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaDefeat.text: Humph!\nYou have proven your worth!\pHere!\nTake the SOULBADGE!

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaPostBattle.text: When afflicted by TOXIC, a POKéMON\nsuffers more and more.\pIt suffers worsening damage as the\nbattle wears on!\pIt will surely terrorize foes!

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainSoulBadg.text:
Now that you have the SOULBADGE,
the DEFENSE of your POKéMON rises.\pIt also lets you SURF outside of
battle.\pAh!
Take this, too!

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainTM06.text: Sealed within that TM06 lies\nTOXIC!\pIt is a secret technique dating\nback some four hundred years.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenIntro.text: Strength isn't the key for POKéMON.\nDo you understand this?\pPOKéMON is about strategy!\pI'll show you how strategy can\nbeat brute strength.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenPostBattle.text: So, you mix brawn with brains?\nGood strategy!\pThat's remarkable for a child\nTRAINER.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro.text: I was a magician once upon a time.\pBut I dreamt of becoming a ninja,\nso I joined this GYM.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle.text: Even though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\lof KOGA, my ninja master.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro.text: Let's see you beat my special\ntechniques!

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle.text: I like poison and sleep techniques,\nas they linger after battle!

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilIntro.text: Stop right there!\pThe famed invisible walls of\nFUCHSIA GYM have you frustrated?

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilPostBattle.text: You impressed me!\nHere's a hint!\pLook very closely for gaps in the\ninvisible walls!

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarIntro.text: I also study the way of the ninja\nwith Master KOGA!\pNinja have a long history of using\nanimals!

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarPostBattle.text: I still have much to learn.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro.text: Master KOGA comes from a long line\nof ninjas.\pWhat did you descend from?

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle.text: Where there is light, there is\nshadow!\pLight and shadow!\nWhich do you choose?

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pFUCHSIA GYM is a tricked-up place.
It's riddled with invisible walls!\pKOGA might appear close, but he's
blocked off.\pYou have to find gaps in the walls
to reach him.

FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory.text: It's amazing how ninja can terrify,\neven now!

FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WardenIsOldHasFa.text: The SAFARI ZONE's WARDEN is old, \nbut he's still very much active.\pAll his teeth are false, though.

FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillIsMyGrandson.text: Hmm?\nYou've met BILL?\pHe's my grandson!\pHe always liked collecting things,\neven as a child!

FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillFilesHisOwnM.text: BILL files his own POKéMON data on\nhis PC.\pDid he show you?

FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_DoYouLikeToFish.text: I'm the FISHING GURU's older\nbrother.\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?

FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_LikeYourStyleTak.text: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!

FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_ReceivedGoodRod.text: {PLAYER} received a GOOD ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU's brother.

FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_GoodRodCanCatchB.text:
Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.\pA crummy OLD ROD could only catch
MAGIKARP, yes?\pBut with a GOOD ROD, you can
catch much better POKéMON.

FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_HowAreTheFishBit.text: Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pHow are the fish biting?

FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_YouHaveNoRoomFor.text: Oh, no!\pI had a gift for you, but you have\nno room for it!

FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WouldYouLikeToFo.text: Uh…\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\pI can make POKéMON forget their\nmoves.\pWould you like me to do that?

FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonHasForgottenM.text: It worked to perfection!\p{STR_VAR_1} has forgotten\n{STR_VAR_2} completely.

FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_ComeAgainToForge.text: Come again if there are other\nmoves to be forgotten.

FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_NoEggShouldKnowM.text: What?\nNo EGG should know any moves.

FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveSafari.text: Don't they have any pennants\npromoting the SAFARI ZONE?\pHow about some paper lanterns?\nAren't there even any calendars?

FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DidYouTryXSpeed.text: Did you try X SPEED?\nIt speeds up a POKéMON in battle.

FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CantBe.text: You can't become a good TRAINER\nwith just one strong POKéMON.\pBut raising many POKéMON evenly\nis no easy task, either.

FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Pokemo.text: There's a narrow trail west of\nVIRIDIAN CITY.\pIt goes to the POKéMON LEAGUE HQ.\nThe HQ governs all TRAINERS.

FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitS.text: If you're working on a POKéDEX,\nvisit the SAFARI ZONE.\pAll sorts of rare POKéMON breed\nthere.

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Pla.text: For just ¥500, you can play the\nSAFARI GAME.\pYou can roam the wide-open safari\nand catch what you like.\pWould you like to play?

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Tha.text: That'll be ¥500, please!\pWe only use a special kind of \nPOKé BALLS here.

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Cal.text: We'll call you on the PA when you\nrun out of time or SAFARI BALLS.\pWell, I'll wish you the best of\nluck!

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Goi.text: Are you going to leave the\nSAFARI ZONE early?

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Ple.text: Please return any SAFARI BALLS\nyou may have left.

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Cat.text: Did you catch your fair share?\nCome again!

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Fir.text: Hi! Is it your first time here at\nthe SAFARI ZONE?

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Exp.text:
The SAFARI ZONE actually has
four zones in it.\pEach zone has different kinds of
POKéMON, even some rare ones.\pUse the supplied SAFARI BALLS to
catch them.\pYou can also throw BAIT or ROCKS
besides the SAFARI BALLS.\pIf you throw BAIT, the POKéMON
becomes less likely to flee, but\lharder to catch.\pIf you throw ROCKS, the POKéMON
becomes more likely to flee, but\leasier to catch.\pWhen you run out of time or SAFARI
BALLS, it's game over for you!

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Nickn.text: We nicknamed the WARDEN\n“SLOWPOKE.”\pYou know, he has that vacant look\nlike a SLOWPOKE.

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Warde.text: WARDEN SLOWPOKE is very\nknowledgeable about POKéMON.\pHe even has some fossils of rare,\nextinct POKéMON.

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Could.text: WARDEN SLOWPOKE came in, but\nI couldn't understand him.\pI think he's got a speech problem!

FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Prize.text:
WARDEN SLOWPOKE is running a
promotion campaign right now.\pTry to get to the farthest corner
of the SAFARI ZONE.\pIf you can make it, you'll win a
very convenient prize.

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HifFuffHef.text: WARDEN: Hif fuff hefifoo!\pHa lof ha feef ee hafahi ho.\nHeff hee fwee!

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_AhHowheeHo.text: Ah howhee ho hoo!\nEef ee hafahi ho!

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HeOhayHeHa.text: Ha?\nHe ohay heh ha hoo ee haheh!

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_GaveGoldTe.text: {PLAYER} gave the GOLD TEETH\nto the WARDEN.

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_WardenPopp.text: The WARDEN popped in his teeth!

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksSonG.text:
WARDEN: Thanks, son!
You're a real lifesaver!\pNo one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!\pI was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.\pLet me give you something for your
trouble.

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksLass.text:
WARDEN: Thank you, lassie!
You're a real lifesaver!\pNo one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!\pI was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.\pLet me give you something for your
trouble.

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ExplainStr.text:
WARDEN: Inside HM04 you'll find
STRENGTH.\pIt lets POKéMON move boulders when
you're outside of battle.\pOh yes, did you find the SECRET
HOUSE in the SAFARI ZONE?

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_YouHaveToo.text: なんや　にもつ\nいっぱいやんけ！

FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_MonPhotosF.text: POKéMON photos and fossils are on\ndisplay.

IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymG.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pAt the POKéMON LEAGUE, you will
face the ELITE FOUR all in a row.\pIf you lose, you have to start all
over again!\pThis is it!
Go for it!

IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Face.text: From here on, you face the\nELITE FOUR one by one.\pIf you win, a door opens to the\nnext TRAINER. Good luck!

IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Lore.text:
I am so sorry, but you've wasted
your time coming here.\pLORELEI of the ELITE FOUR is
absent, you see.\pAs a result, the POKéMON LEAGUE is
closed for the time being.

IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Agat.text:
AGATHA's GHOST-type POKéMON are
horrifically terrifying in toughness.\pI took my FIGHTING-type POKéMON
and raised them to the max.\pI went at AGATHA feeling pretty
confident, but she whupped us.\pThat old lady's also got a really
short fuse, too.\pIt doesn't take anything to get
that scary lady hollering.

IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Lanc.text: Maybe becoming an ELITE FOUR\nmember is in the blood.\pFrom what I've heard, LANCE has\na cousin who's a GYM LEADER\lsomewhere far away.

LavenderTown_Text_JustImaginingWhiteHand.text: Hahaha, I guess not.\pThat white hand on your shoulder…\nI'm just imagining it.

LavenderTown_Text_TownKnownAsMonGraveSit.text: This town is known as the grave\nsite of POKéMON.\pMemorial services are held in\nPOKéMON TOWER.

LavenderTown_Text_GhostsAppearedInTower.text: Ghosts appeared in POKéMON TOWER.\pI think they're the spirits of\nPOKéMON that the ROCKETS killed.

LavenderTown_Text_SilphScopeNotice.text: New SILPH SCOPE!\nMake the Invisible Plain to See!\pSILPH CO.

LavenderTown_Text_PokemonTowerSign.text: POKéMON TOWER\nBecalm the Spirits of POKéMON

LavenderTown_House1_Text_RocketsKilledCu.text: Those horrible ROCKETS!\nThey deserve no mercy!\pThat poor CUBONE's mother…\pIt was killed trying to escape from\nTEAM ROCKET.

LavenderTown_House1_Text_GhostOfPokemonT.text: The ghost of POKéMON TOWER is\ngone!\pSomeone must have soothed its\nrestless spirit!

LavenderTown_House2_Text_WantMeToRateNic.text: Hello, hello!\nI am the official NAME RATER!\pWant me to rate the nicknames of\nyour POKéMON?

LavenderTown_House2_Text_GiveItANicerNam.text: {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat is a decent nickname!\pBut, would you like me to give it\na nicer name?\pHow about it?

LavenderTown_House2_Text_WhatShallNewNic.text: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new\nnickname be?

LavenderTown_House2_Text_FromNowOnShallB.text: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt is a better name than before!\nHow fortunate for you!
Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt looks no different from before,\nand yet, this is vastly superior!\pHow fortunate for you!

LavenderTown_House2_Text_TrulyImpeccable.text: {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat is a truly impeccable name!\pTake good care of {STR_VAR_1}!

LavenderTown_House2_Text_ThatIsMerelyAnE.text: Now, now.\nThat is merely an EGG!

LavenderTown_Mart_Text_SearchingForStatR.text:
I'm searching for items that raise
the stats of POKéMON.\pThey're effective over the course
of a single battle.\pX ATTACK, X DEFEND, X SPEED, 
and X SPECIAL are what I'm after.\pDo you know where I can get them?

LavenderTown_Mart_Text_DidYouBuyRevives.text: Did you buy some REVIVES?\nThey revive any fainted POKéMON!

LavenderTown_Mart_Text_TrainerDuosCanCha.text: Sometimes, a TRAINER duo will\nchallenge you with two POKéMON\lat the same time.\pIf that happens, you have to send\nout two POKéMON to battle, too.

LavenderTown_Mart_Text_SoldNuggetFromMou.text: この　あいだ　やまおくで\nきんのたまを　ひろい　ましてね！\pつかえない　しなもの　ですが\nうったら　なんと　5000¥でした

LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Rocke.text: TEAM ROCKET will do anything for\nthe sake of money!\pThere is no job too dirty, no deed\ntoo heinous, no crime too wicked!

LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Cubon.text: I saw CUBONE's mother trying to\nescape from TEAM ROCKET.\pShe was killed trying to get away…

LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Peopl.text: You know how the CUBONE species\nwears skulls, right?\pPeople will pay a lot for one.

LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HearM.text: I recently moved to this town.\pI hear that MR. FUJI's not from\nthese parts originally, either.

LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_.text: That's odd, MR. FUJI isn't here.\nWhere'd he go?
MR. FUJI had been praying alone\nfor CUBONE's mother.
This is really MR. FUJI's house.\pHe's really kind.\pHe looks after abandoned and\norphaned POKéMON.
It's so warm!\nPOKéMON are so nice to hug.

MR. FUJI: {PLAYER}…\pYour POKéDEX quest is one that
requires strong dedication.\pWithout deep love for POKéMON,
your quest may fail.\pI'm not sure if this will help you,
but I'd like you to have it.
{PLAYER} received a POKé FLUTE\nfrom MR. FUJI.
Upon hearing the POKé FLUTE,\nsleeping POKéMON will spring awake.\pTry using it on POKéMON that are\nsleeping obstacles.
You must make room for this!
MR. FUJI: Has my POKé FLUTE\nhelped you?
POKéMON FAN MAGAZINE\nMonthly Grand Prize Drawing!\pThe application form is…\pGone! It's been clipped out.\nSomeone must have applied already.
POKéMON magazines line the shelf.\pPOKéMON INSIDER…\pPOKéMON FAN…

Text_ExplosionTeach.text:
Can you imagine?
If this volcano were to erupt?\pThe explosion would be the end of
us. How terrifying is that?\pWhile we're terrified, would you
like me to teach EXPLOSION?

Text_ExplosionDeclined.text: Yeah, you're right.\nIt is too terrifying.

Text_ExplosionWhichMon.text: You're terribly brave!\pWhich POKéMON should I teach\nEXPLOSION?

Text_ExplosionTaught.text: Using EXPLOSION while on this\nvolcano…\pWhat a terrifying thrill!

Text_ExplosionTeachJP.text: こ　この　かざんが\nもし　だいばくはつ　したら\lお　おれら　ひとたまりも\lないなあ　‥ブルブル！\pこ　こわい　ついでに\nだいばくはつ　でも　おぼえてみる？

Text_ExplosionDeclinedJP.text: や　やっぱ　こわいもんな\nブルブル

Text_ExplosionWhichMonJP.text: つ　つよきだね！\nじゃあ　どの　ポケモンに　する？

Text_ExplosionTaughtJP.text: かざんで　だいばくはつを‥\nす　すごい　スリル！

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellTryDiggingHere.text: Over here.\nWe'll try digging here.\pThat treasure the ADMINS've been\ntalking about should be here.

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_YoureInTheWayGetLo.text: What the…?\nYou're in the way. Get lost.

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_PunchedThroughAtLa.text: Whew, punched through at last.\nLet's go treasure hunting!

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WhatsPasswordAgain.text: Any treasure we find, we haul back\nto the WAREHOUSE, understood?\p…Oh, and what're the passwords?\nAt the ROCKET WAREHOUSE, I mean.

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_FirstPasswordGolde.text: What, you forgot the password?\nThere're actually two.\pThe first one's “GOLDEEN need\nlog.”\pAnd the second one is…

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: You've been eavesdropping on us,\nhaven't you?

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2Intro.text: Trying to horn in on our treasure?\nDon't bet on it!

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.text: Develop amnesia conveniently and\nforget everything you heard!

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellRegroupDontSte.text:
What a setback…
We'll have to regroup.\pYou! Don't even think about taking
a step inside here!\pIf you know what's good for you,
don't even think about this!

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganIntro.text: An active volcano is one that's\nerupting, or about to.

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganDefeat.text: Whew… That was hot!\nSweat's erupting from me!

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganPostBattle.text: They say there're over 1,500\nactive volcanoes in the world.\pJust thinking about them makes me\nfeel all hot and gooey inside!

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethIntro.text: Do you know how caves form inside\nvolcanoes?

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethPostBattle.text: When lava at the surface of magma\nhardens, and the magma inside flows\lout, caverns are left behind.

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynIntro.text: I've been in training so I can mend\nmy broken heart…\pIt toughened me up physically at\nleast! Hi-yah!

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynDefeat.text: I think I tried to overdo it…

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynPostBattle.text: The way you battle, it reminds me\nof the guy who dumped me…

MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosIntro.text: WHOA!\nYou shocked me!\l…Oh, you're just a kid!

MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosPostBattle.text: Kids like you shouldn't be\nwandering around here in the dark.

MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshIntro.text: Did you come to explore the cave,\ntoo?

MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshPostBattle.text: I came all the way down here to\nshow off to girls.

MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamIntro.text: Wow! It's way bigger in here than\nI thought!

MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamPostBattle.text: How do you get out of here?\nIt's so big, I may get lost.

MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanPostBattle.text: I have to find stronger POKéMON.\nWhere might they be?

MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisIntro.text: What?\nI'm waiting for my friends to find\lme here.

MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisPostBattle.text: I came because I heard there are\nsome very rare fossils here.

MtMoon_1F_Text_KentIntro.text: Suspicious men are in the cave.\nWhat about you?

MtMoon_1F_Text_KentPostBattle.text: I saw them!\nI'm sure they're from TEAM ROCKET!

MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyIntro.text: You need to go through this cave\nto get to CERULEAN CITY.

MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyPostBattle.text: ZUBAT is tough!\nBut if you can catch one, you'll\lbe able to count on it.

MtMoon_1F_Text_BrockHelpsExcavateFossils.text: Hi, I'm excavating for fossils here\nunder MT. MOON.\pSometimes, BROCK of PEWTER GYM\nlends me a hand.

MtMoon_B2F_Text_MiguelIntro.text: Hey, stop!\pI found these fossils!\nThey're both mine!

MtMoon_B2F_Text_WellEachTakeAFossil.text: We'll each take a fossil!\nNo being greedy!

MtMoon_B2F_Text_ThenThisFossilIsMine.text: All right.\nThen this fossil is mine!

MtMoon_B2F_Text_LabOnCinnabarRegenerates.text: Far away, on CINNABAR ISLAND,\nthere's a POKéMON LAB.\pThey do research on regenerating\nfossils.

MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: We, TEAM ROCKET, shall find the\nfossils!\pReviving POKéMON from them will\nearn us huge riches!

MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.text: You made me mad!\nTEAM ROCKET will blacklist you!

MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2Intro.text: We, TEAM ROCKET, are POKéMON\ngangsters!\lWe strike fear with our strength!

MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.text: Darn it all!\nMy associates won't stand for this!

MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3Intro.text: We're pulling a big job here!\nGet lost, kid!

MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle.text: If you find a fossil, give it to me\nand scram!

MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro.text: Little kids shouldn't be messing\naround with grown-ups!\pIt could be bad news!

MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle.text: POKéMON lived here long before\npeople came.

MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantDomeFossil.text: Do you want the DOME FOSSIL?

MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantHelixFossil.text: Do you want the HELIX FOSSIL?

OneIsland_Text_BillLetsGoSeeCelio.text:
BILL: Here we are!
This is ONE ISLAND.\pThere are several islands around
here, and this is one of them.\pMy friend CELIO sent the boat to
fetch me here.\pHe's in charge of the island's PC
network by his lonesome.\p…Why am I telling you this now?
Let's just go see CELIO!

Text_WhereDoYouWantToSail.text: Ahoy, there!\nWhere do you want to sail?

OneIsland_Text_LuckyToHaveCelioHere.text:
Here we are on an island smack in
the middle of nowhere.\pWe're lucky to have an upstanding
young man like CELIO here.\pMy granddaughter was in a tizzy
over CELIO's friend.\pSomething about a famous
POKéMANIAC?\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man!

OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithKanto.text:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy
over a new breakthrough.\pShe said we now have PC linkage
with people in KANTO.\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man!

OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithHoenn.text:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy
over a new breakthrough.\pShe said we finally have PC linkage
with people in HOENN.\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man.\pHe would make a fine husband for
my granddaughter!

OneIsland_Text_IslandSign.text: ONE ISLAND\nFriends Gather at Knot Island

OneIsland_Text_PokemonNetCenterSign.text: Expanding the POKéMON World!\nPOKéMON NET CENTER

OneIsland_Text_ReturnToCinnabar.text: グレンタウンに　もどりますか？

OneIsland_Text_IsntWarmClimateHereGreat.text: Hi, sight-seeing, are you?\nIsn't the warm climate here great?

OneIsland_House1_Text_GazeUponVolcanoOnS.text: On sunny days, I step out and gaze\nupon the volcano.\pThat's my daily routine.

OneIsland_House1_Text_LastTimeMtEmberEru.text: Let me think… When was the last\ntime MT. EMBER erupted?

OneIsland_House2_Text_IWantToStayHereFor.text: Young people all want to go off to\nbig cities.\pBut I want to stay here forever!

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaIntro.text: The weather's gorgeous!\nPerfect for a battle!

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaPostBattl.text: Please don't splash my face!\nYou'll ruin the makeup.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailIntro.text: I'm beginning to get a sunburn…

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailPostBat.text: I like that cap you have.\nMaybe I should wear one, too…

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnIntro.text: Seen from here, MT. EMBER towers\ninto the sky.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnPostBattle.text: The sky is immense around these\nparts.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettIntro.text: I took a break from swimming,\nonly to have you challenge me?

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettPostBat.text: Instead of using SURF all the time,\nyou should swim some.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyIntro.text: Wait! Wait a second!\nI think I've hooked a big one!

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyPostBattl.text: Not only did I lose, the big one\ngot away from me, too!

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonIntro.text: Could you help me out with my\ntraining?

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonDefeat.text: You were a cut above me.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonPostBatt.text: It's clear that you're skilled.\nI like you!

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaIntro.text: There isn't a day in which we don't\ntrain!

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaPostBattl.text: I'll train even harder from now on!

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaIntro.text: Every morning, before breakfast,\nI swim around this island.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaPostBattle.text: I lost because I'm pooped from all\nthe running I did…

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughIntro.text: Dress appropriately for battle!\nLose that frivolous outfit!

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughPostBattle.text: Even martial artists are becoming\nfashion conscious these days…
