OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceIntro.text: You know, everything tastes great\nwhen you're out in the wild.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BrycePostBattl.text: The water in volcanic regions is\ndelicious.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireIntro.text: My lunch filled us up, so will you\nbattle us for some exercise?

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClairePostBatt.text: What should I do?\nI feel famished again.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaIntro.text: KIA: My big brother and I make\nan awesome combination!

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaPostBattle.text: KIA: How could there be anyone\nbetter than my big brother?

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaNotEnoughMo.text: KIA: If you want to battle with\nus, you have to bring at least two\lPOKéMON with you.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikIntro.text: MIK: Together with KIA, I'm afraid\nof nothing!

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikPostBattle.text: MIK: How could my combination\nwith KIA fail?

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikNotEnoughMo.text: MIK: Hey, do you want to battle\nwith us two?\pBring two or more POKéMON with\nyou, then.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_RouteSign.text: This is KINDLE ROAD.\pGo straight for MT. EMBER.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_EmberSpaSign.text: Light the Fire in Your Heart!\nEMBER SPA

OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Water.text:
Hm!
Haaaaaaaaaaah!\pAaaah! This is heavenly!
The water warms me to my core!\pYou should jump in, too.\pGo to the middle, relax, and get
good and warm!

OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Enjoy.text: My favorite part of bathing comes\nup right after this.\pI enjoy a bowl of chowder to\nwarm me from the inside, too!

OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Water.text: The water is perfectly warm.\nIt feels exquisite…\p{PLAYER} and the POKéMON were\nfully refreshed!

OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_HotSp.text: Soaking in a hot spring pool is\ntherapeutic, people say.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_SeeHo.text: Have a look at my face.\nSee how smooth my skin is?\pThe hot spring's water keeps my\nskin younger than my age.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Bruno.text:
After an honest day of training,
nothing beats a relaxing soak in\lthe hot spring pool.\pBRUNO, who's a senior ahead of me,
visits the SPA on occasion.\pHe comes to rehab injuries, both
his own and his POKéMON's.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_UsedT.text:
Hot springs go hand-in-hand with
volcanoes.\pThe EMBER SPA here, well,
I made it years ago.\pI hewed the pool right out of a
gigantic boulder by hand.\pI was using this at the time.
I suppose I can part with it.

OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Expla.text: That shatters boulders as if they\nwere made of crackers.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCan.text: CELIO: BILL!\nI can't believe you came out here.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillHows.text: BILL: Well, absolutely!\nHow's your research coming along?\p…Oh, wait a sec.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThisIsMy.text: {PLAYER}, this is my buddy CELIO.\nHe's one dedicated PC MANIAC!

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlayerIs.text: CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, a rising\ncontender as the POKéMON CHAMP!
CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, the\nreigning POKéMON CHAMP!

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioTha.text: CELIO: That's really impressive.\pI hate to say it, but I have zero\naptitude for battling.\pAnyways, I'm glad to meet you.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillBrin.text: BILL: So, bring me up to speed.\nHow's your machine running?

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPCs.text: CELIO: It's running fine, but we're\ntoo remote out here.\pThe PCs on this island just can't\nlink with your PC, BILL.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillLetM.text: BILL: Oh, yeah?\nOkay, let me take a look-see.\p…Hang on here…\nI think we can make it work.\lLet me help you, okay?

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanYouDe.text:
{PLAYER}, can I get you to wait for
me just a bit?\p…Actually, can I get you to do
me a favor?\pThe island next to this one's
called TWO ISLAND.\pThere's a guy there that runs
a GAME CORNER.\pHe has this thing for rare rocks
and gems.\pWe keep in touch, being fellow
maniacs.\pSo, can I get you to deliver this
METEORITE to him?

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPle.text: CELIO: {PLAYER}, if you are going\nto TWO ISLAND, please take this.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLets.text: It's a PASS for the ferry service\nserving the local islands.\pIt will let you travel between the\nISLANDS ONE, TWO, and THREE.\pOh, you should have this, too.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Received.text: {PLAYER} received an extra page\nfor the TOWN MAP!

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCatc.text: BILL: I'll catch you later!\nSay hi to the guy for me!

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HmmHowAb.text: Hmm…\pHow about we try this like this…

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GotPCWor.text:
Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pDid you see?
We got the PC working!\pI've got a few things to show
CELIO here.\pCan you go out on a stroll or
something for a while more?

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SorryFor.text: I'm sorry for taking up so much of\nBILL's time.\pI'm also sorry for being such a \npoor host on your visit here.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillWeGo.text: BILL: What kept you so long?\nBeen out having a good time?\pWe got it done.\nThe PCs are up and running!

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioJob.text: CELIO: The job went incredibly\nquick.\pBILL is one amazing guy…

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillYouv.text: BILL: No, no! There was almost\nnothing left for me to do.\pCELIO, I have to hand it to you.\nYou've learned a lot.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillWeSh.text: BILL: Well, there you have it.\nI'm finished with the job.\lWe should head back to KANTO.\pCELIO, I'll be seeing you again.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPro.text: CELIO: {PLAYER}, I'm really sorry\nthat we sent you off alone today.\pI promise, I will show you around\nthese islands sometime.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioImM.text:
CELIO: Hello!
You look awfully busy as always.\pHow am I doing?\pWell, I'm modifying my Network
Machine.\pWhen I get done with the machine,
I hope you'll be first to use it,\l{PLAYER}.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCau.text:
CELIO: {PLAYER}, how have things
been for you?\pOh, is that right?
You've caught more POKéMON.\pDo you know what?
Maybe I can be useful to you.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullBeT.text:
I'm modifying the Network Machine
right now.\pI'm changing it so it can handle
trades over long distances.\pWhen I get finished, you'll be
trading for exotic POKéMON from\lTRAINERS far away.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeedsSpe.text: But, there is a slight catch.\pFor the link to work, the Machine\nneeds a special gemstone.\pIt's supposed to be on ONE ISLAND,\nbut I haven't found one yet.\pWho knows where it could be.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryingTo.text:
I was trying to find the gem
even while I was studying.\pAs a result, I've made no headway
in both my search and studies…\pIf I relied on BILL, I'm sure my
research would progress.\pBut this time, I want to try to do
things by myself.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MayIAskO.text: Thank you!\n{PLAYER}, you're simply amazing.\p… … …  … … …\pUm… May I ask one more giant favor\nof you?

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PleaseIN.text: It… It's not anything weird.\nPlease, I need your help.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AnotherG.text:
While I was studying gemstones,
I discovered something important.\pThere is another gem that forms
a pair with this RUBY.\pThat other gemstone is supposed to
be in the SEVII ISLANDS.\p{PLAYER}, please, I need you to go
find the other gem.\p{PLAYER}, may I have your ferry
PASS and the TOWN MAP?

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Returned.text: {PLAYER} returned the TRI-PASS and\nreceived the RAINBOW PASS.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Obtained.text: Obtained an extra page for the\nTOWN MAP!

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLetY.text: This is my own ferry PASS.\pIt will let you get to all the\nSEVII ISLANDS.\p{PLAYER}, please, I can't do\nit without your help.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThankYou.text:
CELIO: So this is the gem that
forms a pair with the RUBY…\p{PLAYER}, you've gone through a lot
to get this, didn't you?\pYou don't have to tell me. I know
it wasn't easy.\pThank you so much!\pNow it's my turn to work for you!
Please give me a little time.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LinkedUp.text: I did it!\nI linked up with LANETTE!

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManagedT.text:
{PLAYER}…
{PLAYER}, I did it!\pI've managed to link up with
TRAINERS in the HOENN region!\pFinally, the Network Machine is
fully operational!\p{PLAYER}, I owe it all to you!\pThanks to you, my dream came
true…

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishYouB.text: I…\nI'm not crying.\pThat's enough about me!\p{PLAYER}, you're going to keep\nlooking for exotic POKéMON, right?\pI wish you the best of luck!

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioHea.text: CELIO: Hello!\p{PLAYER}, I've been hearing rumors\nabout you.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsFir.text:
{PLAYER}, what's your favorite kind
of POKéMON?\pBILL is a POKéMANIAC, so he loves
every kind.\pApparently, the first one he caught
was an ABRA.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsHom.text:
By the way, {PLAYER}, you're from
PALLET TOWN, aren't you?\pI've heard that it's a quiet and
pleasant place.\pBILL's hometown is GOLDENROD CITY,
where his folks still live.\pI've heard that it's quite the
festive, bustling city.\pI'd like to go there one day.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCant.text: {PLAYER}, is there anything that\nyou can't stand?\pApparently, BILL simply can't\nstomach milk at all.

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CameFrom.text: Oh, you're a stranger here!\nHi! Where did you come from?\p…PALLET TOWN?\nI don't know it!

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Enormous.text: On this island, there's an enormous\nvolcano.\pIt hasn't erupted lately, so why\nnot enjoy a hike?

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishICou.text: I wish I could trade POKéMON with\nmy boyfriend who lives far away…

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedWi.text: I traded POKéMON with my boyfriend\nfar away!\pEveryone's saying that we can\nthank you and CELIO.\pSo, thank you!

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineU.text: Network Machine\nLink Level 0\p…POKéMON Storage System under\nadjustment…

OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineL.text: Network Machine\nLink Level 1\pLink established with the KANTO\nregion.
Network Machine\nLink Level 2\pLink established with the KANTO\nand HOENN regions.

OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraIntro.text: Lying back, rocked by the waves…\nIt's exquisite.

OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraPostBa.text: The sea is pleasantly warm in these\nparts.

OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_GoodThingsW.text: Good things get washed up by the\nocean current onto this beach.\pThat's why I often come here for\nsome beachcombing.

PalletTown_Text_OakGrassUnsafeNeedMon.text:
OAK: It's unsafe!
Wild POKéMON live in tall grass!\pYou need your own POKéMON for
your protection.\pI know!
Here, come with me!

PalletTown_Text_RaisingMonsToo.text: I'm raising POKéMON, too.\pWhen they get strong, they can\nprotect me.

PalletTown_Text_CanStoreItemsAndMonsInPC.text: Technology is incredible!\pYou can now store and recall items\nand POKéMON as data via PC.

PalletTown_Text_TownSign.text: PALLET TOWN\nShades of your journey await!

PalletTown_Text_OakLetMeSeePokedex.text: OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\nYou're back, are you?\pHow much have you filled in your\nPOKéDEX?\pMay I see it?\pLet's see…

PalletTown_Text_CaughtXPuttingInHonestEf.text: You've caught {STR_VAR_2}…\pHm, it looks as if you're putting\nin an honest effort.\pWhen you manage to fill it some\nmore, come show me, please.

PalletTown_Text_CaughtXImpressiveFollowM.text:
You've caught… {STR_VAR_2}!?
Now, this is impressive!\pThere's something I wanted to ask
of you, {PLAYER}.\pCome.
Follow me.

PalletTown_Text_OakYouEnjoyingTraveling.text:
OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!
You seem to be enjoying traveling.\pKnowing you, {PLAYER}, I can easily
imagine you going out to even more\lexotic locales.\pGood for you, good for you.
Hohoho.

PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_AllBoysL.text: MOM: …Right.\nAll boys leave home someday.\lIt said so on TV.\pOh, yes. PROF. OAK, next door, was\nlooking for you.

PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_AllGirls.text: MOM: …Right.\nAll girls dream of traveling.\lIt said so on TV.\pOh, yes. PROF. OAK, next door, was\nlooking for you.

PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShoul.text: MOM: {PLAYER}!\nYou should take a quick rest.

PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LookingG.text: MOM: Oh, good! You and your\nPOKéMON are looking great.\lTake care now!

PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MovieOnT.text: There's a movie on TV.\nFour boys are walking on railroad\ltracks.\p…I better go, too.
There's a movie on TV.\nA girl with her hair in pigtails is\lwalking up a brick road.\p…I better go, too.

PalletTown_PlayersHouse_2F_Text_PlayedWi.text: {PLAYER} played with the NES.\p…Okay!\nIt's time to go!

PalletTown_PlayersHouse_2F_Text_PressLRF.text: It's a posted notice…\pIf you're confused, ask for HELP!\nPress the L or R Button!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalNo.text: {RIVAL}: Hey! Gramps! No fair!\nWhat about me?

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGo.text: {RIVAL}: Heh, I don't need to be\ngreedy like you. I'm mature!\pGo ahead and choose, {PLAYER}!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalMy.text: {RIVAL}: My POKéMON looks a lot\ntougher than yours.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLe.text: {RIVAL}: Wait, {PLAYER}!\nLet's check out our POKéMON!\pCome on, I'll take you on!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGo.text: {RIVAL}: Okay! I'll make my\nPOKéMON battle to toughen it up!\p{PLAYER}! Gramps!\nSmell you later!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalWh.text: {RIVAL}: I almost forgot!\nWhat did you call me for?

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLe.text: {RIVAL}: All right, Gramps!\nLeave it all to me!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalTe.text:
{PLAYER}, I hate to say it, but you
won't be necessary for this.\pI know! I'll borrow a TOWN MAP
from my sis!\pI'll tell her not to lend you one,
{PLAYER}! Hahaha!\pDon't bother coming around to
my place after this!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakThre.text:
OAK: {RIVAL}?
Let me think…\pOh, that's right, I told you to
come! Just wait!\pHere, {PLAYER}.\pThere are three POKéMON here.\pHaha!\pThe POKéMON are held inside
these POKé BALLS.\pWhen I was young, I was a serious
POKéMON TRAINER.\pBut now, in my old age, I have
only these three left.\pYou can have one.
Go on, choose!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakBePa.text: OAK: Be patient, {RIVAL}.\nYou can have one, too!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakWhic.text: OAK: Now, {PLAYER}.\pInside those three POKé BALLS are\nPOKéMON.\pWhich one will you choose for\nyourself?

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoo.text: Ah! CHARMANDER is your choice.\nYou should raise it patiently.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you're claiming the\nFIRE POKéMON CHARMANDER?
Hm! SQUIRTLE is your choice.\nIt's one worth raising.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you've decided on the\nWATER POKéMON SQUIRTLE?
I see! BULBASAUR is your choice.\nIt's very easy to raise.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you want to go with\nthe GRASS POKéMON BULBASAUR?

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCanR.text: OAK: If a wild POKéMON appears,\nyour POKéMON can battle it.\pWith it at your side, you should be\nable to reach the next town.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakBatt.text: OAK: {PLAYER}, raise your young\nPOKéMON by making it battle.\pIt has to battle for it to grow.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHave.text:
OAK: Oh, {PLAYER}!
How is my old POKéMON?\pWell, it seems to be growing more
attached to you.\pYou must be talented as a POKéMON
TRAINER.\pWhat's that?
You have something for me?

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCust.text: Ah! \nIt's the custom POKé BALL!\pI had it on order.\nThank you!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHave.text: OAK: Oh, right!\nI have a request for you two.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakPoke.text: On the desk there is my invention,\nthe POKéDEX!\pIt automatically records data on\nPOKéMON you've seen or caught.\pIt's a high-tech encyclopedia!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCatc.text:
OAK: You can't get detailed data
on POKéMON by just seeing them.\pYou must catch them to obtain
complete data.\pSo, here are some tools for
catching wild POKéMON.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakExpl.text:
When a wild POKéMON appears,
it's fair game.\pJust throw a POKé BALL at it and
try to catch it!\pThis won't always work, however.\pA healthy POKéMON can escape.
You have to be lucky!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakComp.text:
To make a complete guide on all
the POKéMON in the world…\pThat was my dream!\pBut, I'm too old.
I can't get the job done.\pSo, I want you two to fulfill my
dream for me.\pGet moving, you two.\pThis is a great undertaking in
POKéMON history!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakMons.text: POKéMON around the world wait for\nyou, {PLAYER}!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakAdde.text:
Ah, {PLAYER}!
How is your POKéDEX shaping up?\p{RIVAL} has already caught some
POKéMON and added to the data.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let's have a look at
your POKéDEX.\p…What's the matter?
You've added no new data at all.\pI'll give you these, so do try a
little harder.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCome.text: OAK: Come see me sometime.\pAfter all, I want to know how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_BlankEn.text: It's like an encyclopedia, but the\npages are blank.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ThoseAr.text: Those are POKé BALLS.\nThey contain POKéMON!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_PressSt.text: Press START to open the MENU!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_SaveOpt.text: The SAVE option is on the MENU.\nUse it regularly.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_AllMonT.text: All POKéMON types have strong and\nweak points against others.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_EmailMe.text:
There's an e-mail message here.\p…\pFinally!
The ultimate TRAINERS of the\lPOKéMON LEAGUE are ready to\ltake on all comers!\pBring your best POKéMON and see
how you rate as a TRAINER!\pPOKéMON LEAGUE HQ
INDIGO PLATEAU\pPROF. OAK, please visit us!
…

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_StudyAs.text: I study POKéMON as PROF. OAK's\nAIDE.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_DaisyWi.text:
Hi, {PLAYER}. I bet you've become
good friends with your POKéMON.\pBy the way, did you know about
DAISY?\pIf you show DAISY your POKéMON,
she can tell how much it likes you.\pOccasionally, she will even groom
a POKéMON for you.\pThis is a secret, so please don't
tell anyone.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakIsGo.text: PROF. OAK is going to have his own\nradio show soon.\pThe program will be called PROF.\nOAK's POKéMON SEMINAR.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakIsAu.text: PROF. OAK may not look like much,\nbut he's the authority on POKéMON.\pMany POKéMON TRAINERS hold him in\nhigh regard.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakFavo.text: Ah, now this is excellent!\p{PLAYER}, I have another important\nfavor to ask of you.\pI need you to listen closely.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakSigh.text:
Recently, there have been sightings
of many rare POKéMON species.\pI'm talking about POKéMON that
have never been seen in KANTO.\pI would love to go see things for
myself, but I'm much too old.\pSince I can't do it, {PLAYER}, I'd
like you to go in my place.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalJu.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, I heard that!\pGramps, what's with favoring
{PLAYER} over me all the time?\pI went and collected more POKéMON,
and faster, too.\pYou should just let me handle
everything.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakNeed.text: OAK: I know, I know.\nOf course I need your help, too.\pNow, I need to see both your\nPOKéDEXES.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakNowT.text: … … …  … … …\p… … …  … … …\p…And that's done!\pNow these units can record data on\na lot more POKéMON.

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakMust.text:
Now, {PLAYER} and {RIVAL}!\pThis time, you really must work
towards filling your POKéDEXES.\pI urge you to make them the best
and the most complete of all time!\pTruly, this is a monumentally great
undertaking in POKéMON history!

PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalIl.text:
{RIVAL}: Gramps, calm down.
Don't get so excited.\pI'll get the POKéDEX completed,
don't you worry about a thing.\pI think I'll try looking around
ONE ISLAND first…\pAnyways, I'm outta here!

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HiBrothersAt.text: DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pMy brother, {RIVAL}, is out at\nGrandpa's LAB.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HeardYouBatt.text: DAISY: {PLAYER}, I heard you had\na battle against {RIVAL}.\pI wish I'd seen that!

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ErrandForGra.text: Grandpa asked you to run an\nerrand?\pGee, that's lazy of him.\nHere, this will help you.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontHaveSpac.text: You don't have space for this in\nyour BAG.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ExplainTownM.text: You can use the TOWN MAP to find\nout where you are, or check the\lnames of places.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_PleaseGiveMo.text: DAISY: Just like people, POKéMON\nare living things.\pWhen they get tired, please give\nthem a rest.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsBigMapOfK.text: It's a big map of the KANTO region.\nNow this would be useful!

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ShelvesCramm.text: The shelves are crammed full of\nbooks on POKéMON.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LikeMeToGroo.text:
DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!
Good timing.\pI'm about to have some tea.
Would you like to join me?\pOh, but look.
Your POKéMON are a little dirty.\pWould you like me to groom one?

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontNeedAnyG.text: You don't need any grooming done?\nOkay, we'll just have tea.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LookingNiceI.text: DAISY: Okay, I'll get it looking\nnice in no time.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ThereYouGoAl.text:
{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{STR_VAR_1} looks dreamily content…\p{COLOR RED}DAISY: There you go! All done.
{FONT_NORMAL}{STR_VAR_1} looks dreamily content…\p{FONT_FEMALE}DAISY: There you go! All done.
See? Doesn't it look nice?\pGiggle…
It's such a cute POKéMON.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CantGroomAnE.text: Oh, sorry. I honestly can't\ngroom an EGG.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_MayISeeFirst.text: DAISY: Your POKéMON grow to love\nyou if you raise them with love.\pFor example, {PLAYER}, may I see\nyour first POKéMON?

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CouldntLoveY.text: It couldn't possibly love you\nany more than it does now.\pYour POKéMON is happy beyond\nwords.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItLooksVeryH.text: It looks very happy.\pI wish {RIVAL} could see this and\nlearn something from it.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsQuiteFrie.text: It's quite friendly with you.\nKeep being good to it!

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsWarmingUp.text: It's warming up to you.\nTrust must be growing between you.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_NotFamiliarW.text: It's not quite familiar with you\nyet.\pPOKéMON are all quite wary when\nyou first get them.

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontLikeWayI.text: {PLAYER}, I don't like the way it\nglares at you.\pCould you try being a little nicer\nto it?

PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_WhyWouldMonH.text: …Um, it's not easy for me to say\nthis, but…\pIs there some reason why your\nPOKéMON would hate you so much?

Text_DreamEaterTeach.text:
Yawn!
I must have dozed off in the sun.\pI had this weird dream about
a DROWZEE eating my dream.\pAnd…
I learned how to eat dreams…\pOogh, this is too spooky!\pLet me teach it to a POKéMON so
I can forget about it!

Text_DreamEaterWhichMon.text: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nDREAM EATER?

PewterCity_Text_ClefairyCameFromMoon.text: CLEFAIRY came from the moon.\nThat's what the rumor is.\pThey appeared after MOON STONES\nfell on MT. MOON.

PewterCity_Text_BrockOnlySeriousTrainerH.text:
There aren't many serious POKéMON
TRAINERS here.\pThey're all like BUG CATCHERS,
you know, just hobbyists.\pBut PEWTER GYM's BROCK isn't like
that, not one bit.

PewterCity_Text_DidYouCheckOutMuseum.text: Did you check out the MUSEUM?

PewterCity_Text_WerentThoseFossilsAmazin.text: Weren't those fossils from MT. MOON\namazing?

PewterCity_Text_ThisIsTheMuseum.text: This is it, the MUSEUM.\pYou have to pay to get in, but it's\nworth it. See you around!

PewterCity_Text_DoYouKnowWhatImDoing.text: Psssst!\nDo you know what I'm doing?

PewterCity_Text_SprayingRepelToKeepWildM.text: I'm spraying REPEL to keep wild\nPOKéMON out of my garden!

PewterCity_Text_BrocksLookingForChalleng.text: You're a TRAINER, right?\pBROCK's looking for new\nchallengers. Follow me!

PewterCity_Text_GoTakeOnBrock.text: If you have the right stuff,\ngo take on BROCK!

PewterCity_Text_TrainerTipsEarningEXP.text: TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON that appear in battle,\nhowever briefly, earn EXP Points.

PewterCity_Text_CallPoliceIfInfoOnThieve.text: NOTICE!\pThieves have been stealing POKéMON\nfossils from MT. MOON.\pPlease call the PEWTER POLICE if\nyou have any information.

PewterCity_Text_GymSign.text: PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\lThe Rock-Solid POKéMON TRAINER!

PewterCity_Text_DefeatedBrockYouCanHaveT.text: あッれー！\nその　ジムバッジ‥‥\lすげえな　タケシに　かったのかよ！\pかんどう　したから\nおれの　たからもの　やるよ！

PewterCity_Text_BerriesInsideUseCarefull.text: なかには　きのみが　はいってるぜ\pやくに　たつ　きのみも\nはいって　いるから\lだいじに　つかって　くれよ！

PewterCity_Text_MonsWillUseHeldBerriesOn.text: ポケモンに　きのみを\nもたせて　おけば\lたたかっている　ときに\lかってに　つかって　くれるんだ\pキズぐすり　とか　どくけし　より\nてがるで　べんり　だろ？

PewterCity_Text_AskedToDeliverThis.text: I'm glad I caught up to you.\nI'm PROF. OAK's AIDE.\pI've been asked to deliver this,\nso here you go.

PewterCity_Text_ReceivedRunningShoesFrom.text: {PLAYER} received the\nRUNNING SHOES from the AIDE.

PewterCity_Text_ExplainRunningShoes.text: Press the B Button to run.\nBut only where there's room to run!

PewterCity_Text_MustBeGoingBackToLab.text: Well, I must be going back to\nthe LAB.\pBye-bye!

PewterCity_Text_RunningShoesLetterFromMo.text: There's a letter attached…\pDear {PLAYER},\pHere is a pair of RUNNING SHOES\nfor my beloved challenger.\pRemember, I'll always cheer for\nyou! Don't ever give up!\pFrom Mom

PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockIntro.text:
So, you're here. I'm BROCK.
I'm PEWTER's GYM LEADER.\pMy rock-hard willpower is evident
even in my POKéMON.\pMy POKéMON are all rock hard, and
have true-grit determination.\pThat's right - my POKéMON are all
the ROCK type!\pFuhaha! You're going to challenge
me knowing that you'll lose?\pThat's the TRAINER's honor that
compels you to challenge me.\pFine, then!
Show me your best!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDefeat.text:
I took you for granted, and so
I lost.\pAs proof of your victory, I confer
on you this…the official POKéMON\lLEAGUE BOULDERBADGE.\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} received the BOULDERBADGE
from BROCK!{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}\p{FONT_MALE}Just having the BOULDERBADGE makes
your POKéMON more powerful.\pIt also enables the use of the
move FLASH outside of battle.\pOf course, a POKéMON must know the
move FLASH to use it.

PewterCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM39.text:
A TM, Technical Machine, contains a
technique for POKéMON.\pUsing a TM teaches the move it
contains to a POKéMON.\pA TM is good for only one use.\pSo, when you use one, pick the
POKéMON carefully.\pAnyways…
TM39 contains ROCK TOMB.\pIt hurls boulders at the foe and
lowers its SPEED.

PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockPostBattle.text:
There are all kinds of TRAINERS in
this huge world of ours.\pYou appear to be very gifted as a
POKéMON TRAINER.\pSo let me make a suggestion.\pGo to the GYM in CERULEAN and test
your abilities.

PewterCity_Gym_Text_DontHaveRoomForThis.text: You don't have room for this.

PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamIntro.text: Stop right there, kid!\pYou're ten thousand light-years \nfrom facing BROCK!

PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamPostBattle.text: You're pretty hot.\n…But not as hot as BROCK!

PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetMeTakeYouToTheTop.text:
Hiya!
Do you want to dream big?\pDo you dare to dream of becoming
the POKéMON champ?\pI'm no TRAINER, but I can advise
you on how to win.\pLet me take you to the top!

PewterCity_Gym_Text_TryDifferentPartyOrd.text:
The first POKéMON out in a match is
at the left of the POKéMON LIST.\pBy changing the order of POKéMON,
you may gain an advantage.\pTry different orders to suit your
opponent's party.

PewterCity_Gym_Text_ItsFreeLetsGetHappen.text: It's a free service!\nLet's get happening!

PewterCity_Gym_Text_YoureChampMaterial.text: Just as I thought!\nYou're POKéMON champ material!

PewterCity_House1_Text_TradeMonsAreFinic.text:
Our POKéMON's an outsider, so it's
finicky and hard to handle.\pAn outsider is a POKéMON that you
get in a trade.\pIt grows fast, but it may ignore an
unskilled TRAINER in battle.\pIf only we had some BADGES…

PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsLearnTechniqu.text: POKéMON learn new techniques as\nthey grow.\pBut some moves must be taught to\nthem by people.

PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsEasierCatchIf.text:
A POKéMON becomes easier to 
catch if it has a status problem.\pSleep, poison, burn, or paralysis…
Those are all effective.\pBut catching POKéMON is never
a sure thing!

PewterCity_Mart_Text_BoughtWeirdFishFrom.text: A shady old guy sucked me into\nbuying this weird fish POKéMON!\pIt's totally weak and it cost ¥500!

PewterCity_Mart_Text_GoodThingsIfRaiseMo.text: Good things can happen if you raise\nPOKéMON diligently.\pEven the weak ones can surprise\nyou if you don't give up on them.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Its50YForChild.text: Yes, yes.\nIt's ¥50 for a child's ticket.\pWould you like to come in?

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DoYouKnowWhatA.text: You can't sneak in the back way!\nNice try, kid, but no.\pOh, whatever!\nDo you know what AMBER is?

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberContainsG.text: AMBER contains the genetic matter\nof ancient POKéMON.\pThere's a LAB somewhere trying to\nresurrect POKéMON from AMBER.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberIsFossili.text: AMBER is actually sap, that gooey\nstuff that oozes from trees.\pThe ancient sap fossilized over\ntime to become rock-hard AMBER.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PleaseGoAround.text: あちらへ　おまわりください

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ShouldBeGratef.text: I should be grateful for my long\nlife.\pNever did I think I would get to\nsee the bones of a dragon!

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WantYouToGetAm.text:
Ssh! Listen, I need to share a
secret with someone.\pI think that this chunk of AMBER
contains POKéMON DNA!\pIt would be a shattering scientific
breakthrough if POKéMON could be\lresurrected from it.\pBut, my colleagues just ignore
what I have to say.\pSo, I have a favor to ask!\pI want you to get this examined at
a POKéMON LAB somewhere.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ReceivedOldAmb.text: {PLAYER} received the OLD AMBER\nfrom the man.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DontHaveSpaceF.text: You don't have space for this.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WeHaveTwoFossi.text: We have two fossils of rare,\nprehistoric POKéMON on exhibit.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BeautifulPiece.text: There is a beautiful piece of\nAMBER in a clear gold color.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AerodactylFoss.text: AERODACTYL Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_KabutopsFossil.text: KABUTOPS Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.

Text_SeismicTossTeach.text:
The secrets of space…
The mysteries of earth…\pThere are so many things about
which we know so little.\pBut that should spur us to study
harder, not toss in the towel.\pThe only thing you should toss…\pWell, how about SEISMIC TOSS?
Should I teach that to a POKéMON?

Text_SeismicTossDeclined.text: Is that so?\nI'm sure you'll be back for it.

Text_SeismicTossWhichMon.text: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nSEISMIC TOSS?

Text_SeismicTossTaught.text: I hope you won't toss in the towel.\nKeep it up.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WhatsSpecialAb.text: MOON STONE, huh?\pWhat's so special about it?\nLooks like an ordinary rock to me.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BoughtColorTVF.text: July 20, 1969!\pHumankind first set foot on the\nmoon that day.\pI bought a color TV just so I\ncould watch that news.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_RunningSpaceEx.text: This month, we're running a space\nexhibit.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AskedDaddyToCa.text: I want a PIKACHU!\nIt's so cute!\pI asked my daddy to catch me one!

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PikachuSoonIPr.text: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_MeteoriteThatF.text: A meteorite that fell on MT. MOON.\nIt is thought to be a MOON STONE.

PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRoc.text: What!?\pTEAM ROCKET is at MT. MOON?\nHuh?\pI'm on the phone!\nScram!

PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WhenJig.text: Yawn!\pWhen JIGGLYPUFF sings, POKéMON get\ndrowsy…\p…Me, too…\nSnore…

PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trading.text: I really want a PIKACHU, so I'm\ntrading my CLEFAIRY for one.
I'm trading POKéMON with that kid\nthere.\pI had two PIKACHU, so I figured\nI might as well trade one.

PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_Intro.text:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pI hear OAK's taken a lot of
interest in you, child.\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_RematchIn.text:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pYou're the child that OAK's taken
under his wing, aren't you?\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_PostBattl.text: You win!\pI see what the old duff sees in\nyou now.\pI have nothing else to say.\nRun along now, child!

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Intro.text:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!\pThrough rigorous training, people
and POKéMON can become stronger\lwithout limit.\pI've lived and trained with my
fighting POKéMON!\lAnd that will never change!\p{PLAYER}!\pWe will grind you down with our
superior power!\pHoo hah!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_RematchInt.text:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!\pThrough rigorous training, people
and POKéMON can become stronger\lwithout limit.\pI've lived and trained with my
fighting POKéMON!\lAnd that will never change!\p{PLAYER}!\pWe will grind you down with our
superior power!\pHoo hah!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_PostBattle.text: My job is done.\nGo face your next challenge.

PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Intro.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI was looking forward to seeing
you, {PLAYER}.\pMy rival should be strong to keep
me sharp.\pWhile working on my POKéDEX, I
looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams
that would beat any POKéMON type.\pAnd now…\pI'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!\p{PLAYER}!
Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!

PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Rematch.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pYou came back, {PLAYER}!
Hahah, that is so great!\pMy rival should be strong to keep
me sharp.\pWhile working on my POKéDEX, I
looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams
that would beat any POKéMON type.\pAnd now…\pI'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!\p{PLAYER}!
Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!

PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat.text:
NO!
That can't be!\lYou beat me at my best!\pAfter all that work to become
the LEAGUE CHAMP?\pMy reign is over already?
It's not fair!

PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Victory.text:
はーはッ！
かった！　かった！　かった！\p{PLAYER}に　まける　ような
おれさま　では　なーい！\pま！　ポケモンの
てんさい　{RIVAL}さま　あいてに\lここまで　よく　がんばった！\pほめて　つかわす！
はーッ！　はーはッはッ！

PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBat.text:
Why?
Why did I lose?\pI never made any mistakes raising
my POKéMON…\pDarn it! You're the new POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION!\pAlthough I don't like to admit it…

PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakCong.text:
OAK: So, you've won!
Sincerely, congratulations!\pYou're the new POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\pYou've grown up so much since you
first left with {STR_VAR_1} to work\lon the POKéDEX.\p{PLAYER}, you have come of age!

PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakImDi.text:
OAK: {RIVAL}…
I'm disappointed in you.\pI came when I heard you'd beaten
the ELITE FOUR.\pBut, when I got here, you had
already lost!\p{RIVAL}, do you understand why
you lost?\pYou have forgotten to treat your
POKéMON with love and trust.\pWithout them, you will never
become a CHAMP again!

PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakPlay.text:
OAK: {PLAYER}.\pYou understand that your victory
was not just your own doing.\pThe bond you share with your
POKéMON is marvelous.\p{PLAYER}!
Come with me!

PokemonLeague_HallOfFame_Text_OakCongrat.text:
OAK: Er-hem!
Congratulations, {PLAYER}!\pThis floor is the POKéMON HALL OF
FAME.\pPOKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPIONS are
honored for their exploits here.\pTheir POKéMON are also recorded in
the HALL OF FAME.\p{PLAYER}!\pYou have worked hard to become
the new LEAGUE CHAMPION.\pCongratulations, {PLAYER}, you and
your POKéMON are HALL OF FAMERS!

PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Intro.text:
Ah! I've heard about you,
{PLAYER}!\pI lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon
TRAINER.\pYou know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.\pWell, are you ready to lose?\pYour LEAGUE challenge ends with
me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_RematchInt.text:
Ah!
So, you've returned, {PLAYER}!\pI lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon
TRAINER.\pYou know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.\pWell, are you ready to lose?\pYour LEAGUE challenge ends with
me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Defeat.text: That's it!\pI hate to admit it, but you are a\nPOKéMON master!

PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_PostBattle.text:
I still can't believe my dragons
lost to you, {PLAYER}.\pYou are now the POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\p…Or, you would have been, but
you have one more challenge left.\pThere is one more TRAINER to face!
His name is…\p{RIVAL}!\pHe beat the ELITE FOUR before
you.\pHe is the real POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION.

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Intro.text:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI am LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR.\pNo one can best me when it comes
to icy POKéMON.\pFreezing moves are powerful.\pYour POKéMON will be at my mercy
when they are frozen solid.\pHahaha!
Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_RematchI.text:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI, LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR,
have returned!\pYou know how it goes.
No one can best me when it comes\lto icy POKéMON.\pFreezing moves are powerful.\pYour POKéMON will be at my mercy
when they are frozen solid.\pHahaha!
Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_PostBatt.text: You're better than I thought.\nGo on ahead.\pYou only got a taste of the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE's power.

PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedIntro.text: Who are you?\nThere shouldn't be anyone here.

PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedPostBattle.text: A key? I don't know what you're\ntalking about.

PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonIntro.text: W-w-waah! You startled me!\nI thought you were a ghost.

PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonPostBattle.text: I was exploring here by myself,\nbut I feel spooked.\pI ought to go soon.

PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArnieIntro.text: I can't get out!\nThis old place is one big puzzle.

PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArniePostBattle.text: The switches here open and close\nalternating sets of doors.

PokemonMansion_1F_Text_NewMonDiscoveredI.text: Diary: July 5\nGuyana, South America\pA new POKéMON was discovered deep\nin the jungle.

PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ChristenedDiscove.text: Diary: July 10\nWe christened the newly discovered\lPOKéMON, MEW.

PokemonMansion_Text_PressSecretSwitchJP.text: ひみつの　スイッチが　ある！\pおして　みますか？

PokemonMansion_Text_LetsTryIt.text: おしてみよう！　‥ポチッとな

PokemonMansion_Text_GaveUpOnPressingSwit.text: おすのは　あきらめた

PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonPostBattle.text: I wonder where my partner went.

PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonPostBattle.text: So, you're stuck?\nTry jumping off over there!

PokemonMansion_1F_Text_MewGaveBirthToMew.text: Diary: Feb. 6\nMEW gave birth.\pWe named the newborn MEWTWO.

PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisPostBattle.text: You can find stuff lying around.\nThe residents must've left them.

PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanIntro.text: This place is ideal for a lab.\nLook at all this space.

PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanPostBattle.text: I like it here.\nIt's conducive to my studies.

PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_MewtwoIsFarTooPo.text: Diary: Sept. 1\nMEWTWO is far too powerful.\pWe have failed to curb its vicious\ntendencies…

PokemonTower_1F_Text_ErectedInMemoryOfDe.text: POKéMON TOWER was erected in the\nmemory of POKéMON that died.

PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsSo.text: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\nson.

PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsGi.text: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\ngirl.

PokemonTower_1F_Text_CameToPrayForDepart.text: I came to pray for my dearly\ndeparted CLEFAIRY.\pSniff!\nI'm awash in tears…

PokemonTower_1F_Text_SenseSpiritsUpToMis.text: I am a CHANNELER.\pThere are spirits up to mischief.\nI sense them high in the TOWER.

PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalIntro.text: {RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nWhat brings you here?\lIs your POKéMON dead?\pHey! It's alive!\pI can at least make them faint!\nLet's go!

PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalDefeat.text: What?\nYou stinker!\pI took it easy on you, too!

PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalVictory.text: {RIVAL}“あーあ‥！\nほんとに　くたばっちまったぞ！\lよわいなー！\lもっと　ちゃんと　そだてて　やれよ

PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalPostBattle.text:
How's your POKéDEX coming?
I just caught a CUBONE!\pI can't find the bigger MAROWAK.
Where could they be?\pI bet there aren't any left!\pWell, I better get going.
I've got a lot to accomplish,\lunlike you.\pSmell ya later!

PokemonTower_2F_Text_SilphScopeCouldUnma.text: Even we could not identify the\nwayward ghosts.\pA SILPH SCOPE might be able to\nunmask them.

PokemonTower_3F_Text_HopePostBattle.text: The ghosts can be identified by\nthe SILPH SCOPE.

PokemonTower_3F_Text_PatriciaPostBattle.text: The others above…\nThey must have been possessed.

PokemonTower_4F_Text_LaurelPostBattle.text: We can't determine the identity of\nthe ghosts…

PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyPostBattle.text: May the departed POKéMON rest in\npeace…

PokemonTower_5F_Text_RestHereInPurifiedS.text: Come, child!\nI have purified this space.\lYou can rest here.

PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaePostBattle.text: I fell to evil spirits despite my\ntraining in the mountains…

PokemonTower_5F_Text_PurifiedZoneMonsFul.text: Entered the purified and protected\nzone.\p{PLAYER}'s POKéMON were fully\nhealed.

PokemonTower_6F_Text_EmiliaPostBattle.text: My hair didn't fall out!\nIt was a malevolent spirit!

PokemonTower_6F_Text_GhostWasCubonesMoth.text: The ghost was the restless spirit\nof CUBONE's mother!

PokemonTower_6F_Text_MothersSpiritWasCal.text: The mother's spirit was calmed.\pIt departed to the afterlife…

PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: What do you want?\nWhy are you here?

PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.text: I'm not going to forget this!

PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro.text:
This old guy marched right up to
our HIDEOUT.\pThen, he starts ranting about how
TEAM ROCKET's abusing POKéMON.\pSo, we're just talking it over as
adults.

PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.text: POKéMON are only good for making\nmoney. Why not use them?\pYou stay out of our business!

PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle.text: You're not getting away with this!

PokemonTower_7F_Text_MrFujiThankYouFollo.text:
MR. FUJI: Heh?
You came to save me?\pThank you. But, I came here of my
own free will.\pI came to calm the spirit of
CUBONE's mother.\pI think MAROWAK's spirit has
finally left us.\pI must thank you for your kind
concern.\pFollow me to my home, POKéMON
HOUSE, at the foot of this tower.

RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyIntro.text: This tunnel goes a long way, kid!

RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyPostBattle.text: Watch for ONIX.\nThey appear only occasionally.\pHigh-level ones can put the\nsqueeze on you!

RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverDefeat.text: Ease up!\nWhat am I doing?\lWhich way is out?

RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverPostBattle.text: That sleeping POKéMON on ROUTE 12\nforced me to take this detour.

RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasIntro.text: Outsiders like you need to show me\nsome respect!

RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonPostBattle.text: Oh well, I'll get a ZUBAT as I go!

RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahIntro.text: Eek!\pDon't try anything funny in the\ndark!

RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahPostBattle.text: I saw a MACHOP in this tunnel.

RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaIntro.text: I came this far looking for wild\nPOKéMON.

RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaPostBattle.text: You looked cute and harmless.\nWas I ever wrong!

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaIntro.text: Do you know how you can avoid\ngetting lost in the mountains?\pYou can bend twigs as trail\nmarkers.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyPostBattle.text: I go for power because I hate\nthinking.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperIntro.text: You have a POKéDEX?\nI want one, too.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperPostBattle.text: When you finish your POKéDEX,\ncan I have it?

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SteveIntro.text: Um… Do you know about POKéMON\ncosplay?

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_StevePostBattle.text: POKéMON cosplay is dressing up as\nPOKéMON for fun.\pCLEFAIRY is a favorite.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenIntro.text: My POKéMON techniques will leave\nyou crying!

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenPostBattle.text: In mountains, you'll often find\nROCK-type POKéMON.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaIntro.text: I don't often come here, but I will\nbattle you.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaPostBattle.text: I like tiny POKéMON.\nBig ones are too scary!

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricIntro.text: Hit me with your best shot!

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricPostBattle.text: I'll raise my POKéMON to beat\nyours, kid.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonIntro.text: I draw illustrations of POKéMON\nwhen I'm home.

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonPostBattle.text: I'm an artist, not a fighter.\nI'll go home to draw.

RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: Who are you?\nHow did you get here?

RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.text: Blast it… You're dissing TEAM\nROCKET, aren't you?

RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro.text: You broke into TEAM ROCKET's\noperation? What nerve!

RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.text: You're not going to get away with\nthis, brat!

RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle.text: SILPH SCOPE? Humph!\nI don't know where it is.

RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle.text: Okay, I'll talk…\nTake the elevator to see my BOSS.

RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro.text: Are you lost, you little mouse?

RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle.text: Uh-oh, that ruckus somehow opened\nthe door!

RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntIntro.text: BOSS said you can see ghosts with\nthe SILPH SCOPE.

RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntPostBattle.text: The TEAM ROCKET HQ has four\nunderground floors.\pThink you can reach the BOSS?

RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: Stop meddling in TEAM ROCKET's\naffairs or else!

RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.text: SILPH SCOPE?\nOh, that machine the BOSS stole.\pIt's here somewhere.

RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2Intro.text: We got word from upstairs that you\nwere coming!

RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.text: Go ahead and go!\pBut you can't run the elevator\nwithout the LIFT KEY.

RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniIntro.text:
So! I must say, I am impressed you
got here.\pTEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from
around the world.\pThey're important tools for keeping
our criminal enterprise going.\pI am the leader, GIOVANNI!\pFor your insolence, you will feel a
world of pain!

RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniPostBattl.text: I see that you raise POKéMON with\nutmost care.\pA child like you would never\nunderstand what I hope to achieve.\pI shall step aside this time!\pI hope we meet again…

RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2Intro.text: I know you!\nYou ruined our plans at MT. MOON!

RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.text: Do you have something against TEAM\nROCKET?

RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3Intro.text: How can you not see the beauty of\nour evil?

RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: The elevator doesn't work?\nWho has the LIFT KEY?

RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.text: Oh, no!\nI dropped the LIFT KEY!

RocketHideout_Elevator_Text_AppearsToNee.text: It appears to need a key.

Route1_Text_WorkAtPokeMartTakeSample.text:
Hi!
I work at a POKéMON MART.\pIt's part of a convenient chain
selling all sorts of items.\pPlease, visit us in VIRIDIAN CITY.\pI know, I'll give you a sample.
Here you go!

Route1_Text_ComeSeeUsIfYouNeedPokeBalls.text: Please come see us if you need\nPOKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.

Route1_Text_PutPotionAway.text: {PLAYER} put the POTION away in\nthe BAG's ITEMS POCKET.

Route1_Text_CanJumpFromLedges.text: See those ledges along the road?\pIt's a bit scary, but you can jump\nfrom them.\pYou can get back to PALLET TOWN\nquicker that way.

Route10_Text_MarkIntro.text: Wow, you came all the way here?\nMaybe you're a POKéMANIAC, too?\lWant to see my collection?

Route10_Text_MarkPostBattle.text: I have more rare POKéMON at home!

Route10_Text_HermanIntro.text: Hi, kid!\nWant to see my POKéMON?

Route10_Text_HermanPostBattle.text: I don't like you.\nI don't like anyone better than me!

Route10_Text_HeidiIntro.text: I've been out at a POKéMON GYM\na few times.\p…But I always lose.

Route10_Text_HeidiPostBattle.text: I noticed some POKéMANIACS\nprowling around.\pCan you imagine? Them?\nUp here in the mountains?

Route10_Text_TrentPostBattle.text: I feel bloated on mountain air!

Route10_Text_CarolIntro.text: I'm feeling a bit faint.\nI haven't hiked in some time.

Route10_Text_CarolDefeat.text: I'm too tired.\nI wasn't up for it.

Route10_Text_CarolPostBattle.text: The POKéMON here in the mountains\nare so chunky…\pI wish there were pink POKéMON\nwith a floral pattern!

Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryTypeS.text: The types of POKéMON match up\ndifferently with each other.\pEvery type is stronger than some\ntypes and weaker than others.

Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NuggetUsel.text: A NUGGET is totally useless.\nSo I sold it for ¥5000.

Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HeardGhost.text: I heard that ghosts haunt\nLAVENDER TOWN.

Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GiveEverst.text:
Oh… {PLAYER}!
I've been looking for you!\pIt's me, one of the ever-present
AIDES to PROF. OAK.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on twenty species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward from PROF. OAK.\pHe entrusted me with this
EVERSTONE.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
twenty kinds of POKéMON?

Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatHereY.text: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!

Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ExplainEve.text:
Making POKéMON evolve certainly
can add to the POKéDEX.\pHowever, at times, you may not
want a certain POKéMON to evolve.\pIn that case, give the EVERSTONE
to that POKéMON.\pIt will prevent evolution according
to the PROFESSOR.

Route11_Text_HugoPostBattle.text: POKéMON is life!\nAnd to live is to play games!

Route11_Text_JasperPostBattle.text: You can't be a coward in the world\nof POKéMON!

Route11_Text_EddiePostBattle.text: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.

Route11_Text_BraxtonPostBattle.text: Spread the word to save energy!

Route11_Text_DillonIntro.text: I just became a TRAINER.\nBut, I think I can win.

Route11_Text_DillonDefeat.text: My POKéMON couldn't win…\nHaven't they grown enough?

Route11_Text_DirkPostBattle.text: You were just lucky, that's all.

Route11_Text_YasuIntro.text: I'm the best in my class.\nI train every morning.

Route11_Text_YasuDefeat.text: Darn!\nMy POKéMON need to be stronger!

Route11_Text_YasuPostBattle.text: There's a fat POKéMON that comes\ndown from the mountains.\pI bet it'd be strong if you can\ncatch it.

Route11_Text_BerniePostBattle.text: Well, better get back to work.

Route11_Text_DaveIntro.text: I raised my POKéMON carefully.\nThey should be ready by now!

Route11_Text_DavePostBattle.text: Tch…\nI better go find stronger ones!

Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_BagIsFull.text: {PLAYER}{KUN}の　バッグ\nいっぱい　みたい　だね

Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_ManInLavend.text:
Don't you think it's hard to think
up good names for POKéMON?\pEspecially if you've caught a
whole bunch?\pIn LAVENDER TOWN, there's a man
who rates POKéMON nicknames.\pHe can even help you rename your
POKéMON, too.

Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_RockTunnelT.text: If you're aiming to reach LAVENDER\nTOWN, take ROCK TUNNEL.\pYou can get to ROCK TUNNEL from\nCERULEAN CITY.

Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_GiveItemfin.text:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with the
{STR_VAR_2} for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
{STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?

Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYo.text: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!

Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainItem.text:
There are items on the ground that
may be hidden from view.\pUse the ITEMFINDER to detect any
hidden items close to you.\pThe machine is a bit limited.
It can't pinpoint item locations.\pWhat it does is show the direction
where the item is.\pUse it to get your bearings, then
search the suspect area by hand.

Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_BigMonAslee.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pA big POKéMON is asleep on a road!

Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_WhatABreath.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pWhat a breathtaking view!

Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_RockTunnelG.text:
Let's see what the binoculars have
to show…\pTo get to LAVENDER TOWN from
CERULEAN CITY…\pROCK TUNNEL appears to be a good
route to take.

Route12_Text_MonSprawledOutInSlumber.text: A POKéMON is sprawled out in\na deep and comfortable slumber.

Text_SnorlaxWokeUp.text: SNORLAX woke up!\pIt attacked in a grumpy rage!

Text_SnorlaxReturnedToMountains.text: SNORLAX calmed down.\nIt gave a huge yawn…\lAnd returned to the mountains.

Text_WantToUsePokeFlute.text: Want to use the POKé FLUTE?

Route12_Text_ChipIntro.text: Be patient.\nFishing is a waiting game.

Route12_Text_ChipPostBattle.text: With a better ROD, I could catch\nbetter POKéMON…

Route12_Text_JustinIntro.text: I'm searching for a MOON STONE.\nHave you found one?

Route12_Text_JustinPostBattle.text: I could have made my POKéMON\nevolve with a MOON STONE.\pI would have won then, I bet.

Route12_Text_LucaIntro.text: Electricity is my specialty.\pI don't know a thing about POKéMON\nof the sea, though.

Route12_Text_LucaPostBattle.text: Water conducts electricity, so you\nshould zap sea POKéMON.

Route12_Text_HankPostBattle.text: I guess you get to be good at\nwhat you like.\pWell, you beat me at POKéMON,\nbut you can't top me at fishing.

Route12_Text_ElliotIntro.text: I love fishing, don't get me wrong.\pBut it'd be best if I also had more\nwork.

Route12_Text_ElliotPostBattle.text: It's all right.\nLosing doesn't bug me anymore.

Route12_Text_AndrewIntro.text: What's catching?\pYou never know what you could\ncatch!

Route12_Text_AndrewPostBattle.text: What, MAGIKARP?\pI catch them all the time, sure.\nBut, boy are they wimpy.

Route12_Text_JesIntro.text: JES: If I win, I'm going to\npropose to GIA.

Route12_Text_JesDefeat.text: JES: Oh, please, why couldn't you\nlet us win?

Route12_Text_JesPostBattle.text: JES: Oh, GIA, forgive me,\nmy love!

Route12_Text_JesNotEnoughMons.text: JES: GIA and I, we'll be\ntogether forever.\pWe won't battle unless you have\ntwo POKéMON of your own.

Route12_Text_GiaIntro.text: GIA: Hey, JES…\pIf we win, I'll marry you!

Route12_Text_GiaPostBattle.text: GIA: JES, you silly!\nYou ruined this!

Route12_Text_GiaNotEnoughMons.text: GIA: I can't bear to battle\nwithout my JES!\pDon't you have one more POKéMON?

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoYouLikeToFis.text: I'm the FISHING GURU's younger\nbrother.\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TakeThisAndFis.text: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_ReceivedSuperR.text: {PLAYER} received a SUPER ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU's brother.

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_IfYouCatchBigM.text:
Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.\pFrom the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend.\pNow, I have a request.\pIf you catch a big MAGIKARP 
with that ROD, I want to see it.\pAs much as I love to fish, I also
love seeing gigantic MAGIKARP.

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TryFishingBrin.text:
Hello there, {PLAYER}!
Have you been fishing?\pTry fishing with the SUPER ROD in
any body of water.\pYou'll find different POKéMON in
different places.\pOh, and don't forget to bring me
gigantic MAGIKARP.

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_OhMagikarpAllo.text: Oh? {PLAYER}?\nWhy, if it isn't a MAGIKARP!\pAllow me to see it, quick!

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_WhoaXInchesTak.text:
… … …Whoa!
{STR_VAR_2} inches!\pYou have a rare appreciation for
the fine, poetic aspects of fishing!\pYou must take this.
I insist!

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_LookForwardToG.text: I'll look forward to seeing greater\nrecords from you!

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HuhXInchesSame.text: Huh?\n{STR_VAR_2} inches?\pThis is the same size as the one\nI saw before.

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HmmXInchesDoes.text: Hmm…\nThis one is {STR_VAR_2} inches long.\pIt doesn't measure up to the\n{STR_VAR_3}-inch one you brought before.

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoesntLookLike.text: Uh… That doesn't look much like\na MAGIKARP.

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_NoRoomForGift.text: Oh, no!\pI had a gift for you, but you have\nno room for it.

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_MostGiganticMa.text: The most gigantic MAGIKARP\nI have ever witnessed…\p{STR_VAR_3} inches!

Route12_FishingHouse_Text_BlankChartOfSo.text: It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.

Route12_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_LookoutSpo.text: There's a lookout spot upstairs.\nThe view is magnificent.

Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TakeTMDont.text: My POKéMON's ashes are stored in\nPOKéMON TOWER.\pYou can have this TM.\nI don't need it anymore…
My POKéMON's ashes are stored in\nPOKéMON TOWER.\pYou can have this TM.\nI don't need it anymore…

Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainTM2.text: TM27 is a move called RETURN…\pIf you treat your POKéMON good,\nit will return your love by working\lits hardest in battle.

Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_DontHaveRo.text: You don't have room for this.

Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TheresManF.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere's a man fishing!

Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ItsPokemon.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt's POKéMON TOWER!

Route13_Text_SebastianIntro.text: My bird POKéMON want to battle\nwith you!

Route13_Text_SebastianPostBattle.text: My POKéMON look happy even though\nthey lost.

Route13_Text_SusieIntro.text: I'm told I'm good for a kid.

Route13_Text_SusiePostBattle.text: I want to become a good TRAINER.\nI'll train hard, just watch.

Route13_Text_ValeriePostBattle.text: You got those BADGES from GYM\nLEADERS. I know!

Route13_Text_GwenIntro.text: My cute POKéMON wish to make your\nacquaintance.

Route13_Text_GwenPostBattle.text: You have to make POKéMON battle\nto toughen them up.

Route13_Text_AlmaIntro.text: I found CARBOS in a cave once\nwhile I was spelunking.

Route13_Text_AlmaDefeat.text: Oh, too bad!\nI just messed up!

Route13_Text_AlmaPostBattle.text: CARBOS boosted the SPEED of my\nPOKéMON.

Route13_Text_PerryIntro.text: I'm not going to lose.\nNot when the wind's blowing my way!

Route13_Text_PerryPostBattle.text: I'm beat.\nI guess I'll FLY home.

Route13_Text_LolaIntro.text: Sure, I'll play with you, sweetie.

Route13_Text_LolaPostBattle.text: I wonder which is stronger, male or\nfemale POKéMON?

Route13_Text_SheilaIntro.text: Do you want to battle some\nPOKéMON with me?

Route13_Text_SheilaPostBattle.text: I don't know anything about\nPOKéMON actually.\pThe ones I use… I picked them\nfor their looks!

Route13_Text_RobertIntro.text: I always go with bird POKéMON.\nI've dedicated myself to them.

Route13_Text_RobertPostBattle.text: I wish I could fly like PIDGEY and\nPIDGEOTTO…

Route13_Text_LookToLeftOfThatPost.text: TRAINER TIPS\pLook, look!\nLook to the left of that post!

Route13_Text_SelectToSwitchItems.text: TRAINER TIPS\pUse SELECT to switch items in the\nITEMS window.

Route14_Text_CarterIntro.text: You need to use TMs to teach good\nmoves to POKéMON.

Route14_Text_CarterPostBattle.text: You have some HMs, right? POKéMON\ncan't forget those moves easily.

Route14_Text_MitchIntro.text: My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle.

Route14_Text_MitchPostBattle.text: My bird POKéMON need to learn\nbetter moves.

Route14_Text_BeckIntro.text: They have TMs on sale at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE.\pTMs aren't really rare, but not\nmany people have HMs.

Route14_Text_BeckPostBattle.text: Try teaching POKéMON a move that's\nthe same type as it.\pThat apparently boosts the power\nof the move.

Route14_Text_MarlonIntro.text: Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky!

Route14_Text_MarlonPostBattle.text: Bird POKéMON are my one true love.\nI don't want to raise anything else.

Route14_Text_DonaldIntro.text: Have you heard the legend of the\nwinged mirages?

Route14_Text_DonaldPostBattle.text: Well, the winged mirages are the\nlegendary bird POKéMON.\pThere are three of them: ARTICUNO,\nZAPDOS, and MOLTRES.

Route14_Text_BennyIntro.text: I'm not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!

Route14_Text_BennyPostBattle.text: Winning, losing… It's insignificant\nunder this huge sky.

Route14_Text_LukasIntro.text: C'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!

Route14_Text_LukasPostBattle.text: What, what, what?\nWhat do you want still?

Route14_Text_IsaacIntro.text: I need to burn some time.\nShut up and battle.

Route14_Text_IsaacPostBattle.text: Raising POKéMON is a drag, man.

Route14_Text_GeraldIntro.text: We ride out here because of the\nwide-open spaces.

Route14_Text_GeraldPostBattle.text: It's cool you made your POKéMON so\nstrong.\pMight is right!\nAnd you know it!

Route14_Text_MalikPostBattle.text: You know who'd win, you and me\none-on-one!

Route14_Text_KiriIntro.text: KIRI: JAN, let's try really,\nreally hard together.

Route14_Text_KiriPostBattle.text: KIRI: Did we lose because of me?

Route14_Text_KiriNotEnoughMons.text: KIRI: We can battle if you have\ntwo POKéMON.

Route14_Text_JanIntro.text: JAN: KIRI, here we go!\nWe have to try hard!

Route14_Text_JanPostBattle.text: JAN: KIRI, don't cry!\nWe'll just try harder next time.

Route14_Text_JanNotEnoughMons.text: JAN: You want to battle?\nYou don't have enough POKéMON.

Route15_Text_KindraIntro.text: I just got some POKéMON in trades.\nCan I try them out on you?

Route15_Text_KindraPostBattle.text: You can't change the nickname of\nany POKéMON you get in a trade.\pOnly the Original TRAINER can get\nthe nickname changed.

Route15_Text_BeckyIntro.text: You look gentle, so I think I can\nbeat you.\pI'll give it a go!

Route15_Text_BeckyPostBattle.text: I'm afraid of BIKERS. They look so\nugly and mean!

Route15_Text_EdwinIntro.text: When I whistle, I can summon bird\nPOKéMON.

Route15_Text_EdwinPostBattle.text: Maybe I'm not cut out for battles.\nI'm not the right type, I guess.

Route15_Text_ChesterIntro.text: Hmm? My birds are shivering!\nYou're good, aren't you?

Route15_Text_ChesterPostBattle.text: This is so obvious, you should know\nthis, but…\pMoves like EARTHQUAKE and FISSURE\nhave no effect on bird POKéMON.

Route15_Text_GraceIntro.text: Oh, you're a little cutie!\nSo like a darling POKéMON!

Route15_Text_GracePostBattle.text: I forgive you.\nI can take it.\lI'm a big girl now.

Route15_Text_OliviaIntro.text: I raise POKéMON for protection\nbecause I live alone.

Route15_Text_OliviaDefeat.text: POKéMON isn't about winning or\nlosing for me.

Route15_Text_OliviaPostBattle.text: I love having my POKéMON greet me\nwhen I get home.\pIt's so reassuring.

Route15_Text_ErnestIntro.text: Hey, kid! C'mon!\nI just got these off some loser!

Route15_Text_ErnestPostBattle.text: Life's too short.\nIt's cool to live as an outlaw.\lTEAM ROCKET RULES!

Route15_Text_AlexIntro.text: Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!

Route15_Text_AlexPostBattle.text: I was just joking about the money.\nDon't take me all serious.

Route15_Text_CeliaPostBattle.text: I trade POKéMON with my friends\nall the time.

Route15_Text_YazminIntro.text: Want to play with my POKéMON?

Route15_Text_YazminPostBattle.text: I'll go train with weaker people.

Route15_Text_MyaIntro.text: MYA: You're perfect.\nHelp me train my little brother?

Route15_Text_MyaDefeat.text: MYA: RON, you have to focus!\nConcentrate on what you're doing!

Route15_Text_MyaPostBattle.text: MYA: Okay, we'll turn it up.\nI'll add to our training menu!

Route15_Text_MyaNotEnoughMons.text: MYA: Do you want to challenge us?\nYou'll need two POKéMON, though.

Route15_Text_RonIntro.text: RON: My sister gets scary when we\nlose.

Route15_Text_RonDefeat.text: RON: Oh, no, no…\nSis, I'm sorry!

Route15_Text_RonPostBattle.text: RON: Oh, bleah…\nI wish I had a nice sister…

Route15_Text_RonNotEnoughMons.text: RON: Did you want to battle with\nmy sister and me?\pYou need two POKéMON, then.

Route15_WestEntrance_1F_Text_OaksAideCam.text: Are you the kid who's working on\na POKéDEX?\pPROF. OAK's AIDE came by here.

Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GiveItemIfC.text:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with the
{STR_VAR_2} for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
{STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?

Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYo.text: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!

Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainExpS.text: EXP. SHARE is an item to be held\nby a POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON will receive a share\nof the EXP. Points without having\lto battle.

Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_LargeShinin.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pA large, shining bird is flying\ntoward the sea.

Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_SmallIsland.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt looks like a small island on\nthe horizon!

Route16_Text_LaoPostBattle.text: We like just hanging here.\nWhat's it to you?

Route16_Text_KojiPostBattle.text: Forget it, who needs your BIKE!

Route16_Text_LukeIntro.text: Come out and play, little mouse!

Route16_Text_LukePostBattle.text: I hate losing!\nGet out of my face!

Route16_Text_HideoPostBattle.text: We'll always be hanging around here\neven if you don't like it.\pYou can detour to VERMILION from\nFUCHSIA going along the coast.

Route16_Text_CamronIntro.text: I'm feeling hungry and mean!\nI need a punching bag!

Route16_Text_CamronPostBattle.text: If I'm going to have POKéMON, they\nmay as well be ferocious.\pI'd use them to leave my enemies\nin tatters.

Route16_Text_RubenIntro.text: Hey, there!\nLet's have ourselves a good time!

Route16_Text_RubenPostBattle.text: I get my kicks by harassing people\nwith my stinking POKéMON.\pThey're great for startling people.\nAnd, they bite, too.

Route16_Text_MonSprawledOutInSlumber.text: A POKéMON is sprawled out in\na deep and comfortable slumber.

Route16_Text_JedIntro.text: JED: Our love knows no bounds.\nWe're in love and we show it!

Route16_Text_JedDefeat.text: JED: Oh, no!\nMy love has seen me as a loser!

Route16_Text_JedPostBattle.text: JED: Listen, LEA.\nYou need to focus less on me.

Route16_Text_JedNotEnoughMons.text: JED: You have just one POKéMON?\nIs there no love in your heart?

Route16_Text_LeaIntro.text: LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of\nour love scares me.

Route16_Text_LeaDefeat.text: LEA: Ohh! But JED looks cool\neven in a loss!

Route16_Text_LeaPostBattle.text: LEA: Ehehe, I'm sorry.\nJED is so cool.

Route16_Text_LeaNotEnoughMons.text: LEA: Oh, you don't have two\nPOKéMON with you?\pDoesn't it feel lonely for you or\nyour POKéMON?

Route16_House_Text_FoundMySecretRetreat.text: Oh, dear.\nYou've found my secret retreat.\pPlease don't tell anyone I'm here.\nI'll make it up to you with this!

Route16_House_Text_ExplainHM02.text: HM02 is FLY.\nIt's a wonderfully convenient move.\pPlease, put it to good use.

Route16_House_Text_DontHaveAnyRoomForThi.text: You don't have any room for this.

Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_NoPedestri.text: No pedestrians are allowed on\nCYCLING ROAD!

Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_CyclingRoa.text: CYCLING ROAD is a downhill course\nby the sea. It's a great ride.

Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_OnBikeRide.text: I'm on a relaxing ride on my new\nbike with my girlfriend.

Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_RidingToge.text: We're going riding together on our\nnew bikes.

Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ItsCeladon.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt's the CELADON DEPT. STORE!

Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_LongPathOv.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere's a long path over water far\naway.

Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_GiveAmulet.text:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on 40 species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with an
AMULET COIN for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
40 kinds of POKéMON?

Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereY.text: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!

Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedAm.text: {PLAYER} received the AMULET COIN\nfrom the AIDE.

Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainAmu.text: An AMULET COIN is an item to be\nheld by a POKéMON.\pIf the POKéMON appears in a winning\nbattle, you will earn more money.

Route17_Text_RaulIntro.text: There's no getting rich quick in\nbattling kids.

Route17_Text_RaulPostBattle.text: You can find good stuff lying\naround on CYCLING ROAD.\pThere's good money in picking them\nup and selling them.

Route17_Text_IsaiahIntro.text: I'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo.\nCome on!

Route17_Text_BillyIntro.text: We're BIKERS!\nWe rule the roads, man!

Route17_Text_NikolasPostBattle.text: I got my VOLTORB at the abandoned\nPOWER PLANT.

Route17_Text_ZeekIntro.text: I leveled up my POKéMON, but it\nwon't evolve. Why?

Route17_Text_ZeekPostBattle.text: Maybe some POKéMON need element\nSTONES to evolve.

Route17_Text_JamalPostBattle.text: I'm sure I lost weight there!

Route17_Text_CoreyPostBattle.text: Be ready to fight for your beliefs!

Route17_Text_JaxonPostBattle.text: The slope makes it hard to steer.

Route17_Text_WilliamPostBattle.text: I need to catch a few z's!

Route17_Text_WatchOutForDiscardedItems.text: It's a notice.\pWatch out for discarded items.

Route17_Text_SameSpeciesGrowDifferentRat.text: TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON are unique.\pEven POKéMON of the same species\nand level grow at different rates.

Route17_Text_PressBToStayInPlace.text: TRAINER TIPS\pPress the B Button to stay in place\nwhile on a slope.

Route17_Text_DontThrowGameThrowBalls.text: It's a notice!\pDon't throw the game, throw POKé\nBALLS instead!

Route18_Text_WiltonIntro.text: I always check every grassy area\nfor new POKéMON.

Route18_Text_WiltonPostBattle.text: I wish I had a BIKE!

Route18_Text_RamiroIntro.text: Kurukkoo!\nHow do you like my birdcall?

Route18_Text_RamiroPostBattle.text: I collect sea POKéMON on weekends\nbecause the sea is so close.

Route18_Text_JacobIntro.text: This is my turf!\nGet out of here!

Route18_Text_JacobPostBattle.text: This is my fave area for catching\nPOKéMON.

Route18_EastEntrance_1F_Text_NeedBicycle.text: You need a BICYCLE to go out on\nCYCLING ROAD!

Route18_EastEntrance_1F_Text_CyclingRoad.text: CYCLING ROAD is all uphill from\nhere.

Route18_EastEntrance_2F_Text_PalletTownI.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pPALLET TOWN is in the west.

Route18_EastEntrance_2F_Text_PeopleSwimm.text: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere are people swimming.

Route19_Text_RichardIntro.text: I have to exercise and warm up\nbefore going out for a swim.

Route19_Text_RichardPostBattle.text: Thanks, kid!\nI'm ready for a swim.

Route19_Text_ReeceIntro.text: Wait! Slow down!\nYou'll have a heart attack!

Route19_Text_ReecePostBattle.text: Watch out for TENTACOOL.\nThey sting so painfully.

Route19_Text_MatthewPostBattle.text: I can beat even marine POKéMON\nat swimming.

Route19_Text_DouglasPostBattle.text: I see a couple of islands over\nyonder!

Route19_Text_DavidIntro.text: I tried diving for POKéMON, but it\nwas a no-go.

Route19_Text_DavidPostBattle.text: I guess you have to fish for sea\nPOKéMON.

Route19_Text_TonyIntro.text: I look at the sea to forget all\nthe bad things that happened.

Route19_Text_TonyPostBattle.text: I'm looking at the sea to forget\nthe bad thing that happened!

Route19_Text_AnyaIntro.text: Oh, I just love your ride!\nCan I have it if I win?

Route19_Text_AnyaPostBattle.text: It's still a long way to go to\nSEAFOAM ISLANDS…\pI want to go back to FUCHSIA…

Route19_Text_AlicePostBattle.text: My boyfriend wanted to swim to\nSEAFOAM ISLANDS.

Route19_Text_AxlePostBattle.text: M-my legs! They cramped up!\nGlub, glub…

Route19_Text_ConnieIntro.text: I swam here with my friends…\nI'm tired…

Route19_Text_ConniePostBattle.text: If I were to ride a POKéMON on\nthe sea, I'd like a LAPRAS.\pLAPRAS is so big, I bet it\nwould keep me dry on water.

Route19_Text_LiaIntro.text: LIA: I'm looking after my brother.\nHe just became a TRAINER.

Route19_Text_LiaDefeat.text: LIA: That's no way to treat my\nlittle brother!

Route19_Text_LiaPostBattle.text: LIA: Do you have a younger\nbrother?\pI hope you're teaching him all\nsorts of things.

Route19_Text_LiaNotEnoughMons.text: LIA: I want to battle together\nwith my little brother.\pDon't you have two POKéMON?

Route19_Text_LucIntro.text: LUC: My big sis taught me how\nto swim and train POKéMON.

Route19_Text_LucDefeat.text: LUC: Oh, wow!\nSomeone tougher than my big sis!

Route19_Text_LucPostBattle.text: LUC: My big sis is strong and nice.\nI think she's awesome!

Route19_Text_LucNotEnoughMons.text: LUC: I don't want to if I can't\nbattle you with my big sis.\pDon't you have two POKéMON?

Route20_Text_BarryIntro.text: The water is shallow here.\nThere are many people swimming.

Route20_Text_BarryPostBattle.text: I wish I could ride my POKéMON.\nI bet you're not tired.

Route20_Text_ShirleyIntro.text: SEAFOAM is a quiet getaway.\nI'm vacationing here.

Route20_Text_ShirleyPostBattle.text: There's a huge cavern underneath\nthis island.

Route20_Text_TiffanyIntro.text: I love floating with the fishes\nhere among the waves.

Route20_Text_IrenePostBattle.text: SEAFOAM used to be a single island\nin the distant past.

Route20_Text_DeanPostBattle.text: I should've been buffing up my\nPOKéMON, not me!

Route20_Text_DarrinIntro.text: Why are you riding a POKéMON?\nCan't you swim?

Route20_Text_DarrinPostBattle.text: Riding a POKéMON sure looks fun!

Route20_Text_RogerIntro.text: I rode my bird POKéMON here.

Route20_Text_RogerDefeat.text: Oh, no!\nNow what am I to do?

Route20_Text_RogerPostBattle.text: My birds are exhausted.\nThey can't FLY me back!

Route20_Text_NoraIntro.text: My boyfriend gave me big pearls.

Route20_Text_NoraDefeat.text: Oh, no!\nMy pearls were in them!

Route20_Text_NoraPostBattle.text: Will my pearls grow bigger inside\nCLOYSTER?

Route20_Text_MissyIntro.text: I swam here from CINNABAR ISLAND.\nIt wasn't easy, I tell you.

Route20_Text_MissyPostBattle.text: POKéMON have taken over an\nabandoned mansion on CINNABAR.\pThey call it the POKéMON MANSION\nnow.

Route20_Text_MelissaIntro.text: CINNABAR, in the west, has a LAB\nfor POKéMON.\pMy daddy works there.

Route20_Text_MelissaPostBattle.text: CINNABAR is a volcanic island.\pI heard it rose out of the sea\nwhen a volcano erupted.

Route20_Text_MistyTrainsHere.text: Strong TRAINERS and WATER POKéMON\nare common sights in these parts.\pThey say that MISTY of the\nCERULEAN GYM trains here.

Route21_North_Text_RonaldIntro.text: You want to know if the fish are\nbiting?

Route21_North_Text_RonaldPostBattle.text: I can't catch anything good.\nNot one good POKéMON to be had!

Route21_North_Text_WadeIntro.text: I got a big haul!\nWanna go for it?

Route21_North_Text_WadeDefeat.text: Heheh, MAGIKARP just don't make\nthe grade, do they?

Route21_North_Text_WadePostBattle.text: I seem to only catch MAGIKARP!

Route21_North_Text_SpencerIntro.text: The sea cleanses my body and soul!

Route21_North_Text_SpencerPostBattle.text: The sea is great and all, but I\nlike the mountains, too.

Route21_North_Text_CueBallIntro.text: おれだって　たまには\nおよぎに　くるぜ！

Route21_North_Text_CueBallPostBattle.text: うきやすそう　だと？\nうるせー　おおきな　おせわだッ！

Route21_South_Text_JackIntro.text: I caught my POKéMON at sea.

Route21_South_Text_JeromeIntro.text: Right now, I'm in a triathlon meet.

Route21_South_Text_JeromePostBattle.text: I'm beat! But, I still have the\nbike race and marathon left!

Route21_South_Text_RolandIntro.text: Ahh!\nFeel the sun and the wind!

Route21_South_Text_ClaudeIntro.text: Hey, don't scare away the fish!

Route21_South_Text_ClaudeDefeat.text: Sorry! I'm just so frustrated from\nnot catching anything.

Route21_South_Text_ClaudePostBattle.text: Sheesh, I haven't caught a thing.\nCould this place actually be a\lgiant pool or something?

Route21_South_Text_NolanIntro.text: Keep me company till I get a hit.

Route21_South_Text_NolanPostBattle.text: Oh wait!\nI got a bite! Yeah!

Route21_North_Text_LilIntro.text: LIL: Huh? A battle?\nIAN, can't you do it alone?

Route21_North_Text_LilDefeat.text: LIL: Oh, see?\nWe lost. Happy now?

Route21_North_Text_LilPostBattle.text: LIL: I'm tired.\nCan't we go home already?

Route21_North_Text_LilNotEnoughMons.text: LIL: Huh? A battle?\nI can't be bothered to do it alone.\lBring two POKéMON, won't you?

Route21_North_Text_IanIntro.text: IAN: My sis doesn't get enough\nexercise, so I made her come.

Route21_North_Text_IanPostBattle.text: IAN: Come on, Sis!\pYou're not going to lose weight\nlike this!

Route21_North_Text_IanNotEnoughMons.text: IAN: We want a two-on-two battle.\nSo can you bring two POKéMON?

Route22_Text_EarlyRivalIntro.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey! {PLAYER}!\pYou're off to the POKéMON LEAGUE?
Forget about it!\pYou probably don't have any
BADGES, do you?\pThe guard won't let you through
without them.\pBy the way, did your POKéMON get
any stronger?

Route22_Text_EarlyRivalPostBattle.text:
I heard the POKéMON LEAGUE is
crawling with tough TRAINERS.\pI have to figure out how to get
past them.\pYou should quit dawdling and get a
move on!
