Route22_Text_RivalShouldCatchSomeMons.text: {RIVAL}“なんだ？\nポケモン　2ひきも\lもってるの　なぜか　だって？\pおまえも\nつかまえれば　いい　じゃん！

Route22_Text_LateRivalIntro.text:
{RIVAL}: What? {PLAYER}!
What a surprise to see you here!\pSo you're going to the POKéMON
LEAGUE?\pYou collected all the BADGES, too?
That's cool!\pThen I'll whip you, {PLAYER}, as a
warm-up for the POKéMON LEAGUE!\pCome on!

Route22_Text_LateRivalPostBattle.text: That loosened me up.\nI'm ready for the POKéMON LEAGUE!\p{PLAYER}, you need more practice.\pBut hey, you know that!\nI'm out of here. Smell ya!

Route22_Text_LateRivalVictory.text: {RIVAL}“ひゃははッ　{PLAYER}ー！\nそれで　がんばってるのかよ！\lおれの　さいのうに　くらべりゃ\l{PLAYER}は　まだまだ　だな！\pもっと　れんしゅう　こいよ！\nあははーッ！

Route24_Text_JustEarnedFabulousPrize.text: Congratulations! You beat our\nfive contest TRAINERS!\pYou just earned a fabulous prize!

Route24_Text_ReceivedNuggetFromMysteryTr.text: {PLAYER} received a NUGGET\nfrom the mystery TRAINER!

Route24_Text_JoinTeamRocket.text:
By the way, how would you like to
join TEAM ROCKET?\pWe're a group of professional
criminals specializing in POKéMON!\pWant to join?\pAre you sure?\pCome on, join us!\pI'm telling you to join!\p…Okay, you need convincing!\pI'll make you an offer you can't
refuse!

Route24_Text_YoudBecomeTopRocketLeader.text: With your ability, you'd become\na top leader in TEAM ROCKET.\pCome on, think of the opportunity!\nDon't let this chance go to waste.

Route24_Text_ShaneIntro.text: I saw your feat from the grass!

Route24_Text_ShanePostBattle.text: I hid because the people on the\nbridge frightened me.

Route24_Text_EthanPostBattle.text: I did my best. I have no regrets!

Route24_Text_ReliPostBattle.text: I did my best, so I've no regrets!

Route24_Text_TimmyPostBattle.text: I did my best. I have no regrets!

Route24_Text_AliPostBattle.text: I did my best. I have no regrets!

Route24_Text_CaleIntro.text: People call this the NUGGET\nBRIDGE!\pBeat us five TRAINERS and win\na fabulous prize!\pThink you got what it takes?

Route24_Text_CalePostBattle.text: I did my best. I have no regrets!

Route25_Text_JoeyPostBattle.text: All POKéMON have weaknesses.\nEven the strongest ones.\pThat's why it's best to raise\nPOKéMON of different types.

Route25_Text_DanIntro.text: Dad took me to a great party on\nthe S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.

Route25_Text_DanPostBattle.text: On the S.S. ANNE, I saw TRAINERS\nfrom around the world.

Route25_Text_FlintIntro.text: I'm a cool guy.\nI've got a girlfriend!

Route25_Text_FlintPostBattle.text: Oh, well.\nMy girlfriend will cheer me up.

Route25_Text_KelseyPostBattle.text: I wish my boyfriend was as good\nas you.

Route25_Text_ChadIntro.text: I had this feeling…\nI knew I had to battle you!

Route25_Text_ChadPostBattle.text: If your POKéMON gets confused,\nswitch it out.\pThat's a good tactic.

Route25_Text_HaleyIntro.text: My friend has many cute POKéMON.\nI'm so jealous!

Route25_Text_HaleyPostBattle.text: You came from MT. MOON?\nMay I have a CLEFAIRY?

Route25_Text_FranklinIntro.text: I just got down from MT. MOON,\nbut I've still got gas in the tank!

Route25_Text_FranklinPostBattle.text: Drat!\nA ZUBAT bit me back in that cave.

Route25_Text_NobIntro.text: I'm off to see a POKéMANIAC's\ncollection at the cape.

Route25_Text_NobDefeat.text: You done got me, and real good,\ntoo!

Route25_Text_NobPostBattle.text: The POKéMANIAC sure lives up to\nhis name.\pHis collection includes many rare\nspecies of POKéMON.

Route25_Text_WayneIntro.text: You're going to see BILL?\nFirst, we battle!

Route25_Text_WaynePostBattle.text: The trail below is a shortcut to\nCERULEAN CITY.

Route25_Text_MistyHighHopesAboutThisPlac.text: This cape is a famous date spot.\pMISTY, the GYM LEADER, has high\nhopes about this place.

Route25_Text_AreYouHereAlone.text: Hello, are you here alone?\pIf you're out at CERULEAN's cape…\nWell, it should be as a couple.

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutP.text:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, pal.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutL.text:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, lady.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_RunCellSeparatio.text: Wait till I get inside the\nTELEPORTER.\pWhen I do, go to my PC and run\nthe Cell Separation System.

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_NoPleaseChief.text:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, chief?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_NoPleaseBeautifu.text:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, beautiful?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksBudTakeThi.text:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, bud! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksLadyTakeTh.text:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, lady! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SSAnnePartyYouGo.text:
That cruise ship S.S. ANNE is in
VERMILION CITY.\pI hear there are lots of TRAINERS
on board, too.\pThey invited me to their party, but
I can't stand fancy do's.\pWhy don't you go instead of me?
Go on and have a good time.

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_CheckOutRareMons.text: BILL: Feel like checking out some\nof my rare POKéMON on my PC?\pGo on, check out my PC.

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_TeleporterIsDisp.text: TELEPORTER is displayed on the PC\nmonitor.

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SeeWhichMon.text: Which POKéMON do you want to see?

Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GiveHM05IfSeen1.text:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on ten species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with
HM05 for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
ten kinds of POKéMON?

Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GreatHereYouGo.text: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!

Route2_EastBuilding_Text_ExplainHM05.text: HM05 contains the hidden move\nFLASH.\pFLASH lights up even the darkest\nof caves and dungeons.

Route2_EastBuilding_Text_CanGetThroughRo.text: Once a POKéMON learns FLASH, you\ncan get through ROCK TUNNEL.

Route2_House_Text_FaintedMonsCanUseField.text: A fainted POKéMON just has no\nenergy left to battle.\pIt can still use moves like CUT\noutside of battle.

Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text.text: Many POKéMON live only in forests \nand caves.\pYou need to be persistent and look\neverywhere to get different kinds.
Have you noticed the skinny trees\non the roadside?\pThey can be cut down by a special\nPOKéMON move, I hear.

Do you know the evolution-cancel
technique?\pWhen a POKéMON is evolving, you
can stop the process.\pIt's a technique for raising
POKéMON the way they are.

Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text.text: Are you going to VIRIDIAN FOREST?\nIt's a natural maze in there.\lBe careful you don't get lost.
RATTATA may be small, but don't\nunderestimate its wicked bite.\pHave you caught one already?

Route3_Text_TunnelFromCeruleanTiring.text: Whew… I better take a rest…\nGroan…\pThat tunnel from CERULEAN takes a\nlot out of you!

Route3_Text_ColtonIntro.text: Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!

Route3_Text_ColtonPostBattle.text: There are other kinds of POKéMON\nthan the ones you find in forests.

Route3_Text_BenIntro.text: Hi!\nI like shorts!\pThey're delightfully comfy and\neasy to wear!

Route3_Text_BenPostBattle.text: Are you using a POKéMON CENTER's\nPC for storing your POKéMON?\pEach BOX can hold up to\n30 POKéMON.

Route3_Text_JaniceIntro.text: Excuse me!\nYou looked at me, didn't you?

Route3_Text_JanicePostBattle.text: You shouldn't be staring if you\ndon't want to battle!

Route3_Text_GregIntro.text: Are you a TRAINER?\nLet's get with it right away!

Route3_Text_GregDefeat.text: If I had new POKéMON, I would've\nwon!

Route3_Text_GregPostBattle.text: If a POKéMON BOX on the PC gets\nfull, just switch to another BOX.

Route3_Text_SallyIntro.text: That look you gave me…\nIt's so intriguing!

Route3_Text_SallyPostBattle.text: You can avoid battles by not\nletting TRAINERS see you.

Route3_Text_CalvinIntro.text: Hey! You're not wearing shorts!\nWhat's wrong with you?

Route3_Text_CalvinPostBattle.text: I always wear shorts, even in\nwinter. That's my policy.

Route3_Text_JamesIntro.text: I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI just caught.

Route3_Text_JamesPostBattle.text: Trained POKéMON are stronger than\nthe wild ones.

Route3_Text_RobinPostBattle.text: ROUTE 4 is at the foot of\nMT. MOON.

Route4_Text_TrippedOverGeodude.text: Ouch! I tripped over a rocky\nPOKéMON, GEODUDE!

Route4_Text_CrissyIntro.text: I came to MT. MOON in search of\nmushroom POKéMON.

Route4_Text_CrissyDefeat.text: After all I did to catch them!

Route4_Text_CrissyPostBattle.text: There might not be any more\nmushrooms here.\pI think I got them all.

Text_MegaPunchTeach.text: A punch of roaring ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen the chips are down,\nMEGA PUNCH is the ultimate attack!\lYou agree, yes?\pNow!\nLet me teach it to your POKéMON!

Text_MegaPunchDeclined.text: You'll be back when you understand\nthe worth of MEGA PUNCH.

Text_MegaPunchTaught.text: Now, we are comrades in the way of\npunching!\pYou should go before you're seen\nby the misguided fool who trains\lonly his silly kicking over there.

Text_MegaKickTeach.text: A kick of brutal ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen you get right down to it,\nMEGA KICK is the ultimate attack!\lDon't you agree?\pOkay!\nI'll teach it to your POKéMON!

Text_MegaKickDeclined.text: You'll come crawling back when you\nrealize the value of MEGA KICK.

Text_MegaKickWhichMon.text: All right!\nWhich POKéMON wants to learn it?

Text_MegaKickTaught.text: Now, we are soul mates in the way\nof kicking!\pYou should run before you're seen\nby the deluded nitwit who trains\lonly simple punching over there.

Route4_Text_PeopleLikeAndRespectBrock.text:
Oh, wow, that's the BOULDERBADGE!
You got it from BROCK, didn't you?\pBROCK is cool. He's not just tough.
People like and respect him.\pI want to become a GYM LEADER
like him.

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanHaveSixM.text: Okay, set six POKé BALLS in my\nbelt…\pYeah, that'll do it. At most, you\ncan have six POKéMON with you.

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketA.text: TEAM ROCKET attacks CERULEAN\ncitizens…\pNot a day goes by without TEAM\nROCKET being in the news.

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LaddieBuyMa.text: MAN: Hello there, laddie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SweetieBuyM.text: MAN: Hello there, sweetie pie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PaidOutrage.text: {PLAYER} paid an outrageous ¥500\nand bought the MAGIKARP…

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnlyDoingTh.text: No? You say no? I'm only doing this\nas a favor to you!

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NoRoomForMo.text: There's no more room for any more\nPOKéMON, it looks like.

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullNeedMo.text: You'll need more money than that!

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IDontGiveRe.text: MAN: Well, I don't give refunds.\nYou knew what you were getting!

Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ShouldStore.text: Sometimes, you'll have too many\nPOKéMON with you to add any more.\pIn that case, you should just\nstore some using any PC.

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WantMeToRaise.text: I run the DAY-CARE service.\pWould you like me to raise one of\nyour POKéMON?

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_LookAfterMonF.text: Fine, I'll look after your\n{STR_VAR_1} for a while.

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeSeeMeInAW.text: Come see me in a while.

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonNeedsToSpe.text: You're back already?\pYour {STR_VAR_1} needs to spend\nsome more time with me.

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OweMeXForMons.text: You owe me ¥{STR_VAR_2} for the return\nof this POKéMON.

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OnlyHaveOneMo.text: Oh? You only have one POKéMON\nwith you.

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhatWillYouBa.text: If you leave me that POKéMON,\nwhat will you battle with?

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonHasGrownBy.text: Your {STR_VAR_1} has grown a lot.\nYes, quite a lot, I'd say.\pLet me see…\nBy level, it's grown by {STR_VAR_2}.\pAren't I great?

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_YouveGotNoRoo.text: You can't take this POKéMON back\nif you've got no room for it.

Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_CantAcceptMon.text: わるいけど　ひでんのわざを　もった\nポケモンは　あずかれないなぁ

Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuard.text: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.

Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTa.text: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…

Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShare.text: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!

Route6_Text_RickyIntro.text: Who's there?\nQuit listening in on us!

Route6_Text_NancyIntro.text: Excuse me!\nThis is a private conversation!

Route6_Text_KeigoIntro.text: There aren't many bugs out here.

Route6_Text_KeigoPostBattle.text: I like bugs, so I'm going back to\nVIRIDIAN FOREST.

Route6_Text_JeffIntro.text: Huh?\nYou want to talk to me?

Route6_Text_JeffDefeat.text: This stinks…\nI couldn't beat your challenge…

Route6_Text_JeffPostBattle.text: I should bring more POKéMON with\nme. I'll feel safer that way.

Route6_Text_IsabellePostBattle.text: I want to get stronger.\nWhat's your secret?

Route6_Text_ElijahIntro.text: I've never seen you around.\nAre you good?

Route6_Text_ElijahPostBattle.text: Are my POKéMON weak?\nOr, am I just bad?\lWhich do you think?

Route6_NorthEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuard.text: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.

Route6_NorthEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTa.text: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…

Route6_NorthEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShare.text: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!

Route7_EastEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuardD.text: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.

Route7_EastEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTas.text: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…

Route7_EastEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShareT.text: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!

Route8_Text_AidanIntro.text: You look good at POKéMON, but how\nis your chemistry grade?

Route8_Text_AidanPostBattle.text: I am better at school than this!

Route8_Text_GlennIntro.text: You should be informed.\nYou need strategy to win at this!

Route8_Text_PaigeIntro.text: I like NIDORAN, so I collect them!

Route8_Text_PaigePostBattle.text: When POKéMON grow up, they get\nugly! They shouldn't evolve.

Route8_Text_LeslieIntro.text: School is fun, but so are POKéMON.

Route8_Text_LeslieDefeat.text: You made it clear to me that\nI should stick with school.

Route8_Text_LesliePostBattle.text: I was planning on getting some\nfresh air for a change, but…\pWe're stuck here because of the\ngates at SAFFRON.

Route8_Text_AndreaIntro.text: MEOWTH is so cute, meow, meow,\nmeow!

Route8_Text_AndreaPostBattle.text: I think PIDGEY and RATTATA are\ncute, too!

Route8_Text_MeganIntro.text: We must look silly standing here\nlike this.

Route8_Text_MeganDefeat.text: Look what you did to my poor, cute\nPOKéMON!

Route8_Text_MeganPostBattle.text: SAFFRON's gatekeeper won't let us\ngo through.\pI know he's doing his job, but I\nthink he's mean.

Route8_Text_RichPostBattle.text: Playing games and POKéMON are like\neating peanuts! I just can't stop!

Route8_Text_JuliaIntro.text: What's a cute, round, and fluffy\nPOKéMON?

Route8_Text_JuliaDefeat.text: Stop!\pDon't be so mean to my CLEFAIRY!

Route8_Text_JuliaPostBattle.text: I read that CLEFAIRY evolves when\nit's exposed to a MOON STONE.\pI read that in a POKéMON JOURNAL.\nI wonder if it's true?

Route8_Text_EliIntro.text: ELI: Twin power is fantastic.\nDid you know?

Route8_Text_EliDefeat.text: ELI: But…\nWe used our twin power…

Route8_Text_EliPostBattle.text: ELI: I caught my POKéMON with\nANNE!

Route8_Text_EliNotEnoughMons.text: ELI: We can't battle if you don't\nhave two POKéMON.

Route8_Text_AnneIntro.text: ANNE: We'll shock you with our twin\npower!

Route8_Text_AnneNotEnoughMons.text: ANNE: Hi, hi! Let's battle!\nBut bring two POKéMON.

Route8_Text_RicardoPostBattle.text: I got grass caught up in my\nspokes, man.

Route8_Text_JarenIntro.text: Clear the way, or I'll run you\ndown!

Route8_Text_JarenPostBattle.text: Don't think you're all special and\nall just because of this.

Route8_WestEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuardD.text: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.

Route8_WestEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTas.text: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…

Route8_WestEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShareT.text: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!

Route9_Text_AliciaIntro.text: You have POKéMON with you!\nYou're mine!

Route9_Text_AliciaPostBattle.text: The tunnel coming up is pitch-black\ninside.\pYou'll need FLASH to get through\nthere.

Route9_Text_ChrisIntro.text: Who's that walking there with those\ngood-looking POKéMON?

Route9_Text_DrewIntro.text: I'm taking the ROCK TUNNEL to\ngo to LAVENDER…

Route9_Text_DrewPostBattle.text: Are you off to ROCK TUNNEL, too?

Route9_Text_CaitlinPostBattle.text: You're obviously talented.\nGood luck to you!

Route9_Text_JeremyDefeat.text: Keep it coming, eh!\pOh wait.\nI'm out of POKéMON!

Route9_Text_JeremyPostBattle.text: You sure had guts standing up to\nme there, eh?

Route9_Text_BrentIntro.text: I got up early every day to raise\nmy POKéMON from cocoons!

Route9_Text_BrentDefeat.text: WHAT?\pWhat a total waste of time!

Route9_Text_BrentPostBattle.text: I have to collect more than bugs\nto get stronger…

Route9_Text_ConnerPostBattle.text: If you don't like BUG POKéMON,\nyou bug me!

SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_LeStrongSilentTy.text:
Bonjour!
I am le waiter on this ship!\pI will be happy to serve you
anything you please!\p… … …
Ah! Le strong silent type!

SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_PassengersAreRes.text: The passengers are restless from\nthis long voyage.\pYou might be challenged by the\nmore bored ones!

SSAnne_1F_Room1_Text_ImAGlobalPoliceAgen.text: Ssh…!\nI'm a GLOBAL POLICE agent.\pI'm on the trail of TEAM ROCKET.\nThey're up to nothing good!

SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerPostBattle.text: Listen, listen!\nLet me be your friend, okay?\pThen we can trade POKéMON and\ndo stuff.

SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnIntro.text: I collected these POKéMON\nfrom all around the world!

SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnDefeat.text: Oh, no!\nI went around the world for these!

SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnPostBattle.text: You hurt my poor POKéMON!\pI demand that you heal them at a\nPOKéMON CENTER!

SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_CruisingAroundWorld.text: We are cruising around the world,\nmy children and I.

SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_CruiseIsElegantAndC.text: A world cruise is so elegant yet\ncozy!

SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_AlwaysTravelWithWig.text: I always travel with WIGGLYTUFF.\nI never leave home without it.

SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaiterCherryPiePlea.text: Waiter, I would like a cherry pie,\nplease!

SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaitressCherryPiePl.text: Waitress, I would like a cherry\npie, please!

SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurIntro.text: You insolent pup!\nHow dare you barge in!

SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurDefeat.text: Humph! You rude child!\nYou have no sense of courtesy!

SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurPostBattle.text: I wish to be left alone!\nGet out!

SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_TakeAShortRest.text: You look tired. Would you like to\ntake a short rest?

SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_GladEveryoneIsRefre.text: I'm glad to see that everyone is\nlooking refreshed and chipper.

SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyB.text: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little brother…

SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyS.text: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little sister…

SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasIntro.text: I am but a solitary traveler…\pMy sole companions and friends are\nPOKéMON I caught on my journeys…

SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasPostBattle.text: You should be nice to friends!

SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_ThisShipIsLuxury.text: This ship, she is a luxury liner for\nTRAINERS of the world!\pAt every port, we hold parties with\ninvited TRAINERS.

SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalIntro.text:
{RIVAL}: Bonjour!
{PLAYER}!\pImagine seeing you here!
{PLAYER}, were you really invited?\pSo how's your POKéDEX coming?\pI already caught 40 kinds, pal.
Different kinds are everywhere.\pCrawl around in grassy areas, and
look hard for them.

SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalVictory.text: {PLAYER}‥！\nふなよい　してるのか！\pもっと　からだ\nきたえた　ほうが　いいぜ！

SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalPostBattle.text:
{RIVAL}: I heard there was a CUT
master on board.\pBut he was just a seasick old man!\pCUT itself is really useful.
Yup, it'll be handy.\pYou should go see him, too.
Smell ya!

SSAnne_2F_Room1_Text_SleepingMonLookedLi.text: I've journeyed far and wide, but in\nall my travels I've never seen\lany POKéMON sleep like this one!\pIt was something like this!

SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksIntro.text: Competing against the young keeps\nme youthful.

SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksDefeat.text: Good match!\nAh, I feel young again!

SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksPostBattle.text: Fifteen years ago, I would\nhave won!

SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DaleIntro.text: Check out what I fished up!

SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DalePostBattle.text: Party?\pThe cruise ship's party should be\nover by now.

SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SeenMonsFerryPeople.text: Ah, yes, I have seen some POKéMON\nferry people across the water!

SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SomeTreesCanBeCutDo.text:
Small trees can be chopped down
using the move CUT.\pBut remember this!
CUT is an HM technique.\pOnce learned, it is not so easily
discarded.

SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarIntro.text: Which do you find more worthy,\na strong or a rare POKéMON?

SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarPostBattle.text: Personally, I prefer strong and\nrare POKéMON.

SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnIntro.text: I don't believe I saw you at the\nparty?

SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnPostBattle.text: Oh, I adore your strong POKéMON!\nOh, how I envy you for them!

SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_HaveYouGoneToSafari.text: Have you gone to the SAFARI ZONE\nin FUCHSIA CITY?\pThere are many kinds of rare\nPOKéMON.

SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_WeThinkSafariZoneIs.text: Me and my daddy think the SAFARI\nZONE is awesome!\lI wish we could go there again.

SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_CaptainIsAwfullySic.text: The CAPTAIN said he's awfully sick.\nHe was all pale.

SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_ManyPeopleGetSeasic.text: I hear many people get seasick.

SSAnne_3F_Corridor_Text_CaptainTeachesCu.text: Our CAPTAIN is a sword master.\nHe's awesome at using CUT.\pThey say he even teaches CUT\nto POKéMON!

SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipIntro.text: Matey, you're walking the plank if\nyou lose!

SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipPostBattle.text: When we're out at sea, jellyfish\nPOKéMON sometimes drift by.

SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyIntro.text: Hello, stranger!\pI can't tell if you're from the seas\nor mountains, but stop and chat.\pAll my POKéMON are from the sea.

SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyDefeat.text: Darn!\nI let that one get away!

SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyPostBattle.text: I was going to make you my\nassistant, too!

SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyIntro.text: Even us sailors have POKéMON, too!

SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyPostBattle.text: We caught all our POKéMON while\nwe were out at sea.

SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanIntro.text: I like feisty kids like you!

SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanPostBattle.text: Sea POKéMON live in deep water.\nYou'll need a ROD to fish them up!

SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardIntro.text: You know what they say about\nsailors and battling!

SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardPostBattle.text: Hahaha!\nWant to be a sailor, mate?

SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanIntro.text: Come on, then!\nMy sailor's pride is at stake!

SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanPostBattle.text: Did you see the FISHING GURU in\nVERMILION CITY?

SSAnne_B1F_Room5_Text_MachokeHasStrength.text: My buddy MACHOKE is super strong!\pHe has enough STRENGTH to move\nbig rocks!

SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThankYouHaveH.text:
CAPTAIN: Whew! Thank you!
I'm feeling much better now.\pYou want to see my hidden CUT
technique?\pI could show you my prized CUT
technique if I weren't so ill…\pI know! You can have this!
This HIDDEN MACHINE!\pTeach CUT to your POKéMON, and
you can see it CUT anytime!

SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ExplainCut.text: Using CUT, you can chop down\nsmall trees.\pWhy not try it with the trees\naround VERMILION CITY?

SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_SSAnneWillSet.text: CAPTAIN: …Whew!\pNow that I'm not sick anymore,\nI guess it's time.\pThe S.S. ANNE will set sail soon!\pFarewell, until our return to\nVERMILION CITY!

SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_YouHaveNoRoom.text: Oh, no!\nYou have no room for this!

SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_HowToConquerS.text: How to Conquer Seasickness…\nThe CAPTAIN's reading this!

SSAnne_Deck_Text_ShipDepartingSoon.text: The party's over.\nThe ship will be departing soon.

SSAnne_Deck_Text_FeelSeasick.text: Urf… I feel ill…\pI got seasick, so I stepped out to\nget some air…

SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondIntro.text: Hey, matey!\pLet's do a little jig!

SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondPostBattle.text: How many kinds of POKéMON do you\nthink there are in this big world?

SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorPostBattle.text: My pa said there are 100 kinds of\nPOKéMON. I think there are more.

SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_BusyOutOfTheWay.text: You, mon petit!\nWe're busy here!\lOut of the way!

SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SawOddBerryInTrash.text: I saw an odd BERRY in the trash.\nI wonder what that was?

SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SoBusyImDizzy.text: I'm so busy I'm getting dizzy!\nYou have to give me room here!

SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_HearAboutSnorlaxItsA.text: Did you hear about SNORLAX?\nIt's a glutton.\pNo other POKéMON eats and sleeps\nthe way SNORLAX can and does!

SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_OnlyGetToPeelOnions.text: Snivel… Sniff…\pI only get to peel onions…\nSnivel…

SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_IAmLeChefMainCourseI.text: Er-hem!\nIndeed I am le CHEF!\pLe main course is

SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SalmonDuSalad.text: Salmon du Salad!\pLes guests may gripe it's fish\nagain, however!

SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_EelsAuBarbecue.text: Eels au Barbecue!\pLes guests will mutiny, I fear.

SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_PrimeBeefsteak.text: Prime Beefsteak!\pBut, have I enough fillets du\nbeef?

SafariZone_Center_Text_PressStartToCheck.text: TRAINER TIPS\pPress START to check\nremaining time.

SafariZone_Center_Text_WhereDidErikGo.text: SARA: Where did my boyfriend,\nERIK, go?

SafariZone_Center_Text_CatchingMonsAsGif.text: I'm catching POKéMON to take home\nas gifts.

SafariZone_East_Text_TimeDeclinesOnlyWhi.text: TRAINER TIPS\pThe remaining time declines only\nwhile you walk.

SafariZone_East_Text_HowManyDidYouCatch.text: How many did you catch?\nI'm bushed from the effort!

SafariZone_East_Text_CaughtChanseyAllWor.text: I caught a CHANSEY!\pThat makes this all worthwhile.

SafariZone_East_Text_TiredFromAllTheFun.text: Whew!\nI'm tired from all the fun!

SafariZone_North_Text_SecretHouseStillAh.text: TRAINER TIPS\pThe SECRET HOUSE is still ahead.

SafariZone_North_Text_ZigzagThroughTallG.text: TRAINER TIPS\pPOKéMON hide in tall grass.\pZigzag through grassy areas to\nflush them out.

SafariZone_North_Text_WinFreeHMFindSecre.text: TRAINER TIPS\pWin a free HM for finding the\nSECRET HOUSE.

SafariZone_East_Text_KeepAnyItemFoundOnS.text: You can keep any item you find in\nthe SAFARI ZONE.\pBut, you'll run out of time if you\ntry for all of them at once.

SafariZone_East_Text_PrizeInDeepestPartO.text: Go to the deepest part of the\nSAFARI ZONE. You will win a prize!

SafariZone_East_Text_MyEeveeEvolvedIntoF.text: My EEVEE evolved into FLAREON.\pBut, a friend's EEVEE turned into a\nVAPOREON. I wonder why?

SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_CongratsYouv.text:
Ah! Finally!\pYou're the first person to reach
the SECRET HOUSE!\pAlthough I made a campaign
for our grand opening,\pI was getting worried that no one
would win our campaign prize.\pCongratulations!
You have won!

SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_ExplainSurf.text:
HM03 is SURF.\pPOKéMON will be able to ferry you
across water using it.\pAnd, this HM isn't disposable, so
you can use it over and over.\pYou're super lucky for winning this
fabulous prize!

SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_DontHaveRoom.text: You don't have room for this\nfabulous prize!

SafariZone_West_Text_PleaseFindWardensLo.text: REQUEST NOTICE\pPlease find the SAFARI WARDEN's\nlost GOLD TEETH.\lThey're around here somewhere.\pReward offered!\nContact: WARDEN

SafariZone_West_Text_SearchForSecretHous.text: TRAINER TIPS\pZone Exploration Campaign!\nThe Search for the SECRET HOUSE!

SafariZone_West_Text_KogaPatrolsSafariEv.text:
The SAFARI ZONE's huge, wouldn't
you say?\pFUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA, 
patrols the grounds every so often.\pThanks to him, we can play here
knowing that we're safe.

SafariZone_West_Text_RocksMakeMonRunButE.text: Tossing ROCKS at POKéMON might\nmake them run, but they'll be\leasier to catch.

SafariZone_West_Text_BaitMakesMonStickAr.text: Using BAIT will make POKéMON more\nlikely to stick around if they get\lbusy eating.

SafariZone_West_Text_HikedLotsDidntSeeMo.text: I hiked a lot, but I didn't see any\nPOKéMON I wanted.

SaffronCity_Text_BossTakeTownForTeamRock.text: BOSS said he'll take this town\nin the name of TEAM ROCKET!

SaffronCity_Text_DontGetDefiantOrIllHurt.text: Don't get defiant!\nOr I'll have to hurt you!

SaffronCity_Text_CriminalLifeMakesMeFeel.text: My life as a criminal makes me feel\nso alive!

SaffronCity_Text_WeCanExploitMonsAroundW.text: With SILPH under control, we can\nexploit POKéMON around the world!\pWe'll get stinking rich, yeahah!

SaffronCity_Text_YouBeatTeamRocket.text: You beat TEAM ROCKET all alone?\nThat's amazing!

SaffronCity_Text_SafeToGoOutAgain.text: Yeah! TEAM ROCKET is gone!\nIt's safe to go out again!

SaffronCity_Text_PeopleComingBackToSaffr.text: People fled from here in droves\nwhen those ROCKETS came.\pThey should be flocking back to\nSAFFRON now.

SaffronCity_Text_FlewHereOnPidgeot.text: I flew here on my PIDGEOT when\nI read about SILPH.\pIt's already over?\nI missed the media action…

SaffronCity_Text_SawRocketBossEscaping.text: I saw the ROCKET BOSS escaping\nSILPH's building.

SaffronCity_Text_ImASecurityGuard.text: I'm a security guard.\pSuspicious kids I don't allow in!

SaffronCity_Text_CitySign.text: SAFFRON CITY\nShining, Golden Land of Commerce

SaffronCity_Text_GymSign.text: SAFFRON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\lThe Master of PSYCHIC POKéMON!

SaffronCity_Text_FullHealCuresStatus.text: TRAINER TIPS\pFULL HEAL cures all ailments like\nburns, paralysis, poisoning,\lfreezing, and sleep.\pIt costs a bit more, but it's more\nconvenient than buying other items.

SaffronCity_Text_GreatBallImprovedCatchR.text: TRAINER TIPS\pThe new GREAT BALL offers improved\ncatching rates.\pTry it on those hard-to-catch\nPOKéMON.

SaffronCity_Text_SilphsLatestProduct.text: SILPH's latest product!\nRelease to be determined…

SaffronCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign.text: POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB\pMany TRAINERS have scribbled their\nnames on this sign.

SaffronCity_Text_HowCanClubNotRecognizeL.text:
This FAN CLUB…
No one here has a clue!\pHow could they not recognize
the brilliance that is LANCE?\pHe stands for justice!
He's cool, and yet passionate!\lHe's the greatest, LANCE!

SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_Daught.text: My daughter is so self-centered.\nShe has but a few friends.
My daughter likes to mimic people.\nIt's rather vexing.\pHer mimicry has earned her the\nnickname COPYCAT around here.

SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_Mimick.text:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Do you like POKéMON?\p{PLAYER}: Uh, no, I just asked you.\p{PLAYER}: Huh?
You're strange!\pCOPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?
But, that's my favorite hobby!

{PLAYER}: Hi.
You must like POKéMON.\p{PLAYER}: No, not me.
I asked you.\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?
You're weird!\l \lCOPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?\lBut that's my favorite hobby!

Text_MimicTeach.text:
Oh wow!
A POKé DOLL!\pFor me?
Thank you!\pYou know what?
I can teach the move MIMIC.

Text_MimicWhichMon.text: I really love MIMIC!\nWho's going to learn it?

Text_MimicTaughtMale.text:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Thanks for earlier!\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Is it that fun to mimic my
every move?\pCOPYCAT: You bet!
It's a scream!

Text_MimicTaughtFemale.text:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Thanks for what you did for us.\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Is it really that fun to
copy what I say and do?\pCOPYCAT: You bet!
It's a scream!

SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_TooMuc.text: にもつが　いっぱいね！

SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_Mimick.text:
{PLAYER}“やあ！　こんにちは！
きみ　ポケモン　すきかい？\p{PLAYER}“ぼく　じゃなくって
きみに　きいてるんだ　けど\p{PLAYER}“‥‥　えー　なんだよ！
ヘンな　やつ　だなあ！\pモノマネむすめ“‥‥　なに？
ひとの　マネ　すんなって？\pだって　あたし　
ものまね　しゅみ　なんだ　もん！”

{PLAYER}“こんにちは！
ポケモン　すきなのね？\p{PLAYER}“わたし　じゃなくって
あなたに　きいてるんだ　けど\p{PLAYER}“‥　えー　なんなの！
おかしなこ　ねー！\pモノマネむすめ“‥　なに？
ひとの　マネ　すんなって？\pだって　あたし
ものまね　しゅみ　なんだ　もん！

SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_Doduo.text: DODUO: Giiih!\pPRETTY MIRROR LOOK AT ME,\nSEE HOW PRETTY I CAN BE?

SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_RareMo.text: This is a rare POKéMON!\nHuh? It's only a doll!

SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MarioW.text: A game with MARIO wearing a bucket\non his head!

SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MySecr.text: …\pMy Secrets!\pSkill: Mimicry!\nHobby: Collecting dolls!\lFavorite POKéMON: CLEFAIRY!

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MasterKoichiIntro.text: Grunt!\pI am the KARATE MASTER!\nI am the LEADER here!\pYou wish to challenge us?\nExpect no mercy!\pFwaaa!

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ChoosePrizedFighti.text: Indeed, I have lost!\pBut, I beseech you, do not take\nour emblem as your trophy!\pIn return, I will give you a prized\nFIGHTING POKéMON!\pChoose whichever one you like!

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_StayAndTrainWithUs.text: Grunt!\nStay and train at karate with us!

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MikePostBattle.text: You wait 'til you see our MASTER!\nI'm a small fry compared to him!

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HidekiPostBattle.text: Our MASTER is a pro fighter.\nBe prepared to lose!

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronIntro.text: Hiyah!\nI have no fear for anything tough!\pI shatter boulders for training\nevery day!

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronPostBattle.text: The only thing that frightens us is\npsychic power!

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiPostBattle.text: The prime fighters across the land\ntrain here.

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ReceivedMonFromKar.text: {PLAYER}は　カラテ　だいおう　から\n{STR_VAR_1}を　もらった！

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaIntro.text:
I had a vision of your arrival.\pI have had psychic powers since
I was a child.\pIt started when a spoon I
carelessly tossed, bent.\pI dislike battling, but if you wish,
I will show you my powers!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaDefeat.text:
This loss shocks me!
But, a loss is a loss.\pI admit, I didn't work hard enough
to win.\pYour victory has earned you the
MARSHBADGE.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostBattle.text: Psychic power isn't something that\nonly a few people have.\pEveryone has psychic power.\nPeople just don't realize it.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMarshBadgeTa.text:
The MARSHBADGE makes POKéMON up
to Lv. 70 obey you.\pStronger POKéMON will become wild,
ignoring your orders in battle.\pJust don't raise your POKéMON too
much to avoid that problem.\pWait, please take this TM with you.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM04.text: TM04 is CALM MIND.\pIt makes the POKéMON concentrate\nto raise both SP. ATK and SP. DEF.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_BagFullOfOtherItems.text: Your BAG is full of other items.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaIntro.text: SABRINA is far younger than I,\nbut she has earned my respect.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaPostBattle.text: In a battle of equals, the one\nwith the stronger will wins.\pIf you wish to beat SABRINA, focus\nand will yourself to victory.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanIntro.text: Does our unseen power scare you?

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanPostBattle.text: PSYCHIC POKéMON fear only ghosts\nand bugs!

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyIntro.text: POKéMON take on the appearance of\ntheir TRAINERS.\pYour POKéMON must be tough, then!

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyPostBattle.text: I have much to learn still…\pI must master PSYCHIC and teach it\nto my POKéMON…

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronIntro.text: You understand, don't you?\pThat power alone isn't enough to\nwin in the world of POKéMON?

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronPostBattle.text: SABRINA just wiped out the KARATE\nMASTER next door.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaIntro.text: You and I, our POKéMON shall\nbattle!

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaPostBattle.text: I knew that this was going to take\nplace.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronIntro.text: SABRINA is young, but she's also\nour highly skilled LEADER.\pYou won't reach her easily!

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronPostBattle.text:
There used to be two POKéMON GYMS
in SAFFRON.\pThe FIGHTING DOJO next door lost
its GYM status, though.\pWe simply creamed them when we
decided to have just one GYM.

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro.text: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM is famous for\ntraining psychics.\pYou want to see SABRINA, don't\nyou? I can tell!

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle.text: That's right! I used telepathy to\nread your mind!

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pSABRINA's POKéMON use psychic
power instead of force.\pFIGHTING POKéMON are especially
weak against PSYCHIC POKéMON.\pThey'll get destroyed before they
can even aim a punch!

SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory.text: Psychic power, huh?\pIf I had that, I'd make a bundle\nat the slots!

SaffronCity_House_Text_DontLookAtMyLette.text: …Thank you for writing.\nI hope to see you soon!\p…Hey!\nDon't look at my letter!

SaffronCity_House_Text_GettingCopycatPok.text: The COPYCAT is cute!\nI'm getting her a POKé DOLL.

SaffronCity_House_Text_ExplainPPUp.text: I was given a PP UP as a gift.\pIt's used to increase the PP of\na POKéMON's move.\pI should use it on a powerful move\nwith only a few PP.

SaffronCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelMoreEffect.text: MAX REPEL keeps weaker POKéMON\nfrom appearing.\pMAX REPEL stays effective longer\nthan SUPER REPEL.

SaffronCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsCostly.text: REVIVE is costly, but it revives\nfainted POKéMON!

SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_YouWant.text: …Wait! Don't say a word!\pYou wanted this!

SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_Explain.text: You already know, don't you?\nTM29 is PSYCHIC.\pIt's an attack that may also lower\nthe target's special stats.

SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_YouveNo.text: Where do you plan to put this?\nYou've no room.

SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Growth.text: POKéMON growth rates differ from\nspecies to species.

SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SilphC.text: SILPH CO. is widely known to all.\pIt's a victim of its own fame - it\nattracted TEAM ROCKET.

SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatI.text: Sigh…\nWouldn't this be great?\pIf the ELITE FOUR came and\nstomped TEAM ROCKET?

SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRo.text: TEAM ROCKET took off!\nWe can go out safely again!\lThat's great!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_Y.text:
Are you maybe…
… …\pYou are!
You are {PLAYER}!\pWe were just talking about you!\pWe were talking about how an
incredibly good TRAINER appeared.\pAnd that someone is you!
You're so cool!\pSo, we decided that we'll become
your FAN CLUB!\pWe all hope you'll keep battling
and show us how cool you are.\pThat way, maybe other people will
become fans just like me.

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_A.text: I'll always be cheering for you!\pGo, {PLAYER}, go!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_I.text: I'll always believe in you,\n{PLAYER}.\pPlease show the others what you're\nlike when you battle seriously.

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_W.text:
I'm sorry.
I was your fan before.\pBut now, you seem to have lost
the drive you had before.\pLately, I think {STR_VAR_1} has been
a lot cooler.

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_E.text:
Oh!
{PLAYER}!\pEveryone's been all excited about
you recently.\pI can understand why.
I know that you're strong.\pBut, do you know what?\pOnce I became {STR_VAR_1}'s fan,
I can't just stop being a fan.

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_T.text: I think TRAINERS are so cool when\nthey're battling.\pDon't you think so, too?

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_C.text:
Oh! It's {PLAYER}!
Too cool!\pOh!
Oh, yeah!\pCan you autograph something?
How about my shorts?

However hot it's been…\pAnd however cold it may get…\pI've always believed in, and worn,
shorts!\pI'm counting on you to keep
winning!\pI believe in you just as much as
I believe in shorts!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_B.text:
BROCK's my hero!
He's a man among men!\pHeheh, I got my mom to do
something for me.\pI got her to embroider “BROCK”
on my shorts!
…  …\p…  …\nI'm BROCK's fan!\pEven if I were his only fan,\nI swear it on my rock-hard will,\land on my shorts!\pI'll be his fan to the bitter end!
BROCK's the last word on cool,\nend of story!\pNow there's a guy who I want to\nbe like!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_H.text:
{PLAYER}, I've had the pleasure of
watching you battle.\pIt brings back sweet memories of
my own long-lost youth.\pMay you continue to find success.
You have a fan in me!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_N.text:
I have journeyed far and wide
across the lands.\pBut never have I seen a TRAINER
of your magnificence.\pTake courage in your abilities
and keep battling on!\pMake that a promise to me,
my young idol!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_H.text: Hmm…\nAnd you are?\pWere you hoping to sign up for\na membership in our FAN CLUB?

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_Y.text:
Ah, so you are the much-
talked-about {PLAYER}.\pYou certainly do have the look of
a winner.\pBut for me to accept you as
a true POKéMON great…\p… …\pYou've still a ways to go!

All of us gathered here are fans
of POKéMON TRAINERS.\pThe way they look in battle…
They are the picture of coolness.\pPerhaps you will be talked about
here, too, if you keep winning.

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_W.text: It's {PLAYER}!\nIt's {PLAYER}!\pI want to be like {PLAYER} one day!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_E.text:
Everyone stopped being {PLAYER}'s
fan…\pBut that means I can have {PLAYER}
all to myself!\pYay! Go for it!
My one and only {PLAYER}!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_W.text: Do you know what?\nI want to be like SABRINA!\pI want to be a psychic girl just\nlike her!

Even if I'm the only one, I won't
stop being SABRINA's fan.\pMy dream is to be like SABRINA,
cute, but cool.\pI want to be a psychic girl just
like her!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_C.text: I wonder if I can become a cool\nTRAINER one day?

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_T.text:
Oh, man, oh, man!
Cool! Too cool!\p…Huh?
No, not you.\pJust the way you battle.
That's cool.

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_I.text: Yo, {PLAYER}!\pLooks like I'm the only one left\nout of your fans.\pBut, you know, I like being an only\nfan… It's less stressful.\pKeep up and at it!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_L.text: {STR_VAR_1}'s cool, huh?\nI love the way he talks.\pI'd really relish a chance to meet\nhim in person once.

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_I.text:
Huh, can you believe it?
Everyone turned into your fans.\pSo after all we've been through,
I'm the lone {STR_VAR_1} fan?\pEh, being the one and only
{STR_VAR_1} fan's my style, anyway.

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_A.text:
Oh, my goodness!
Is it really you, {PLAYER}?\pI have to tell you, I adore the
way you battle.\pI hope you'll keep at it.
I'll be your number one fan!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_I.text:
Oh, my goodness!
If it isn't {PLAYER}!\pIt's so disappointing… I realized
I'm your number-one-and-only fan!\pWell, it can't be helped!
Let me cheer you on, at least!\pHurray, hurray, {PLAYER}!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_T.text: Recently, {STR_VAR_1} has been on\nfire.\pThe way he battles… It's just \nthe way that I like it!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_E.text:
Oh, hello!
If it isn't {PLAYER}!\pLately, all everyone talks about
is you.\pI'm feeling lonesome because I
prefer {STR_VAR_1}.

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_Y.text: Amazing!\n{PLAYER}, you really are amazing!\pInstead of just watching, maybe\nI should become a TRAINER, too.

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_I.text: I'm your only fan…\nSigh… This is lonely…\pCan't you try harder and make the\nothers take notice of you?

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_W.text: Master {STR_VAR_1} is so dignified…\nHe is so my type.\pWhy can't the others see the\ndignity he simply oozes?

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_B.text:
I believe in Master {STR_VAR_1}
with all my heart.\pEven if I am the only one to
believe in him.\pI won't ever feel lonesome, though.\pNot if I keep thinking about Master
{STR_VAR_1}.

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_Y.text: Hiyah!\pYour battling style is most\neducational.\pI hope that you will keep plugging\naway at success, hiyah!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_W.text:
Instead of just watching others
battle, battle yourself!\p…My DOJO's MASTER chewed me out
like that…\pBut I won't let that stop me from
being your fan!\pI can't stop being your fan!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_O.text:
Hiyah! There is but one TRAINER
who has my respect.\pAnd that is none other than my
MASTER at the FIGHTING DOJO.\pYou should become a fan of my
MASTER like me! Hiyah!

SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_N.text:
Hiyah! I respect my MASTER at the
FIGHTING DOJO.\pI will never become a fan of
anyone other than my MASTER!\pI will even sneak out of the DOJO
to spread word of his greatness.\pHiyah!

Text_RockSlideTeach.text:
When you're up on a rocky mountain
like this, rockslides are a threat.\pCan you imagine?
Boulders tumbling down on you?\pThat'd be, like, waaaaaaaaaaah!
Total terror!\pYou don't seem to be scared.
Want to try using ROCK SLIDE?

Text_RockSlideDeclined.text: Oh, so you are scared after all.

Text_RockSlideWhichMon.text: Which POKéMON should I teach\nROCK SLIDE?

Text_RockSlideTaught.text: It might be scary to use it in this\ntunnel…

SeafoamIslands_B4F_Text_BouldersMightCha.text: Hint: Boulders might change the\nflow of water.

Text_SwordsDanceTeach.text: Not many people come out here.\pIf I train here, I'm convinced that\nI'll get stronger and stronger.\pYep, stronger and stronger…\pHow would you like to learn a move\nlike that? It's SWORDS DANCE.

Text_SwordsDanceWhichMon.text: All right, pick which POKéMON\nI should teach it to.

Text_SwordsDanceTaught.text: If only we could keep getting\nstronger and stronger, eh?

SevenIsland_Text_IslandsMadeInSevenDays.text:
These islands are called the SEVII
ISLANDS because there are seven.\p…Or at least that's what the young
people believe.\pThe truth is, these islands are so
named because they are said to\lhave been made in seven days.

SevenIsland_Text_IslandVirtuallyUntouche.text: This island has been left virtually\nuntouched in its natural state.\pIt could be a little difficult to\nhike around because of that.

SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OnlyEnjoyme.text:
I may not look like much now,
but when I was younger…\pI flew everywhere, challenging
TRAINERS wherever I found them.\pNow, my only source of enjoyment
is reminiscing about the past while\lwatching battles.

SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SlightBreez.text: There is a slight breeze blowing\naround the box.

SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_ChallengeVi.text:
Ah!
Welcome, my friend!\pLet me tell you something. There's
a hidden room in the basement.\pA TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is
waiting there now.\pTell me, you did come to challenge
{STR_VAR_1}, am I right?

SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OhYouWontBa.text:
Oh…
You won't battle…\pI see, I see.
… …\pWell, perhaps if you change your
mind, do come back.

SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_LimitThreeM.text:
Ah!
You will battle for me?\pIt was worth my time moving the
box aside, then.\p… …
But there is one slight problem.\pThis hidden room is not built very
sturdy.\pCan I get you to limit it to
battles of three POKéMON per side?

SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SaveProgres.text: Fine! Before your battle, would\nyou like to save your game?

SevenIsland_House_Room2_Text_MatchEndedU.text: The match ended up a draw.

SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_DrawWasIt.text: A draw, was it?\pHowever, let me say that it was\na worthy spectacle.\pI'd say it was a wonderful battle\nwith a real sense of depth!

SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_AstoundingB.text:
Bravo!\pBravo, indeed!
What an astounding battle!\pIt was so astounding, why, it keeps
filling my eyes with tears!\pThe thrust and parry of expertly
used techniques!\pThe clash of power upon power!\pYes!
It was sheer magnificence!

SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_FeelYourDis.text:
Too bad!
I feel your disappointment.\pHowever, that disappointment is
what will make you better.\pUse it, learn from it, and make it
motivate you to seek greatness.\pForget not this disappointment
and redouble your training!

SevenIsland_Mart_Text_MonHavePersonaliti.text: POKéMON have personalities of their\nown, just like people.\pMy PIKACHU has a HASTY nature,\nso it grew to be a speedy POKéMON.

SevenIsland_Mart_Text_PreparationsComple.text: Okay, preparations are complete\nfor me to explore the RUINS.

SevenIsland_Mart_Text_NeedToFishOnSevenI.text: I need to fish on SEVEN ISLAND.\pThat will complete my fishing tour\nof the SEVII ISLANDS.\pI'd better stock up on some\nPOKé BALLS first, though.

SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Events.text: On this island, different events\noccur depending on connections.\pWhat are those connections?\pThey are for you to discover on\nyour own.

SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DidYou.text:
Did you ride a SEAGALLOP ferry
to get here?\pThere are at least ten of those
high-speed ships.\pI don't know where they all go,
though.

SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CheckO.text: If you're confident, you should\ncheck out TRAINER TOWER.

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyPost.text: The way I am now, I may have to\nhold off on TRAINER TOWER…

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanIntro.text: It doesn't matter if you happen to\nhave the strongest POKéMON…\pIt doesn't mean a thing if you don't\nknow how to use them properly!

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanPostB.text: You see them every so often,\nTRAINERS with awesome POKéMON\lwho have no idea what to do.\pBefore training POKéMON, TRAINERS\nthemselves need to grow up.

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonIn.text: I work to protect the environment.\nIn turn, nature protects me!

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonDe.text: Whoa! You're tough!\nHow about protecting me?

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonPo.text: From far out among the stars, our\nplanet is just a drop of water.\pBut we want to protect that drop\nof water for everyone.

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynIn.text: Those shoes you have are pretty\nsnazzy.

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynDe.text: You're hot stuff in spite of your\ncute looks.

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynPo.text: Your mom bought those snazzy\nRUNNING SHOES for you?\pShe must adore you.

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyIntr.text: You look strong.\nLet me battle you, please!

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyDefe.text: I knew it!\nYou're as tough as I thought!

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyPost.text: The way you battle has given me\na lot of useful data.\pThanks so much!

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleI.text: I was given the best possible\neducation to become this strong.\pI don't want to lose to anyone!

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleD.text: Thank you. I feel like I've been\nset free by losing to you.

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleP.text: For some reason, I get furious\nover the slightest thing.\pI'll calm myself by breathing\ndeeply.

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexIntro.text: LEX: My darling NYA, together\nwe could win!

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexDefeat.text: LEX: I seem to have been too\ncareless…

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexPostBa.text: LEX: I think it was a good\nexperience for NYA.\pYou have my gratitude.

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexNotEno.text: LEX: May I ask you to battle the\nboth of us at the same time?

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaIntro.text: NYA: I'll do my best so I won't\ndrag down my mentor, LEX!

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaDefeat.text: NYA: Oh, no…\nI'm so sorry, I…

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaPostBa.text: NYA: I think I'm going to need\nmuch more seasoning and tutoring\lunder LEX…\p…So, LEX, please, may I stay with\nyou like this?

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaNotEno.text: NYA: I'm sorry, but may we battle\nin two-on-two style?

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_BrunoTrai.text:
Training by oneself is certainly
not a bad thing.\pBut it's also not bad to aim for
the top with a partner.\pEven BRUNO…
He trained with a fellow by the\lname of BRAWLY before.

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_.text: Kyahaha!\nI'll flick you away effortlessly!
Tch!\nToo strong for me!
What's that?\nI don't act the way I look?\pHeh, that's a part of my strategy!
Howdy!\nAre you a member of my fan club?
Oh, so you're not a fan…\pWell, I can change that.\nLet me sing for you!
Lalalah…\nMy POKéMON, I send them out,\lall the girls scream and shout!
This island is too spread out…\nIt's not easy patrolling the place.
Uh-huh…
TRAINERS like you from cities,\nthey sure are tough.\pYou'll be headed for the TOWER,\nwon't you?
I punish people who abuse\nPOKéMON!
You don't seem to be a problem\nTRAINER.
If you treat your POKéMON with\nkindness, they'll understand.
EVE: I'll team up with JON and\nbattle together.
EVE: Me and JON, we lost.\nEhehe.
EVE: I'm going to work harder with\nJON.
EVE: I want to team up with JON\nwhen I battle you.\pCome back with two POKéMON, okay?
JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels\nlike we could never lose.
JON: When I'm with EVE,\nit doesn't feel like I've lost!
JON: When I'm with EVE, I feel\ngiddy whether I win or lose.\pIt's magical!
JON: If it's with EVE, I'll be\nhappy to battle with you.\pSo, I'd like to make it a\ntwo-on-two battle, if I may.
SEVAULT CANYON ENTRANCE\pTRAINERS are asked to refrain from\ndamaging plants in the CANYON.

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_Cha.text: Dance, dance!\nCHANSEY Dance!\pYou join in, too!\nDance, dance!

SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_TanobyKey_Text.text: A mysterious rumble echoed\nsomewhere far away.

SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonIntr.text: Do you know anything about this\nstone chamber?

SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonDefe.text: That was uncalled for.\nYou didn't have to be so rough.

SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonPost.text: The TANOBY RUINS date back at\nleast 1,500 years.\pBut it's a baffling mystery as to\nwhy it was built in the first place.

SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminInt.text: A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep\ninside here.

SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminDef.text: I'm not much good in battle.

SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminPos.text: I hear there are other ruins like\nthe one here.\pMight they be the resting places\nof other mystic POKéMON?

SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaIntro.text: CLIFFORD is teaching me how to\npaint.

SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaDefeat.text: We might get in trouble for being\nnoisy here.

SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaPostBat.text: I said that I wanted to paint an\nold building.\pSo CLIFFORD brought me here.

SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordInt.text: Today, in addition to our lesson,\nwe came to see the chamber.

SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordPos.text: Ah, so you are studying POKéMON\non your own…\pYes, you certainly are quite the\nextraordinary person, indeed.

SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioPostB.text: In your future, I sense that you\nwill meet many others.\pI think you will be linked to each\nother by a strange power.

SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteInt.text: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.

SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodettePos.text: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.\pCould it be that they're waiting\nfor you?

SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTow.text: TRAINER TOWER ENTRANCE\nRise to the Challenge, TRAINERS!

SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_LooksLikeT.text: トレーナータワーには\nいまは　はいれない　みたい‥

SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTow.text: トレーナータワーが　あいてる！\nさっそく　はいってみよう！

SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntIntro.text: Welcome to 10F!\nSo good of you to join me!

SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntPostBattle.text: Nice try, but the boardroom is up\none more floor.

SilphCo_10F_Text_TravisPostBattle.text: Are you satisfied with beating me?\nThen go on home!

SilphCo_10F_Text_KeepMeCryingASecret.text: About me crying…\nPlease keep it a secret.

SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForSavingMeDearBo.text:
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear boy!
Thank you for saving SILPH.\pI will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril.\pI have to thank you in some way.\pBecause I am rich, I can give you
anything.\pHere, maybe this will do.

SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForSavingMeDearGi.text:
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear girl!
Thank you for saving SILPH.\pI will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril.\pI have to thank you in some way.\pBecause I am rich, I can give you
anything.\pHere, maybe this will do.

SilphCo_11F_Text_ObtainedMasterBallFromP.text: {PLAYER} obtained a MASTER BALL\nfrom the PRESIDENT!

SilphCo_11F_Text_ThatsOurSecretPrototype.text:
PRESIDENT: You can't buy that
anywhere.\pIt's our secret prototype MASTER
BALL.\pIt will catch any POKéMON without
fail!\pYou should be quiet about using it,
though.

SilphCo_11F_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForThis.text: You have no room for this.

SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForRescuingUs.text: SECRETARY: Thank you for rescuing\nall of us.\pWe, from the PRESIDENT down,\nare indebted to you.

SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniIntro.text:
Ah, {PLAYER}!
So we meet again!\pThe PRESIDENT and I are discussing
a vital business proposition.\pKeep your nose out of grown-up
matters…\pOr, experience a world of pain!

SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniPostBattle.text: Blast it all!\nYou ruined our plans for SILPH!\pBut, TEAM ROCKET will never fall!\p{PLAYER}! Never forget that all\nPOKéMON exist for TEAM ROCKET!\pI must go, but I shall return!

SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.text: So, you want to see my BOSS?

SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: Halt! Do you have an appointment\nwith my BOSS?

SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.text: Watch your step…\nMy BOSS likes his POKéMON tough!

SilphCo_11F_Text_MonitorHasMonsOnIt.text: The monitor has POKéMON on it!

SilphCo_1F_Text_WelcomePresidentInBoardr.text: Welcome.\pThe PRESIDENT is in the boardroom\non 11F.

SilphCo_1F_Text_DestroyedWontBeFixedForW.text: めちゃめちゃに　こわされてる\nとうぶん　なおりそうに　ない‥

SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorDefeat.text: How did you know\nI was a ROCKET?

SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorPostBattle.text: I work for both SILPH and TEAM\nROCKET.

SilphCo_2F_Text_JerryPostBattle.text: Can you solve the maze in here?\nIt's not easy, I tell you!

SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: No kids are allowed in here!

SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.text: Diamond-shaped tiles are teleport\nblocks.\pThey're transporters for this\nhigh-tech building.

SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2Intro.text: Hey, kid!\nWhat are you wandering here for?

SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.text: SILPH CO. will be associated with\nTEAM ROCKET!

Text_ThunderWaveTeach.text:
Eeek!
No! Stop! Help!\pOh, you're not with TEAM ROCKET.
I'm sorry, I thought…\pWill you forgive me if I teach
you the THUNDER WAVE technique?

Text_ThunderWaveWhichMon.text: Which POKéMON should I teach\nTHUNDER WAVE?

Text_ThunderWaveTaught.text:
THUNDER WAVE causes paralysis in
the target POKéMON.\pA paralyzed POKéMON may be unable
to move in battle.\pIt's an ELECTRIC-type move, so it
won't work on some POKéMON.

SilphCo_3F_Text_WhatAmIToDo.text: I work for SILPH CO.\nWhat am I to do?

SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntPostBattle.text: A hint? You can open doors with\na CARD KEY!

SilphCo_3F_Text_JoseIntro.text: I support TEAM ROCKET more than\nI support SILPH CO.!

SilphCo_3F_Text_JosePostBattle.text: Humph…\pTEAM ROCKET said that if I helped\nthem, they'd let me study POKéMON.

SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: TEAM ROCKET has taken control\nof SILPH CO.!

SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.text: Fwahahaha!\nMy BOSS has been after this place!

SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyIntro.text: My POKéMON is my loyal servant.

SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyPostBattle.text: The doors are electronically\nlocked.\pIt takes a CARD KEY to open the\ndoors here.

SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.text: I better tell the BOSS on 11F!

SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketsInUproarAboutIntr.text: TEAM ROCKET is in an uproar over\nsome intruder.\pThat's you, right?

SilphCo_5F_Text_YoureOurHeroThankYou.text: TEAM ROCKET took off!\nYou're our hero! Thank you!

SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: I heard a kid was wandering\naround.

SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.text: It's not smart to pick a fight with\nTEAM ROCKET!

SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauIntro.text: We study POKé BALL technology on\nthis floor.

SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauPostBattle.text: We worked on the ultimate POKé\nBALL which would catch anything.

SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonPostBattle.text: You're only on 5F.\nIt's a long way to my BOSS!

SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2Intro.text: Show TEAM ROCKET a little respect!

SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.text: Which reminds me.\pKOFFING evolves into WEEZING!

SilphCo_5F_Text_PorygonFirstVRMon.text: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pPOKéMON LAB created PORYGON,\nthe first virtual-reality POKéMON.

SilphCo_5F_Text_Over350TechniquesConfirm.text: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pOver 350 POKéMON techniques have\nbeen confirmed.

SilphCo_5F_Text_SomeMonsEvolveWhenTraded.text: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pSome POKéMON have been confirmed\nto evolve when they are traded.

SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketBossLookingForStro.text:
Those thugs that took over our
building…\pTheir BOSS said he was looking for
strong POKéMON.\pI hope our PRESIDENT managed to
avoid trouble…

SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsTookOverBuilding.text: The ROCKETS came and took over\nthe building!

SilphCo_6F_Text_BetterGetBackToWork.text: Well, better get back to work.

SilphCo_6F_Text_HelpMePlease.text: Oh dear, oh dear.\nHelp me, please!

SilphCo_6F_Text_ThatManIsSuchACoward.text: That man next to me…\nHe's such a coward!

SilphCo_6F_Text_NeedsMeToLookAfterHim.text: He's so helpless, he needed\nsomeone like me to look after him.

SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsTryingToConquerWo.text: TEAM ROCKET is trying to conquer\nthe world with POKéMON.

SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsRanAwayBecauseOfY.text: TEAM ROCKET ran away, and it's all\nbecause of you!

SilphCo_6F_Text_TargetedSilphForOurMonPr.text: They must have targeted SILPH for\nour POKéMON products.

SilphCo_6F_Text_ComeWorkForSilphWhenYour.text: Come work for SILPH when you\nget older.

SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!

SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.text: No matter!\nMy brothers will avenge me!

SilphCo_6F_Text_TaylorIntro.text: That rotten PRESIDENT!\pServes him right for shipping me\noff to the TIKSI BRANCH!\pThat's why TEAM ROCKET came after\nus, I'm sure of it!

SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.text: If you stand for justice, you\nbetray us bad guys!

SilphCo_7F_Text_HaveMonForSavingUs.text: Oh! Hi! You're not a ROCKET!\nYou came to save us?\lWhy, thank you!\pI want you to have this POKéMON\nfor saving us.

SilphCo_7F_Text_ObtainedLaprasFromEmploy.text: {PLAYER} obtained a LAPRAS from\nthe SILPH employee!

SilphCo_7F_Text_ExplainLapras.text:
It's a LAPRAS.
It's a very intelligent POKéMON.\pWe kept it in our lab, but it will
be much better off with you.\pI think you will be a good TRAINER
for LAPRAS!\pIt's a good swimmer.
It'll give you a lift across water!

SilphCo_7F_Text_RocketBossWentToBoardroo.text: TEAM ROCKET's BOSS went to the\nboardroom!\pIs our PRESIDENT okay?\nI'm worried.

SilphCo_7F_Text_OhNo.text: あ‥　もう　もてないぞ

SilphCo_7F_Text_SavedAtLast.text: たすかったよ　ありがと！

SilphCo_7F_Text_RocketsAfterMasterBall.text: TEAM ROCKET was after the MASTER\nBALL, which catches any POKéMON.

SilphCo_7F_Text_CanceledMasterBallProjec.text: We canceled the MASTER BALL\nproject because of TEAM ROCKET.

SilphCo_7F_Text_BadIfTeamRocketTookOver.text: It would be bad if TEAM ROCKET\ntook over SILPH or our POKéMON.

SilphCo_7F_Text_WowYouChasedOffTeamRocke.text: Wow!\pYou chased off TEAM ROCKET all by\nyourself?

SilphCo_7F_Text_ReallyDangerousHere.text: You!\nIt's really dangerous here!\pYou came to save me?\nYou can't!

SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle.text: You won't find my BOSS by just\nscurrying around!

SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaIntro.text: Heheh!\pYou mistook me for a SILPH worker?

SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaPostBattle.text: Despite your age, you are a\nskilled TRAINER!

SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!

SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.text: Doesn't matter.\nMy brothers will repay the favor!

SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro.text: A child intruder?\nThat must be you!

SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.text: Go on home before my BOSS gets\nticked off!

SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalIntro.text:
{RIVAL}: Hahaha! I thought you'd
turn up if I waited here!\pI guess TEAM ROCKET slowed you
down! Not that I care!\pI saw you in SAFFRON, so I decided
to see if you got better!

SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalDefeat.text: Oh, man!\nSo, you are ready for BOSS\lROCKET!

SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalVictory.text: {RIVAL}“おまえなあ‥\pこんな　うでまえじゃ\nまだまだ‥\lいちにんまえ　とは　いえないぜ

SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalPostBattle.text:
Well, {PLAYER}!
I'm moving on up and ahead!\pBy checking my POKéDEX, I'm
starting to see what's strong and\lhow they evolve!\pAm I a genius or what?\pI'm going to the POKéMON LEAGUE to
boot out the ELITE FOUR.\pI'll become the world's most
powerful TRAINER!\p{PLAYER}, well, good luck to you!
Don't sweat it!\lSmell ya!

SilphCo_8F_Text_WonderIfSilphIsFinished.text: I wonder if SILPH is finished…

SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: That's as far as you'll go!

SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.text: If you don't turn back…\nI'll call for backup!

SilphCo_8F_Text_ParkerPostBattle.text: So, what do you think of SILPH\nBUILDING's maze?

SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2Intro.text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!

SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.text: I'll leave you up to my brothers.

SilphCo_8F_Text_ToRocketBossMonsAreTools.text:
TEAM ROCKET's BOSS is terribly
cruel!\pTo him, POKéMON are just tools to
be used.\pWhat will happen if that tyrant
takes over our company…

SilphCo_9F_Text_YouShouldTakeQuickNap.text: You look tired.\nYou should take a quick nap.

SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1Intro.text: Your POKéMON seem to adore you,\nkid!

SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.text: If I had started as a TRAINER at\nyour age…

SilphCo_9F_Text_EdIntro.text: Your POKéMON have weak points!\nI can nail them!

SilphCo_9F_Text_EdPostBattle.text: Exploiting weak spots does work.\nThink about type advantages.

SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt2Intro.text: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!

SixIsland_Text_IslandSign.text: SIX ISLAND\nFortune Island of Aged Wisdom

SixIsland_Text_ThatWayToWaterPathRuinVal.text: Keep going this way and you'll get\nto the WATER PATH.\pStay on that and you'll get to\nthe RUIN VALLEY.

SixIsland_Text_SkyAtNightIsFantastic.text: When you're this far away from the\ncity, the sky at night is fantastic.

SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_I.text: Fufu… Fufufufu…\nI guessed right.\pI was right in tailing you!

SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_S.text:
I knew that there was a SAPPHIRE
here, so it belongs to me!\pI'll sell it to TEAM ROCKET for
serious money.\p…D-don't glare at me like that!\pIf you want it back, why don't you
go get it after I sell it?\pI'll even tell you one of the
passwords to TEAM ROCKET's\lWAREHOUSE.\pThe WAREHOUSE password I know is
“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”\pI'm done.
Don't think badly of me!

SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynIntro.text: …Huh?\pI was envisioning my house, but\nthis is where I TELEPORT?

SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynPostBattl.text: I am so scatterbrained!\pI need to focus so I can TELEPORT\nproperly to my house!

SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_RightRouteSign.text: GREEN PATH\nThink Green, Keep Nature Clean!

SixIsland_House_Text_GoodPlaceForNatureA.text: There's nothing that young people'd\nfind exciting here on this island.\pBut, this is a good place in terms\nof nature and history.\pRelax and enjoy your stay.

SixIsland_Mart_Text_AgathaOldestEverElit.text: Play with POKéMON lots and live\na long life!\pTake AGATHA, for example.\pShe set a record for being the\noldest-ever ELITE FOUR member.\pShe spurs me to do bigger things.

SixIsland_Mart_Text_ShouldBuyMailAndWrit.text: I should buy some MAIL and write\nhim a letter…

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketIntro.text: There're no rare POKéMON around\nthese parts! Not a one!\pThat burns me up, man.\nI'll take it out on you!

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketPostB.text: So listen, you haven't seen any\nrare POKéMON, have you?

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorIntro.text: I'm having no luck at all.\nA battle'd be a change of pace!

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorPostBa.text: I can't very well go home without\ncatching something, though.

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoIntro.text: Gasp… Gasp…\pI swam here from SIX ISLE PORT\nin one go.

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoPostBat.text: I'm only at the halfway point…\nI'm beat…

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleIntro.text: It's not so easy sending POKéMON\nout while swimming, you know?

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleDefea.text: I didn't lose to you at swimming.\nThis doesn't bother me.

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicolePostB.text: Are you headed for the island up\npast here?\pI didn't see anything interesting\nthere.

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaIntro.text: AVA: Let's have a two-on-two\nmarine battle!

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaDefeat.text: AVA: Oh, you're amazing!\nEven better, you're on your own!

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaPostBatt.text: AVA: You know, I do prefer the\nsea over any pool.

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaNotEnoug.text: AVA: You're challenging us to\na battle?\pYou'll need at least two POKéMON\nif you want to do that.

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebIntro.text: GEB: Big Sister, help!\nPlease battle with me!

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebDefeat.text: GEB: Wow, Big Sister, this person's\nreally good!

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebPostBatt.text: GEB: I'm hanging onto my sister\nbecause I can't touch the bottom.

SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebNotEnoug.text: GEB: Please battle against me and\nmy sister!\p…Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyIntro.text: I'm curious, how do you raise your\nPOKéMON?

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyDefeat.text: You raise your POKéMON with a\nwhole lot of love!

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyPostBa.text: In the same way your mother raised\nyou full of love, you should raise\lyour POKéMON.

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonIntro.text: I'm working to preserve the natural\necology of POKéMON here.

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonDefeat.text: Oh, for someone so young, you are\ntremendous!

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonPostBa.text: I'm not saying that you shouldn't\ncatch POKéMON.\pI just want people to raise their\nPOKéMON responsibly.

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretIntro.text: I caught a BUG POKéMON that lives\nonly around here!

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretPostBat.text: There's a girl near the BUSH who\nmeasures HERACROSS for TRAINERS.

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahIntro.text: You know, it just doesn't feel right\nif I don't use BUG POKéMON.

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahDefeat.text: It's okay, losing is a fun part of\nPOKéMON's appeal, too.

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahPostBatt.text: By the way, “appeal” is a weird\nword, if you think about it.\pLike, is it like an orange peel?\nOr like a ringing bell?

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceIntro.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah!\nLook at all the BUG POKéMON!

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceDefeat.text: I got beat while I was still busy\ncelebrating!

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VancePostBatt.text: I'm going to bring my little brother\nhere next time.

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashIntro.text: Look, look! There are funny\npatterns on the ground.

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashPostBattl.text: The funny patterns on the ground…\pThey look like the patterns on my\ngrandpa's clothes.

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellIntro.text: I bet you think I'm just some guy,\ndon't you, eh?

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellDefeat.text: I bet you think I'm weak,\ndon't you, eh?

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellPostBa.text: Ayup, you townies come around all\nso dandy with a hat that flashy…\pHow about giving me that?

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaIntro.text: Take a deep breath.\nIsn't the air delicious?

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaDefeat.text: If you'd like, I can teach you how\nto breathe properly.

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaPostBatt.text: First, exhale.\nBlow everything out.\pWhen you can't exhale anymore,\ninhale the clean air!\pIsn't it refreshing?

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaIntro.text: I love BUG POKéMON.\nThat's why I'm here all the time.\pAm I the only girl like that?

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaDefeat.text: I lost, but I'm still laughing.\nAm I the only girl like that?

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaPostBatt.text: I'm going to keep on collecting\nBUG POKéMON.\pAm I the only girl like that?

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyIntro.text: This is a good spot.\nI'll pitch my tent here.

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyPostBatt.text: I'm going to observe the night sky\nhere.

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyIntro.text: Oh, yuck!\nI think a bug stung me!

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyDefeat.text: It wasn't a bug.\nI cut my shin on some grass.

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyPostBatt.text: A little cut like that…\nA little spit's enough to cure it!

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonIntro.text: Have you noticed something odd\nabout these parts?

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonDefeat.text: Have you taken a good look around\nyour feet?

SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonPostBat.text: There are places here in PATTERN\nBUSH where grass won't grow.\pWhat could be the cause of such\na phenomenon?

SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Somethin.text: For ten years, I've searched for\nRUINS.\pNo, make that twenty years.\pI get this feeling that there's\nsomething hidden on this island.

SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SomeMons.text:
You know of POKéMON that evolve
only upon trading, yes?\pBut did you know that there are
still others?\pSome POKéMON evolve only when
traded while holding specific items.

SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RivalImp.text:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!
How's your POKéDEX filling up?\pIt looks like it's impossible to get
all the POKéMON by hanging around\ljust these parts.\pMaybe there are POKéMON we don't
know about somewhere far away…\p… … …  … … …  … … …\pWell, if I can't do it, there's no
way for you to get it done.\pI'm not going to get all desperate
over this.\pI'll keep collecting POKéMON at my
own pace while I train them.\pThat's what I'll do.
So there's no point staying here.\lI may as well leave for home.\pThat's that, then!
Smell ya later!

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CantFigureOutH.text: I can't figure out how I'm supposed\nto get inside.

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_IFoundThisPlac.text: Let me tell you, I found this\nplace.\pDon't look so envious, will you?

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CheckDoorMoreT.text: The door doesn't budge at all.\nCheck it more thoroughly?

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_SeveralDotsOnT.text: On closer inspection, there are\nseveral dots on the door…

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyIntro.text: There appear to be many secrets\nstill unsolved in this world.

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyPostBatt.text: I suggest to you that you, too,\ngive a thought to the secrets and\lmysteries of our world once a day.

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterIntro.text: I'm curious, what compelled you to\ncome here?

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterDefeat.text: It's been so long since I battled,\nmy instincts are off.

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterPostBatt.text: There are several ruins on the\nSEVII ISLANDS.\pThe majority of them date back\na long way.

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryIntro.text: It's been said that there are\nmysterious stones on this island.\pI suspect it has something to do\nwith the ruins here.

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryPostBattl.text: Those ruins over there…\pI haven't had any luck in finding\nhow I can get inside.

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylIntro.text: A battle with you, so high up!

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylDefeat.text: Oh, the heartbreak of losing so\neasily to you!

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorIntro.text: I'm pretty familiar with the land\naround these parts.

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorDefeat.text: You don't need to be so pushy.\nI'll be happy to tell you.

SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorPostBatt.text: The door to the ruins…\nIt has these strange patterns\lengraved on the outside.\pI don't know what they mean,\nthough.

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseIntro.text: I let a pleasant breeze lead me\nall the way here.

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseDefeat.text: Giggle… You're so cute when you're\ndetermined.

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RosePostBattle.text: I want to go to the woods over\nthere, but…\pThere are lots of BUG POKéMON.\nThey scare me a little.

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardIntro.text: I'm practicing in secret so no one\ncan see me.

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardPostBattl.text: As a performer, I don't want people\nto know about the effort I put in.

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirIntro.text: What, you're suggesting that you're\nsick of seeing SWIMMERS like me?\pAww, don't be hatin'!

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirPostBattle.text: I couldn't lift the stigma of being\na SWIMMER…

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseIntro.text: My boyfriend's always busy, so I\ncome swimming by myself.

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseDefeat.text: Awww, I knew this would happen!

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DenisePostBattl.text: When I can't be with my boyfriend,\nI spend time with the POKéMON he\lgave me.

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlIntro.text: Tell me, where are the mountains\naround these parts?

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlDefeat.text: I lost my way while I was busy\nbattling!

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlPostBattle.text: Aren't there any mountains around\nthese parts?

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuIntro.text: MIU: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to play!

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuPostBattle.text: MIU: It makes me all sad inside\nwhen we lose…
