SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuNotEnoughMon.text: MIU: MIA and I are TWINS.\nWe want to battle together.

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaIntro.text: MIA: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to battle!

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaDefeat.text: MIA: You're mean!\nYou're bad for winning!

SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaNotEnoughMon.text: MIA: Oh, you only have one\nPOKéMON?\pDon't you feel lonesome?

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_LoveItNe.text: Hera, hera, HERACROSS!\nBig and shiny, it's the bug boss!\lLove it, need it, HERACROSS!

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_MayIMeas.text: Eeeeek!\nThat's a HERACROSS!\pPlease, please, may I measure how\nbig it is?

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInch.text: Eeeek, it's {STR_VAR_2} inches!\nI've never seen anything like this!\lYou deserve a reward!

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_WantToSe.text: I want to see a much, much bigger\nHERACROSS than that one.\pOh, how I adore them, big\nHERACROSS!

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInch.text: Huh? This {STR_VAR_2}-inch measurement…\nOh, boo! It's the same as before.
Oh, it's just {STR_VAR_2} inches.\nThe HERACROSS before was bigger.\pIt was {STR_VAR_3} inches, the biggest\nHERACROSS you've brought me.

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ThisWont.text: Oh, no! This won't do!\pHERACROSS looks much more macho\nand cool, and has a lovely horn!

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_YourBagI.text: Your BAG is full.\nMy reward won't fit.

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BiggestH.text: The biggest HERACROSS that I have\never seen measured so far is:\p{STR_VAR_3} inches!

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BlankCha.text: It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.

SixIsland_WaterPath_House2_Text_MyNeighb.text: My height is 67.0 inches on the\nbutton.\pI know it is this precisely because\nmy neighbor measured me.

ThreeIsland_Text_IslandSign.text: THREE ISLAND\nKin Island of Family Bonding

ThreeIsland_Text_IslandBelongsToUs.text: Hyahoo!\pFrom this day on, this island\nbelongs to us!

ThreeIsland_Text_GoBackToKanto.text: We don't need you people bringing\nyour noise and trouble here!\pWe're asking you to go back to\nKANTO!

ThreeIsland_Text_BossIsOnHisWay.text: Hey, go cry somewhere else.\nOur boss is on his way.\pWhen he gets here, we'll give you\na k-rad motorbike show you won't\lsoon forget!

ThreeIsland_Text_GetOffIslandNow.text: W-what!? Not on your life!\nGet off the island now!

ThreeIsland_Text_AreYouBossGoBackToKanto.text: Are you the boss?\nGo back to KANTO right now!

ThreeIsland_Text_JustGotHerePal.text: Hah?\pI just got here, pal.\pWhat's with the hostile attitude?\nIt's mighty cold of you!

ThreeIsland_Text_FollowersRaisingHavoc.text: Your gang of followers have been\nraising havoc on their bikes.\pDo you have any idea how much\ntrouble they've caused us on the\lisland?

ThreeIsland_Text_OughtToBeThankingUs.text:
No, man, I don't get it at all.\pLook at this place.
What do you do for entertainment?\pYou ought to be thanking us for
livening up this sleepy village.\pBut hey, if you insist, you can try
making us leave.

ThreeIsland_Text_YouCowardsToughInPack.text: Grr… You cowards…\nSo tough in a pack…

ThreeIsland_Text_WannaMakeSomethingOfYou.text: You, what are you staring at?\nDon't you know it's not polite?\pYou wanna make something of it\nor what?

ThreeIsland_Text_ThatsSmart.text: That's smart.\nKeep your nose out of this.

ThreeIsland_Text_Biker1Intro.text: Heh, I like your guts.\nYou'll be losing money to me, but…

ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2Intro.text: Aren't you from KANTO?\nYou should be on our side!

ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2PostBattle.text: What's the matter with you,\ngetting all hot like that?\pTotally uncool, man!

ThreeIsland_Text_Biker3Intro.text: We invited the boss out here,\nbut you had to mess it up!\pYou embarrassed us, man!

ThreeIsland_Text_Biker3PostBattle.text: Boss, I'm telling you, you've gotta\ndo something about this kid!

ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonIntro.text:
I've been watching you, and I'd say
you've done enough.\pWhat are you, their friend or
something?\pThen I guess you'll be battling me
in their place.

ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonDefeat.text: All right, enough!\nWe'll leave like you wanted!\pWe'll be happy to see the last of\nthis boring island!

ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonPostBattle.text: Humph! Yeah, go right on hanging\naround with these hayseeds!

ThreeIsland_Text_ThankYouOhYourMonGotHur.text: Thank you! Those goons were\nnothing but bad trouble.\pOh, look, your POKéMON got hurt\non my account.

ThreeIsland_Text_YouveGotImpressiveMons.text: You've got seriously impressive\nPOKéMON with you.

ThreeIsland_Text_LostelleWentOffTowardsB.text:
It'd be fantastic if someone as
strong as you lived here.\pI hope you'll at least stay here
a while.\p…I beg your pardon?
You're looking for LOSTELLE?\pLOSTELLE went off towards BOND
BRIDGE a while ago.

ThreeIsland_Text_WouldntWantToSeeBikersH.text: THREE ISLAND is actually the most\npopulous of the islands here.\pStill, it could be less sleepy.\pBut I wouldn't want to see goons\nlike those BIKERS here again.

ThreeIsland_Text_WhenDodouEvolvesGoingTo.text: I'm going to train my DODUO in the\nBERRY FOREST.\pWhen it evolves, I'm going to play\na game on TWO ISLAND.

ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HelpScaryPo.text:
LOSTELLE: Whimper… Sniff…
Oh! Please, help!\pA scary POKéMON appeared there
a little while ago.\pIt kept scaring.
It made LOSTELLE scared.\pI'm too scared to move!
But I want to go home…

ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HereItComes.text: Oh! Here it comes again!\nNo! Go away! It's scaring me!\pWaaaaaaah!\nI want my daddy!

ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_ThankYouHav.text: Ohh! That was so scary!\nThank you!\pLOSTELLE came to pick some\nBERRIES.\pYou can have this!

ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_LetsGoHome.text: What's your name?\pLOSTELLE's scared, so can I go\nwith you to my daddy's house?\pOkay!\nLet's go home!

ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_BerryPouchI.text: Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nI guess you don't want this.

ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_WelcomeToBe.text: Welcome to the BERRY FOREST\pBe friendly and share BERRIES with\nothers and POKéMON.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiIntro.text: The salty tang of the sea…\nIt tickles my heart.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiPostBat.text: Perhaps that reek is your sweaty\nPOKéMON's body odor…

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletIntro.text: Where are you off to in such\na hurry?

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletPostBa.text: If you keep going this way, you'll\neventually reach BERRY FOREST.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraIntro.text: My mommy said that I can't swim\nwithout my float ring.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraPostBat.text: This year, I'm going to finally\nlearn how to swim!

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisPostBa.text: Did I just win?\nOr did I lose?

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaIntro.text: Oh, no, don't come here!\nPlease, stay away from me!

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaDefeat.text: Okay, you've won!\nNow will you please go away?

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaPostBat.text: A POKéMON bit through my \nswimsuit.\pI can't get out of the water!

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyIntro.text: JOY: We'll teach you what our\nfavorite POKéMON is!

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyPostBattl.text: JOY: Wasn't that fun?\nI hope we can battle again!

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyNotEnough.text: JOY: I really want to battle with\nMEG.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegIntro.text: MEG: We'll show you our favorite\nPOKéMON.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegNotEnough.text: MEG: I want to battle together\nwith JOY.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_BondBridgeSi.text: BOND BRIDGE\nPlease be quiet when crossing.\pBERRY FOREST AHEAD

ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_Prospec.text:
Hey, there!
How's it going?\pWhat am I doing here, you ask?
Why, I'm prospecting for gold!\pWhen I strike it rich, I'm buying
a house in KANTO.

ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_StruckG.text:
Hey, there! How's it going?
Did you hear? I've struck gold!\pYou remembered that I was
prospecting, didn't you?\pYou can't begin to imagine just
how happy I am.\pSo, I'll show you!
This is for you!

ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_ThatsAN.text: That's a NUGGET!\pI can't give you any nuggets of\nwisdom, so that'll have to do!

ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_WhoopsB.text: Whoops, your BAG is crammed full!\nI'll give this to you later.

ThreeIsland_House1_Text_YoureAlwaysSoCoo.text: LOSTELLE: Hi, {PLAYER}!\nYou're always so cool!\pI'll make lunch for you, too, one\nday, {PLAYER}.

ThreeIsland_House1_Text_RareRocksGemsDis.text: Rare rocks and gems are displayed.

ThreeIsland_House2_Text_CantMakeThisSpoo.text:
Urrrrrrrrgggghhhh…
Kwaaaaah!\p…It's useless! I can't make this
spoon bend with my mind.\pMaybe I really don't have any
psychic powers.

ThreeIsland_House2_Text_IAdmireSabrina.text:
You know about a girl GYM LEADER
in SAFFRON CITY?\pShe uses PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,
right?\pI admire her, I really do.\pI've heard that she's one cool
customer and beautiful, too.

ThreeIsland_House3_Text_WantedToLiveSome.text: I bought this house because I\nwanted to live somewhere quiet.\pToday, I think I'll go out fishing.

ThreeIsland_House4_Text_GhostsInBerryFor.text: You must never, ever go out to\nthe BERRY FOREST alone.\pWhy?\nThere are ghosts there.

ThreeIsland_House4_Text_PapaKeepsLyingTo.text: Papa keeps lying to me, and won't\nlet me go out and play!

ThreeIsland_House5_Text_ImNotLostelle.text:
Me?
I'm not LOSTELLE.\pShe's probably gone to the
BERRY FOREST, I think.\pShe picks BERRIES there for making
lunch.

ThreeIsland_House5_Text_IllGoPlayWithLos.text: I think I'll go play with LOSTELLE\ntoday.

ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_TrueThatCeldadonDe.text: Is it true?\pCELADON DEPT. STORE is several\ntimes bigger than this shop?

ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_PeopleHealWithBerr.text: I sometimes buy medicine here.\pBut a lot of people heal POKéMON\nwith BERRIES from BERRY FOREST.\pAfter all, BERRIES are free and\nthey never run out.

ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_BikersWereAboutToT.text: Those BIKERS were about to trash\nthis POKéMON MART.\pAm I glad they decided to leave!

ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCNetw.text: Hey, did you hear the news?\pThe PC network here can now link\nwith PCs in KANTO.\pI don't know how that came about,\nbut it's fantastic!

ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Imposs.text: It's impossible to SURF between the\nislands around these parts.\pThe tides are too fast and\ntreacherous.

ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Always.text: Let's crush BERRIES!\n…That'd be wasting BERRIES?\pYou can always find some BERRIES\non the ground in BERRY FOREST.

ThreeIsland_Port_Text_WereKantoRiderFede.text: We're the KANTO RIDER FEDERATION!\nVroom! Vavavavooom! Vroom!\pMy bike's wimpy, so I have to\nmake exhaust noises myself!

ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ForkOverMoney.text: Hey, hey, lady!\nFork over some spending money!

ThreeIsland_Port_Text_IllCallThePolice.text: Aiyeeh!\pWh-who are you?!\nI… I'll call the police!

ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ThankGoodnessBiker.text: Those BIKERS…\nAre they gone?\pOh, thank goodness!\nThey certainly had me terrified!

ThreeIsland_Port_Text_EverythingTurnedOu.text: Those BIKERS ran off, and\nLOSTELLE was found safe.\pEverything turned out for the best!

TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_WelcomeToTrainer.text: Hello!\pWelcome to TRAINER TOWER where\nTRAINERS gather from all over!

TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TrainersUpToFloo.text: TRAINERS from all over the world\ngather here to battle.\pLet me see…\pRight now, there are TRAINERS only\nup to Floor {STR_VAR_1}.

TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TrainersUpEighth.text: TRAINERS are awaiting your\nchallenge up to the eighth floor.

TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_LikeToChallengeT.text: Would you like to challenge the\nwaiting TRAINERS?

TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_StartClockGetSet.text: Okay, I'll get the clock started,\nso give it everything you have.\pOn your marks…\pGet set…\pGo!

TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TooBadComeBackTr.text: That was too bad.\pI think you put in a tremendous\neffort in your battling.\pPlease come back and try again!

TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_GiveItYourBest.text: I hope you give it your best.

TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_MoveCounterHereW.text: When the TRAINERS switch places,\nthe movement can be hectic.\pTo avoid the stampede, we moved\nthe reception counter here.\pI'm sorry for the inconvenience.

TrainerTower_Roof_Text_ImOwnerBattledPer.text: Hello…\pI am the owner of this TOWER…\pHow the sky soars above this\nrooftop…\pThe caress of the winds up here…\pIt's all so perfect…\pThe way you battled…\nIt, too, was perfection…

TrainerTower_Roof_Text_DoneItInRecordTim.text:
Oh!
Stupendous!\pIt's marvelous how you've come up
here so quickly.\pThe fact is, you've done it in
record time…\pI'll have your record posted at
the reception counter.

TrainerTower_Roof_Text_TookSweetTimeGett.text: You seem to have taken your sweet\ntime getting here…

TrainerTower_Roof_Text_IdLikeToSeeBetter.text: What I would like to see is a\nbetter time out of you…\pI'm counting on you.\pUntil then, farewell…

TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_NeedTwoMonsForDo.text: This is a two-on-two battle.\pYou may not battle unless you have\nat least two POKéMON.

TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_ExplainTrainerTo.text:
Here at TRAINER TOWER, there is an
event called TIME ATTACK.\pYou will be timed on how quickly
you can get from the reception\lcounter to the OWNER on the roof.\pThe best times will be recorded on
the Time Board.\pTry competing with friends to see
who can beat it the fastest.\pYou will not earn any EXP. Points
or money by beating TRAINERS here.

TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_WonderWhatKindsO.text: I'm here to see how good I am.\pI wonder what kinds of TRAINERS\nare waiting for me?\pIt's nerve-racking!

TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_StairsTougherTha.text: Gasp, gasp…\nGasp…\pNever mind battling! These stairs…\nThey're tougher than any battle…

TwoIsland_Text_DangerFastCurrent.text: DANGER! FAST CURRENT!\nFishing and surfing prohibited!

TwoIsland_Text_WelcomeToShopMerchandiseL.text: Oh!\nHello, welcome to my shop!\pWe've only opened up recently.\pOur merchandise is limited, but I\nhope we can serve your needs.

TwoIsland_Text_AddedMerchandiseForLostel.text:
I can't tell you how grateful I am
for your rescue of LOSTELLE.\pThanks to your feat, the people of
THREE ISLAND have changed their\lattitudes about KANTO people.\pAnd, I'm from KANTO, you see.\pThe people of THREE ISLAND
helped me add to my merchandise.

TwoIsland_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest.text: Hi! I'm giving it my best here.\nI hope you do too, {PLAYER}.

TwoIsland_Text_BringingItemsFromDistantL.text:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
Welcome!\pI've started bringing in items from
distant lands.\pI've got some rare items in, too.
Please have a look!

TwoIsland_Text_FellowMovedFromCeladonCit.text:
That fellow there, he moved here
from CELADON CITY.\pHe started up a shop with his
younger brother.\pYou have to wonder if he knew what
he was getting into.

TwoIsland_Text_ShopkeepersBrotherWorksGa.text: The shopkeeper's brother took\na job at the GAME CORNER.\pHe's trying to pull together money\nso they can buy more merchandise.

TwoIsland_Text_BrunoCameToIslandWhileBac.text:
Listen, listen.
Did you know?\pA famous TRAINER came to the
ISLAND a little while back.\pHe's one of the ELITE FOUR.
His name is BRUNO.\pHe went away disappointed when he
found out that they were all sold\lout of Rage Candybars.

TwoIsland_Text_BuyRareItemsHere.text: The discerning TRAINER knows to\nbuy rare items here!

TwoIsland_Text_OldWomanLivesOutOnCape.text: There's an old woman who lives in\na cottage out on the cape.\pShe gives the eye to POKéMON.\nIt's a bit unnerving.

TwoIsland_Text_HaveYouTriedJumpingGame.text:
Boing! Boing!
Have you tried the jumping game?\pThe POKéMON you can enter…
Boing!\pSome go boing!\pAnd some go boooooooing!\pDid you know that?
Boing!

Text_UltimateMoveThatMon.text:
I perfected the ultimate move of
its type…\pBut will no one take it for
future use?\p…Hm? Hmmm!\pY-you…
Th-that {STR_VAR_1}…

Text_AllowMeToTeachMonUltimateMove.text:
Oh! This is the one!
This is the POKéMON!\pThis {STR_VAR_1} is worthy of
learning my ultimate move!\pWill you allow it?\pWill you allow your {STR_VAR_1} to
learn my {STR_VAR_2}?

Text_YouRejectIt.text: Gaah! You reject it?\nNo, I won't be dissuaded!

Text_LetMeConferUltimateMove.text: You will allow it?\pThen, let me confer my ultimate\n{STR_VAR_2} on your {STR_VAR_1}.\pGgggrah-awooo!

Text_TaughtMove.text: Gasp, gasp, gasp…\pI didn't think I could teach that\nmove while I still lived…

Text_MakeBestUseOfMove.text: I implore you to make the best\nuse of that move and gain power!

Text_PassedOnEverythingIKnow.text: Gasp, gasp, gasp…\pI have no regrets now.\nI've passed on everything I know.\pNow I can live out my life knowing\nmy work is done.

Text_FeelRejuvenated.text: After I passed on my knowledge to\nyou, I felt so much relief.\pIn fact, I feel rejuvenated,\nas if I were younger again!

TwoIsland_House_Text_TeachMonMoveForMush.text:
I'm the POKéMON MOVE MANIAC.\pI know every single move that
POKéMON learn growing up.\pI'm also a mushroom maniac.\pBring me two TINYMUSHROOMS,
or one BIG MUSHROOM.\pIf you do that for me, I'll teach
a move to one POKéMON.

TwoIsland_House_Text_WantMeToTeachMove.text: Sniff, sniff…\nHm! You smell of MUSHROOMS!\pDo you want me to teach a move\nto a POKéMON of yours?

TwoIsland_House_Text_NoMoveICanTeachThat.text: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have a\nmove I can teach that POKéMON.

TwoIsland_House_Text_IllNeedMushroomOrTw.text: Then, I'll need a MUSHROOM or two.\nWhat are you going to give me?

TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverOneBigMus.text: {PLAYER} handed over one\nBIG MUSHROOM in exchange.

TwoIsland_House_Text_NeedMushroomOrTwoTo.text: If your POKéMON need to learn a\nmove, I need a MUSHROOM or two.

TwoIsland_House_Text_CantTeachAnEgg.text: Hunh? There isn't a single move\nthat I can teach an EGG.

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_WhereHas.text: Now, where's LOSTELLE gotten to\ntoday?\pShe always brings me lunch every\nday right about now…

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseHe.text:
Hm? You, there!
Are you a friend of LOSTELLE's?\pHave you seen LOSTELLE around?
I don't know where she might be.\lShe should've been here long ago.\pLOSTELLE's a cutie - she got my
looks - so what if someone…\pWhat if something's happened to
my LOSTELLE?!\pPlease, help me find her!
Please go search THREE ISLAND!

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_IsThisOn.text:
Hah? What is this GAME CORNER?
How much sadder can this get?\pThose clowns…\pThey said they'd be waiting on the
island, so where are they?\pHey, you! Is this the only THREE
ISLAND around here?

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ThisIsTw.text: Try waking up before you crawl out\nof bed, you punk.\pThis is TWO ISLAND!\pMove it! Get your filthy motorbike\nout of my place!

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_TheseIsl.text: Huh…\nOh, oh, gotcha.\pTch…\nThese islands are confusing…

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PunkScuf.text: Would you look at that?\nThat punk scuffed up my floor.

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseGo.text:
Hey, but listen! I'm begging you,
you have to go to THREE ISLAND.\pIf anything were to happen to my
LOSTELLE…\pMy place is the house with the red
roof on THREE ISLAND.\pShe may just show up late here,
so I can't run off anywhere.\pThat's why I have to get you to do
me this big favor.

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_NotRunni.text: I'm sorry.\nWe're not running any games today.

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_GetGames.text: We'll get the games going soon\nfor you!

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_YouRescu.text: So you rescued LOSTELLE?\nHow can I thank you?\pLOSTELLE, darling, forgive me!\pDaddy didn't know you were scared\nand in trouble!

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_Lostelle.text: LOSTELLE: It's okay, Daddy.\nI got to be friends with {PLAYER}!

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ThisIsFo.text:
Oh, what's that?
You're saying that this is for me?\pHow did you know that I love rare
rocks and gems?\pYou sure know how to make a guy
happy.

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_OhThisIs.text: Oh, I see, this is from BILL!\nYou have to thank him for me!\pYou know, you've been fantastic.\nI want you to have this.

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_Received.text: {PLAYER} received a MOON STONE\nfrom LOSTELLE's daddy.

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_NotGoing.text: Your BAG's not going to fit another\nthing…

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_IllGetGa.text: All right, I'll get the GAME CORNER\nrunning right away.\pYou have to come visit with a\nfriend.

TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseSh.text: Listen, listen!\pPlease show me you being cool\nagain!

TwoIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HaveYouV.text: Have you visited the GAME CORNER\nalready?\pIt's no good to go alone.\nYou have to take a friend along.

TwoIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OldLadyL.text:
Not many people live on
TWO ISLAND.\pThere is this old lady who lives
out on the cape.\pShe's been there since I don't know
when.

UndergroundPath_EastEntrance_Text_DoYouG.text: The DEPARTMENT STORE in CELADON\nhas a great selection.\pDo you go there very often?

UndergroundPath_SouthEntrance_Text_Peopl.text: People often lose things in the\ndarkness of the UNDERGROUND PATH.

UndergroundPath_WestEntrance_Text_Sleepy.text: I heard a sleepy POKéMON appeared\nout near CELADON CITY, too.

VermilionCity_Text_GrimerMultipliesInSlu.text: We're careful about pollution here.\pWe've heard GRIMER multiplies in\ntoxic sludge.

VermilionCity_Text_DidYouSeeSSAnneInHarb.text: Did you see the S.S. ANNE moored\nin the harbor?

VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneHasDepartedForY.text: So, the S.S. ANNE has departed?\pShe'll be back in VERMILION about\nthis time next year.

VermilionCity_Text_BuildingOnThisLand.text: I'm putting up a building on this\nplot of land. I own it all.\pMy POKéMON is tamping the land\nto lay the foundation.

VermilionCity_Text_MachopStompingLandFla.text: A MACHOP is stomping the land flat.

VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneVisitsOnceAYear.text: The S.S. ANNE is a famous luxury\ncruise ship.\pIt visits VERMILION once a year.

VermilionCity_Text_CitySign.text: VERMILION CITY\nThe Port of Exquisite Sunsets

VermilionCity_Text_SnorlaxBlockingRoute1.text: NOTICE!\pROUTE 12 may be blocked off by a\nsleeping POKéMON.\pDetour through ROCK TUNNEL to\nLAVENDER TOWN.\pVERMILION POLICE

VermilionCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign.text: POKéMON FAN CLUB\nAll POKéMON fans welcome!

VermilionCity_Text_GymSign.text: VERMILION CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\lThe Lightning American!

VermilionCity_Text_DoYouHaveATicket.text: Welcome to the S.S. ANNE!\pExcuse me, do you have a ticket?

VermilionCity_Text_FlashedSSTicket.text: {FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} flashed the S.S. TICKET!\p{FONT_MALE}Great!\nWelcome to the S.S. ANNE!

VermilionCity_Text_DontHaveNeededSSTicke.text: {FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} doesn't have the needed\nS.S. TICKET.\p{FONT_MALE}Sorry!\pYou need a ticket to get aboard.

VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopTriPass.text: Ah, you have a TRI-PASS.\pWould you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?

VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop7Departing.text: Okay, everything's in order.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 7 will be\ndeparting immediately.

VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopRainbow.text: Ah, you have a RAINBOW PASS.\pWould you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?

VermilionCity_Text_OhMysticTicketTakeYou.text: Oh! That's a MYSTICTICKET!\nNow that is rare.\pWe'll be happy to take you to\nNAVEL ROCK anytime.

VermilionCity_Text_OhAuroraTicketTakeYou.text: Oh! That's an AURORATICKET!\nNow that is rare.\pWe'll be happy to take you to\nBIRTH ISLAND anytime.

VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopFerry.text: Would you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?

VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop10Departing.text: Okay, everything's in order for you\nto board a special ferry.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 10 will be\ndeparting immediately.

VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop12Departing.text: Okay, everything's in order for you\nto board a special ferry.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 12 will be\ndeparting immediately.

VermilionCity_Text_Route2AideHasPackageF.text:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
How are you doing?\pIt's me, one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pDid you meet the other AIDE?\pHe had a package from PROF. OAK
for you, {PLAYER}.\pHe said he'd look for you around
ROUTE 2, {PLAYER}.\pIf you're in the ROUTE 2 area,
please look for him.

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeIntro.text:
Hey, kid! What do you think you're
doing here?\pYou won't live long in combat!
Not with your puny power!\pI tell you, kid, electric POKéMON
saved me during the war!\pThey zapped my enemies into
paralysis!\pThe same as I'll do to you!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgePostBattle.text: A little word of advice, kid!\pElectricity is sure powerful!\pBut, it's useless against GROUND-\ntype POKéMON!

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainThunderBad.text:
The THUNDERBADGE cranks up your
POKéMON's SPEED!\pIt also lets your POKéMON FLY
lightning-quick anytime, kid!\pYou're special, kid!
Take this!

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM34.text: TM34 contains SHOCK WAVE!\pTeach it to an ELECTRIC POKéMON!

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_MakeRoomInYourBag.text: Yo, kid, make room in your BAG!

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeDefeat.text: Now that's a shocker!\pYou're the real deal, kid!\pFine, then, take the THUNDERBADGE!

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerIntro.text: When I was in the Army, LT. SURGE\nwas my strict CO.\pHe was a hard taskmaster.

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerPostBattle.text: It's not easy opening that door.\pLT. SURGE was always famous for\nhis cautious nature in the Army.

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyIntro.text: I'm a lightweight, but I'm good\nwith electricity!\pThat's why I joined this GYM.

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyPostBattle.text: Okay, I'll talk!\pLT. SURGE said he hid door\nswitches inside something.

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwayneIntro.text: This is no place for kids!\nNot even if you're good!

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwaynePostBattle.text:
LT. SURGE installed the traps in
the GYM himself.\pHe set up double locks everywhere.
Let me give you a hint.\pWhen you open the first lock, the
second lock is right next to it.

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLT. SURGE has a nickname.\pPeople refer to him as the
Lightning American!\pHe's an expert on electric
POKéMON.\pBIRD/WATER-type POKéMON match
poorly against the ELECTRIC type.\pBeware of paralysis, too.\pLT. SURGE is very cautious.\pHe's locked himself in, so it won't
be easy getting to him.

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue.text: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWo.text: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SwitchUnderTrashF.text: Hey! There's a switch under the\ntrash! Turn it on!\pThe first electric lock opened!

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_AnotherSwitchInTr.text: ガサゴソ‥！\nおっと！　ゴミばこの　そこに\lまた　スイッチが　あった！\lおして　みよう！　‥　ポチッとな

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SecondLockOpened.text: The second electric lock opened!\nThe motorized door opened!

VermilionCity_Gym_Text_OnlyTrashLocksWer.text: Nope!\nThere's only trash here.\pHey!\nThe electric locks were reset!

VermilionCity_House1_Text_ImFishingGuruD.text: I'm the FISHING GURU!\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?

VermilionCity_House1_Text_TakeThisAndFis.text: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!

VermilionCity_House1_Text_ReceivedOldRod.text: {PLAYER} received an OLD ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU.

VermilionCity_House1_Text_FishingIsAWayO.text: Fishing is a way of life!\nIt is like the finest poetry.\pFrom the seas to rivers, go out\nand land the big one, my friend.

VermilionCity_House1_Text_HowAreTheFishB.text: Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pHow are the fish biting?

VermilionCity_House1_Text_NoRoomForNiceG.text: Oh, no!\pI had a nice gift for you, but you\nhave no room for it!

VermilionCity_House2_Text_DoYouHaveMonWa.text: Hi!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?

VermilionCity_House2_Text_ThisIsNoMon.text: …This is no {STR_VAR_1}.\pIf you get one, please trade it\nto me!

VermilionCity_House2_Text_HowIsMyOldMon.text: How is my old {STR_VAR_2}?\pMy {STR_VAR_1} is doing great!

VermilionCity_House3_Text_PidgeyFlyLette.text: I'm getting my PIDGEY to fly a\nletter to SAFFRON in the north.

VermilionCity_House3_Text_DearPippiLette.text: Dear PIPPI,\nI hope to see you soon.\pI heard SAFFRON has problems with\nTEAM ROCKET.\pVERMILION appears to be safe.

VermilionCity_House3_Text_SendMyPidgeyTo.text: I want to exchange MAIL with all\nsorts of people.\pI send my PIDGEY to a UNION ROOM\nto exchange MAIL for me.

VermilionCity_Mart_Text_TeamRocketAreWic.text:
There are wicked people who will
use POKéMON for criminal acts.\pTEAM ROCKET traffics in rare
POKéMON, for example.\pThey also abandon POKéMON that
they consider unpopular or useless.\pThat's the sort of horrid people
they are, TEAM ROCKET.

VermilionCity_Mart_Text_MonsGoodOrBadDep.text: I think POKéMON can be good or\nbad. It depends on the TRAINER.

VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trai.text: Even if they are the same level,\nPOKéMON can have very different\lstats and abilities.\pA POKéMON raised by a TRAINER is\nstronger than one in the wild.

VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Pois.text: My POKéMON was poisoned!\nIt fainted while we were walking!

VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AllM.text:
It is true that a higher-level
POKéMON will be more powerful…\pBut, all POKéMON will have weak
points against specific types.\pSo, there appears to be no
universally strong POKéMON.

VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Urge.text:
The urge to battle with someone
you've tangled with before…\pHave you ever had that urge?
I'm sure you have.\pI wanted to battle certain people
again over and over, too.\pSo, I've been giving these away.
Please, take one!

VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_UseD.text: Use that device and you'll find\nTRAINERS looking for a rematch.\pYou have to charge its battery to\nuse it, though.

VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Expl.text:
How do you use the VS SEEKER?
There's nothing to it.\pUse it like beep-beep-beep, and
TRAINERS around you will notice.\pIf any TRAINER wants a rematch,
it will let you know immediately.\pCharge its battery and use it
while you're on a road.

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Admire.text: Won't you admire my PIKACHU's\nadorable tail?

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Pikach.text: Humph!\pMy PIKACHU is twice as cute as\nthat one!

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AdoreM.text: I just adore my SEEL!\nIt's so lovable!\pIt squeals, “Kyuuuh,” when I\nhug it!

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_SeelFa.text: Oh, dear!\pMy SEEL is far more attractive.\nBy double, I would say.

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidYou.text:
I chair the POKéMON Fan Club!\pI raise more than a hundred
POKéMON!\pI'm very fussy when it comes to
POKéMON! I surely am!\pSo…\pDid you come visit to hear about
my POKéMON?

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Chairm.text:
Good!
Then listen up!\pMy favorite RAPIDASH…\pIt's…cute…lovely…smart… 
plus…amazing…you think so?…\loh yes…it's…stunning…\lkindly…love it!\pHug it…when…sleeping…warm
and cuddly…spectacular…\lravishing…\l…Oops! Look at the time!\lI kept you too long!\pThanks for hearing me out!
I want you to have this!

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Receiv.text: {PLAYER} received a BIKE VOUCHER\nfrom the CHAIRMAN.

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Explai.text:
Take that BIKE VOUCHER to the
BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY.\pExchange that for a BICYCLE
free of charge!\pDon't worry, my favorite FEAROW
will FLY me anywhere I need to go.\pSo, I have no need for a BICYCLE.\pI hope you like cycling!

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ComeBa.text: Oh. Come back when you want to\nhear my story!

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidntC.text: Hello, {PLAYER}!\pDid you come see me about my\nPOKéMON again?\pNo?\nToo bad!

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Chairm.text: Our CHAIRMAN is very vocal about\nPOKéMON.

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Listen.text: Let's all listen politely to other\nTRAINERS!

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Someon.text: If someone brags, brag right back!

VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Chairm.text: Our CHAIRMAN really does adore his\nPOKéMON.\pBut the person who is most liked by\nPOKéMON is DAISY, I think.

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiIntro.text: I wonder if you are good enough\nfor me?

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiPostBattle.text: I never wanted to lose to anybody,\nespecially to a younger kid…

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoIntro.text: I can see you're good.\nLet me see exactly how good!

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoPostBattle.text: Tch!\nI concede, you are better than I!

VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonIntro.text: If you can get through here,\nyou can go meet the ELITE FOUR.

VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonPostBattle.text: I can beat you when it comes to\nknowledge about POKéMON!

VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukeIntro.text: This here is VICTORY ROAD.\nIt's the final test for TRAINERS!

VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukePostBattle.text: If you get stuck, try moving some\nboulders around.

VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonIntro.text: Ah, so you wish to challenge the\nELITE FOUR?

VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentPostBattle.text: You earned the right to be on\nVICTORY ROAD…

VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryPostBattle.text: Many TRAINERS give up their\nchallenge here and go home.

Text_DoubleEdgeTeach.text:
You should be proud of yourself,
having battled your way through\lVICTORY ROAD so courageously.\pIn recognition of your feat,
I'll teach you DOUBLE-EDGE.\pWould you like me to teach that
technique?

Text_DoubleEdgeTaught.text: Keep that drive going for the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE!\pTake a run at them and knock 'em\nout!

VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgeIntro.text: I heard rumors of a child prodigy.

VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgePostBattle.text: So, it was you who beat GIOVANNI\nof TEAM ROCKET?

VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaPostBattle.text: By fighting tough battles, you get\nstronger.

VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolineIntro.text: I'll show you just how good you\nare. Not!

VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolinePostBattle.text: You showed me just how good\nI was…

VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyIntro.text: Only the chosen can pass here!

VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyPostBattle.text: All TRAINERS here are headed to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE.\pDon't let down your guard.

VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayIntro.text: RAY: Together, the two of us are\ndestined for greatness!

VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayPostBattle.text: RAY: You've beaten us.\nGreatness remains elusive…

VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayNotEnoughMons.text: RAY: Together, the two of us are\nstriving for the pinnacle.\pWe need you to bring two POKéMON\ninto battle with us.

VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraIntro.text: TYRA: We're trying to become\nchampions together.

VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraPostBattle.text: TYRA: You've taught me that power\ncan be infinite in shape and form.

VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons.text: TYRA: You can't battle with us if\nyou have only one POKéMON.

ViridianCity_Text_CanCarryMonsAnywhere.text: Those POKé BALLS at your waist!\nYou have POKéMON, don't you?\pIt's great that you can carry and\nuse POKéMON anytime, anywhere.

ViridianCity_Text_GymClosedWonderWhoLead.text: This POKéMON GYM is always closed.\pI wonder who the LEADER is?

ViridianCity_Text_WantToKnowAboutCaterpi.text: You want to know about the two\nkinds of caterpillar POKéMON?

ViridianCity_Text_ExplainCaterpieWeedle.text: CATERPIE has no poison,\nbut WEEDLE does.\pWatch that your POKéMON aren't\nstabbed by WEEDLE's POISON STING.

ViridianCity_Text_GrandpaHasntHadCoffeeY.text: Oh, Grandpa!\nDon't be so mean!\pI'm so sorry.\nHe hasn't had his coffee yet.

ViridianCity_Text_GoShoppingInPewterOcca.text: I go shopping in PEWTER CITY\noccasionally.\pI have to take the winding trail in\nVIRIDIAN FOREST when I go.

ViridianCity_Text_ThisIsPrivateProperty.text: I absolutely forbid you from\ngoing through here!\pThis is private property!

ViridianCity_Text_ShowYouHowToCatchMons.text:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pHm?
What is that red box you have?\pAh, so you're working on your
POKéDEX.\pThen let me give you a word of
advice.\pWhenever you catch a POKéMON,
the POKéDEX automatically updates\lits data.\p…You don't know how to catch
a POKéMON?\pI suppose I had better show you
then!

ViridianCity_Text_ThatWasEducationalTake.text: There! Now tell me, that was\neducational, was it not?\pAnd here, take this, too.

ViridianCity_Text_WatchThatToLearnBasics.text: If there's something you don't\nunderstand, watch that.\pIt will teach you about the basics\nof being a POKéMON TRAINER.

ViridianCity_Text_WeakenMonsFirstToCatch.text:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pBut I made it too strong.
It gave me a headache…\pIncidentally, are you filling your
POKéDEX?\pAt first, focus on weakening the
POKéMON before trying to catch it.

ViridianCity_Text_HowsTeachyTVHelping.text:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pBut I made it too strong.
It gave me a headache…\pIncidentally, is my old TEACHY TV
helping you?

ViridianCity_Text_MyGrandsonOnTheShow.text: Wahaha!\nIt's my grandson on the show!\pSince he's the one doing the\nteaching, you're bound to learn.

ViridianCity_Text_TooBusyForTeachyTV.text: Hm… You're too busy to not even\nhave the time for TEACHY TV…\pTime is money, and neither should\nbe ill spent…

ViridianCity_Text_CatchMonsForEasierBatt.text: TRAINER TIPS\pCatch POKéMON and expand your\ncollection.\pThe more you have, the easier it\nis to battle.

ViridianCity_Text_MovesLimitedByPP.text: TRAINER TIPS\pThe battle moves of POKéMON are\nlimited by their POWER POINTS, PP.\pTo replenish PP, rest your tired\nPOKéMON at a POKéMON CENTER.

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniIntro.text:
Fwahahaha!
Welcome to my hideout!\pIt shall be so until I can restore
TEAM ROCKET to its former glory.\pBut, you have found me again.
So be it.\lThis time, I'm not holding back!\pOnce more, you shall face
GIOVANNI, the greatest TRAINER!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniDefeat.text: Ha!\nThat was a truly intense fight.\lYou have won!\pAs proof, here is the EARTHBADGE!\n{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniPostBattle.text:
Having lost in this fashion, 
I can't face my followers.\lI have betrayed their trust.\pAs of today, TEAM ROCKET is
finished forever!\pAs for myself, I shall dedicate
my life to training again.\pLet us meet again someday!
Farewell!

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainEarthBadgeT.text:
The EARTHBADGE makes POKéMON of
any level obey without question.\pIt is evidence of your mastery as
a POKéMON TRAINER.\pWith it, you can challenge the
POKéMON LEAGUE.\pAlso, take this TM.\pConsider it a gift for your POKéMON
LEAGUE challenge.

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM26.text: TM26 contains EARTHQUAKE.\pIt is a powerful attack that causes\na massive tremor.\pI made it when I ran the GYM here,\nfar too long ago…

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YouDoNotHaveSpace.text: You do not have space for this!

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiIntro.text: Heh!\nYou must be running out of steam\lby now!

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiPostBattle.text: You'll need power to keep up with\nour GYM LEADER.

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_AtsushiIntro.text: Rrrroar!\nI'm working myself into a rage!

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonIntro.text: POKéMON and I, we make wonderful\nmusic together!

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonPostBattle.text: Do you know the identity of our\nGYM LEADER?

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoIntro.text: Karate is the ultimate form of\nmartial arts!

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoPostBattle.text: If my POKéMON were as good at\nkarate as I…

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenIntro.text: The truly talented win with style.

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenPostBattle.text: The LEADER will scold me for\nlosing this way…

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiIntro.text: I'm the KARATE KING!\nYour fate rests with me!

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiPostBattle.text: The POKéMON LEAGUE?\nYou? Don't get cocky!

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ColeIntro.text: Your POKéMON will cower at the\ncrack of my whip!

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelIntro.text: VIRIDIAN GYM was closed for a\nlong time.\pBut now, our LEADER is back!

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelPostBattle.text: You can go on to the POKéMON\nLEAGUE only by defeating our GYM\lLEADER!

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice.text:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pEven I don't know the VIRIDIAN
LEADER's identity.\pBut one thing's certain.
This will be the toughest of all\lthe GYM LEADERS.\pAlso, I heard that the TRAINERS
here like GROUND-type POKéMON.

ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory.text: Blow me away! GIOVANNI was the\nGYM LEADER of VIRIDIAN?

ViridianCity_House_Text_NicknamingIsFun.text: Coming up with nicknames is fun,\nbut it's not so easy to do.\pClever names are nice, but simple\nnames are easier to remember.

ViridianCity_Mart_Text_TakeThisToProfOak.text: You know PROF. OAK, right?\pHis order came in.\nCan I get you to take it to him?

ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ReceivedOaksParce.text: {PLAYER} received OAK'S PARCEL\nfrom the POKéMON MART clerk.

ViridianCity_Mart_Text_SayHiToOakForMe.text: Okay, thanks! Please say hi to\nPROF. OAK for me, too.

ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ShopDoesGoodBusin.text: This shop does good business in\nANTIDOTES, I've heard.

ViridianCity_Mart_Text_GotToBuySomePotio.text: I've got to buy some POTIONS.\pYou never know when your POKéMON\nwill need quick healing.

ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FeelF.text: Please feel free to use that PC in\nthe corner.\pThe receptionist told me so.\nIt's so kind of her!

ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeC.text: There's a POKéMON CENTER in every\ntown ahead.\pThey charge no money, so don't\nbe shy about healing POKéMON.
POKéMON CENTERS heal your tired,\nhurt, or fainted POKéMON.\pThey make all POKéMON completely\nhealthy.

ViridianCity_School_Text_TryingToMemoriz.text: Whew! I'm trying to memorize all my\nnotes.

ViridianCity_School_Text_ReadBlackboardC.text: Okay!\pBe sure to read what's on the\nblackboard carefully!

ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFirstPa.text:
Let's check out the notebook.\pFirst page…\pPOKé BALLS are used to catch
POKéMON.\pUp to six POKéMON can be carried
in your party.\pPeople who raise and battle
with POKéMON are called TRAINERS.

ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookSecondP.text: Second page…\pA healthy POKéMON may be hard to\ncatch, so weaken it first.\pPoison, burn, or cause another\nstatus problem to weaken it.

ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookThirdPa.text:
Third page…\pPOKéMON TRAINERS seek others to
engage in POKéMON battles.\pTo TRAINERS, the taste of victory
is sweet, indeed.\pBattles are constantly waged at
POKéMON GYMS everywhere.

ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFourthP.text:
Fourth page…\pThe ultimate goal for all POKéMON
TRAINERS is simple.\pIt is to defeat the top eight
POKéMON GYM LEADERS.\pDo so to earn the right to face…\pThe ELITE FOUR of the POKéMON
LEAGUE!

ViridianCity_School_Text_HeyDontLookAtMy.text: GIRL: Hey!\nDon't look at my notes!

ViridianCity_School_Text_BlackboardLists.text: The blackboard lists POKéMON\nSTATUS problems during battles.

ViridianCity_School_Text_ReadWhichTopic.text: Which topic do you want to read?

ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainSleep.text:
A POKéMON can't attack if it's
asleep.\pPOKéMON will stay asleep even
after battles.\pUse AWAKENING to awaken one
from sleep.

ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainBurn.text: A burn reduces ATTACK power.\nIt also causes ongoing HP loss.\pA burn remains after a battle.\nUse BURN HEAL to cure a burn.

ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainPoison.text: When poisoned, a POKéMON's health\nsteadily drops.\pPoison lingers after battles.\nUse an ANTIDOTE to cure poison!

ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainFreeze.text:
A frozen POKéMON becomes
helplessly immobile.\pIt stays frozen even after the
battle ends.\pUse ICE HEAL to thaw out the
suffering POKéMON.

ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainParalysi.text: Paralysis reduces SPEED and may\nprevent the POKéMON from moving.\pParalysis remains after battles.\nUse PARLYZ HEAL for treatment.

ViridianForest_Text_FriendsItchingToBatt.text: I came here with some friends to\ncatch us some BUG POKéMON!\pThey're all itching to get into\nsome POKéMON battles!

ViridianForest_Text_RickIntro.text: Hey! You have POKéMON!\nCome on!\lLet's battle 'em!

ViridianForest_Text_RickPostBattle.text: Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away.\nAnother time, okay?

ViridianForest_Text_DougIntro.text: Yo!\nYou can't jam out if you're a\lPOKéMON TRAINER!

ViridianForest_Text_DougPostBattle.text: That totally stinks! I'm going to\ncatch some stronger ones!

ViridianForest_Text_SammyIntro.text: Hey, wait up!\nWhat's the hurry? Why the rush?

ViridianForest_Text_SammyPostBattle.text: Sometimes, you can find stuff on\nthe ground.\pI'm looking for the stuff I\ndropped. Can you help me?

ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyIntro.text: I might be little, but I won't like\nit if you go easy on me!

ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyPostBattle.text: I lost some of my allowance…

ViridianForest_Text_CharlieIntro.text: Did you know that POKéMON evolve?

ViridianForest_Text_CharliePostBattle.text: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.\nThey're a lot of fun!

ViridianForest_Text_RanOutOfPokeBalls.text: I was throwing POKé BALLS to\ncatch POKéMON, and I ran out.\pThat's why you can never have too\nmany POKé BALLS.

ViridianForest_Text_AvoidGrassyAreasWhen.text: TRAINER TIPS\pIf your POKéMON are weak and you\nwant to avoid battles, stay away\lfrom grassy areas!

ViridianForest_Text_UseAntidoteForPoison.text: For poison, use ANTIDOTE!\nGet it at POKéMON MARTS!

ViridianForest_Text_ContactOakViaPCToRat.text: TRAINER TIPS\pContact PROF. OAK via a PC to\nget your POKéDEX evaluated!

ViridianForest_Text_CantCatchOwnedMons.text: TRAINER TIPS\pYou can't catch a POKéMON that\nbelongs to someone else.\pThrow POKé BALLS only at wild\nPOKéMON to catch them!

ViridianForest_Text_WeakenMonsBeforeCapt.text: TRAINER TIPS\pWeaken POKéMON before attempting\ncapture!\pWhen healthy, they may escape!
